using System.Web;
using System.Web.Optimization;

namespace GradeWise
{
    public class BundleConfig
    {
        // For more information on bundling, visit https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkId=301862
        public static void RegisterBundles(BundleCollection bundles)
        {
            bundles.Add(new ScriptBundle("~/bundles/jquery").Include(
                        "~/Scripts/jquery-{version}.js"));

            bundles.Add(new ScriptBundle("~/bundles/jqueryval").Include(
                        "~/Scripts/jquery.validate*"));

            // Use the development version of Modernizr to develop with and learn from. Then, when you're
            // ready for production, use the build tool at https://modernizr.com to pick only the tests you need.
            bundles.Add(new ScriptBundle("~/bundles/modernizr").Include(
                        "~/Scripts/modernizr-*"));

            bundles.Add(new Bundle("~/bundles/bootstrap").Include(
                      "~/Scripts/bootstrap.js"));

            // Shared modal dialogs (GW.confirm, GW.alert, GW.modal, data-confirm).
            bundles.Add(new ScriptBundle("~/bundles/gwmodal").Include(
                      "~/Scripts/gw-modal.js"));

            // Student notification bell (loaded only for students).
            bundles.Add(new ScriptBundle("~/bundles/gwnotifications").Include(
                      "~/Scripts/gw-notifications.js"));

            bundles.Add(new StyleBundle("~/Content/css").Include(
                      "~/Content/bootstrap.css"));
        }
    }
}



================================================================================
FILE: GradeWise\App_Start\FilterConfig.cs
================================================================================
using System.Web;
using System.Web.Mvc;
using GradeWise.Filters;

namespace GradeWise
{
    public class FilterConfig
    {
        public static void RegisterGlobalFilters(GlobalFilterCollection filters)
        {
            filters.Add(new HandleErrorAttribute());
            filters.Add(new NoCacheAttribute());
        }
    }
}



================================================================================
FILE: GradeWise\App_Start\RouteConfig.cs
================================================================================
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Web;
using System.Web.Mvc;
using System.Web.Routing;

namespace GradeWise
{
    public class RouteConfig
    {
        public static void RegisterRoutes(RouteCollection routes)
        {
            routes.IgnoreRoute("{resource}.axd/{*pathInfo}");

            routes.MapRoute(
                name: "Default",
                url: "{controller}/{action}/{id}",
                defaults: new { controller = "Home", action = "Index", id = UrlParameter.Optional }
            );
        }
    }
}

   The old navy/gold variables were removed in Phase R9; the few legacy names
   still used by rules (--gw-page, --gw-head, --gw-line, --gw-muted) point at the new palette. */

/* =====================================================================

   1. Text a little bigger: notes, table cells, chips and the small
      pixel-font captions go up by about 0.05 to 0.1rem.
   2. A little more room: card padding and the gap between sections.
   3. Calmer colours. Each colour has one job:
        paper   = cards and table bodies
        grey    = table headers, group rows, note bands, filter bar
        lime    = "your number" or "what you picked" (the one big result
                  card, the picked chip, the open category, result rows)
        gold / orange = only the PS standing chips
        category colours = only the small square dots and the stripe on a
                  closed category column
   Scoped to .gw-sg-course (Course page) and .gw-student-whatif only.

================================================================================
FILE: GradeWise\Controllers\AccountController.cs

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Web;
using System.Web.Mvc;
using System.Web.Security;
using GradeWise.Data;
using GradeWise.Helpers;
using GradeWise.Models;
using MongoDB.Driver;
using Roles = GradeWise.Models.Roles;

namespace GradeWise.Controllers
{
    public class AccountController : Controller
    {
        private const int TimeoutMinutes = 30;

        [AllowAnonymous]
        public ActionResult Login(string returnUrl)
        {
            if (User.Identity.IsAuthenticated)
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(returnUrl)) return RedirectToDashboard(CurrentRole());
                ViewBag.Error = "Your account does not have access to that page.";
            }
            return View();
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [AllowAnonymous]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult Login(string loginId, string password)
        {
            loginId = (loginId ?? string.Empty).Trim();
            ViewBag.LoginId = loginId;

            if (loginId.Length == 0 || string.IsNullOrEmpty(password))
            {
                ViewBag.Error = "Enter your student number or email and your password.";
                return View();
            }

            User user = null;
            MongoDbContext db = null;
            try
            {
                db = new MongoDbContext();
                var lowerLogin = loginId.ToLower();
                user = db.Users.Find(u => u.StudentNo.ToLower() == lowerLogin || u.Email.ToLower() == lowerLogin).FirstOrDefault();
            }
            catch (Exception) { }

            var passwordOk = user != null && PasswordHelper.Verify(password, user.PasswordHash, user.Salt, user.PasswordIterations);

            if (!passwordOk) { ViewBag.Error = "Incorrect ID/email or password."; return View(); }
            if (!user.IsActive) { ViewBag.Error = "This account has been disabled."; return View(); }
            if (!Roles.IsValid(user.Role)) { ViewBag.Error = "This account has an invalid role."; return View(); }

            // NEW: Force password change
            if (user.MustChangePassword)
            {
                SignIn(user);
                return RedirectToAction("ForceChangePassword");
            }

            var nowUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
            user.LastLoginAt = nowUtc;
            if (db != null)
            {
                try { db.Users.UpdateOne(u => u.Id == user.Id, Builders<User>.Update.Set(u => u.LastLoginAt, nowUtc)); } catch { }
            }

            SignIn(user);
            if (Url.IsLocalUrl(Request.QueryString["ReturnUrl"])) return Redirect(Request.QueryString["ReturnUrl"]);
            return RedirectToDashboard(user.Role);
        }

        [Authorize]
        public ActionResult ForceChangePassword()
        {
            return View();
        }

        [Authorize]
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult ForceChangePassword(string newPassword, string confirmPassword)
        {
            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            var identityName = User.Identity.Name.ToLower();
            var user = db.Users.Find(u => u.StudentNo.ToLower() == identityName || u.Email.ToLower() == identityName).FirstOrDefault();

            if (user == null) return RedirectToAction("Logout");

            var errors = new List<string>();
            var problem = ValidationHelper.PasswordProblem(newPassword);

            if (problem != null) errors.Add(problem);
            else if (newPassword != confirmPassword) errors.Add("The new password and its confirmation do not match.");

            if (errors.Count > 0)
            {
                ViewBag.Errors = errors;
                return View();
            }

            string salt;
            int iterations;
            var hash = PasswordHelper.CreateHash(newPassword, out salt, out iterations);

            var update = Builders<User>.Update
                .Set(u => u.PasswordHash, hash)
                .Set(u => u.Salt, salt)
                .Set(u => u.PasswordIterations, iterations)
                .Set(u => u.MustChangePassword, false);

            db.Users.UpdateOne(u => u.Id == user.Id, update);
            TempData["Message"] = "Your new password has been saved. Welcome!";
            return RedirectToDashboard(user.Role);
        }

        public ActionResult Logout()
        {
            FormsAuthentication.SignOut();
            Session.Abandon();
            Response.AppendHeader("Clear-Site-Data", "\"cache\"");
            return RedirectToAction("Login", "Account");
        }

        [Authorize]
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult UpdateProfile(string firstName, string middleName, string lastName, string suffix,
            string loginId, string email, string currentPassword)
        {
            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            var me = FindCurrentUser(db);
            if (me == null || !me.IsActive) return RedirectToAction("Logout");

            firstName = NormalizeNamePart(firstName);
            middleName = NormalizeNamePart(middleName);
            lastName = NormalizeNamePart(lastName);
            suffix = (suffix ?? string.Empty).Trim();
            loginId = (loginId ?? string.Empty).Trim();
            email = (email ?? string.Empty).Trim().ToLowerInvariant();

            var errors = new List<string>();
            var validSuffixes = new[] { "", "Jr.", "Sr.", "II", "III", "IV", "V" };
            if (firstName.Length == 0) errors.Add("Enter your first name.");
            if (lastName.Length == 0) errors.Add("Enter your last name.");
            if (new[] { firstName, middleName, lastName }.Any(x => x.Length > 40)) errors.Add("Each name field must be 40 characters or fewer.");
            if (new[] { firstName, middleName, lastName }.Any(x => x.Any(char.IsControl))) errors.Add("Name fields cannot contain control characters.");
            if (!validSuffixes.Contains(suffix)) errors.Add("Choose a valid suffix.");

            var fullName = string.Join(" ", new[] { firstName, middleName, lastName, suffix }.Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x)));
            if (fullName.Length > 100) errors.Add("Your full name must be 100 characters or fewer.");

            if (loginId.Length == 0) errors.Add("Enter your sign-in ID.");
            else if (!System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(loginId, @"^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,50}$"))
                errors.Add("Sign-in ID can only use letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores (up to 50 characters).");

            if (email.Length == 0) errors.Add("Enter your email address.");
            else if (!ValidationHelper.IsValidEmail(email)) errors.Add("Enter a valid email address.");

            AddPasswordError(errors, me, currentPassword);

            if (errors.Count == 0 && !string.Equals(loginId, me.StudentNo, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                var takenId = db.Users.Find(u => u.StudentNo.ToLower() == loginId.ToLower() && u.Id != me.Id).FirstOrDefault();
                if (takenId != null) errors.Add("That sign-in ID is already used by another account.");
            }
            if (errors.Count == 0 && !string.Equals(email, me.Email, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                var takenEmail = db.Users.Find(u => u.Email.ToLower() == email && u.Id != me.Id).FirstOrDefault();
                if (takenEmail != null) errors.Add("That email is already used by another account.");
            }

            if (errors.Count > 0)
            {
                TempData["EditInfoProfile"] = new Dictionary<string, string>
                {
                    { "FirstName", firstName }, { "MiddleName", middleName }, { "LastName", lastName },
                    { "Suffix", suffix }, { "LoginId", loginId }, { "Email", email }
                };
                TempData["EditInfoErrors"] = errors;
                TempData["EditInfoForm"] = "profile";
                return RedirectToDashboard(me.Role);
            }

            var update = Builders<User>.Update
                .Set(u => u.FirstName, firstName)
                .Set(u => u.MiddleName, middleName)
                .Set(u => u.LastName, lastName)
                .Set(u => u.Suffix, suffix)
                .Set(u => u.FullName, fullName)
                .Set(u => u.StudentNo, loginId)
                .Set(u => u.Email, email);
            try
            {
                db.Users.UpdateOne(u => u.Id == me.Id, update);
            }
            catch (MongoWriteException ex) when (ex.WriteError.Category == ServerErrorCategory.DuplicateKey)
            {
                TempData["EditInfoProfile"] = new Dictionary<string, string>
                {
                    { "FirstName", firstName }, { "MiddleName", middleName }, { "LastName", lastName },
                    { "Suffix", suffix }, { "LoginId", loginId }, { "Email", email }
                };
                TempData["EditInfoErrors"] = new List<string> { "That sign-in ID or email is already used by another account." };
                TempData["EditInfoForm"] = "profile";
                return RedirectToDashboard(me.Role);
            }

            me.FirstName = firstName;
            me.MiddleName = middleName;
            me.LastName = lastName;
            me.Suffix = suffix;
            me.FullName = fullName;
            me.StudentNo = loginId;
            me.Email = email;
            SignIn(me); // Refresh the authentication ticket when the sign-in ID or display name changes.

            TempData["Message"] = "Profile updated.";
            return RedirectToDashboard(me.Role);
        }

        private static string NormalizeNamePart(string value)
        {
            var trimmed = (value ?? string.Empty).Trim();
            return System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(trimmed, @"\s{2,}", " ");
        }

        [Authorize]
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult ChangeName(string newName)
        {
            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            var me = FindCurrentUser(db);
            if (me == null || !me.IsActive) return RedirectToAction("Logout");

            var typed = (newName ?? string.Empty).Trim();
            var errors = new List<string>();

            if (typed.Length == 0) errors.Add("Enter your name.");
            else if (typed.Any(char.IsControl)) errors.Add("Your name cannot contain control characters.");

            var saved = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(typed, " {2,}", " ");

            if (errors.Count == 0)
            {
                if (saved.Length > 100) errors.Add("Your name must be 100 characters or fewer.");
                else if (string.Equals(saved, me.FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal)) errors.Add("That is already your name.");
            }

            if (errors.Count > 0)
            {
                TempData["EditInfoName"] = newName ?? string.Empty;
                return EditInfoFailed("name", errors, me);
            }

            db.Users.UpdateOne(u => u.Id == me.Id, Builders<User>.Update.Set(u => u.FullName, saved));
            TempData["Message"] = "Name updated.";
            return RedirectToDashboard(me.Role);
        }

        [Authorize]
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult ChangeEmail(string newEmail, string currentPassword)
        {
            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            var me = FindCurrentUser(db);
            if (me == null || !me.IsActive) return RedirectToAction("Logout");

            newEmail = (newEmail ?? string.Empty).Trim();
            var errors = new List<string>();

            if (newEmail.Length == 0) errors.Add("Enter your new email address.");
            else if (!ValidationHelper.IsValidEmail(newEmail)) errors.Add("Enter a valid email address.");
            else if (string.Equals(newEmail, me.Email, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) errors.Add("That is already your email address.");

            AddPasswordError(errors, me, currentPassword);

            if (errors.Count == 0)
            {
                var lower = newEmail.ToLower();
                var taken = db.Users.Find(u => u.Email.ToLower() == lower && u.Id != me.Id).FirstOrDefault();
                if (taken != null) errors.Add("That email is already used by another account.");
            }

            if (errors.Count > 0)
            {
                TempData["EditInfoEmail"] = newEmail;
                return EditInfoFailed("email", errors, me);
            }

            var saved = newEmail.ToLowerInvariant();
            db.Users.UpdateOne(u => u.Id == me.Id, Builders<User>.Update.Set(u => u.Email, saved));
            TempData["Message"] = "Email updated.";
            return RedirectToDashboard(me.Role);
        }

        [Authorize]
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult ChangePassword(string currentPassword, string newPassword, string confirmPassword)
        {
            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            var me = FindCurrentUser(db);
            if (me == null || !me.IsActive) return RedirectToAction("Logout");

            var errors = new List<string>();
            AddPasswordError(errors, me, currentPassword);

            var problem = ValidationHelper.PasswordProblem(newPassword);
            if (problem != null) errors.Add(problem);
            else
            {
                if (newPassword == currentPassword) errors.Add("The new password must be different from your current password.");
                if (newPassword != confirmPassword) errors.Add("The new password and its confirmation do not match.");
            }

            if (errors.Count > 0) return EditInfoFailed("password", errors, me);

            string salt;
            int iterations;
            var hash = PasswordHelper.CreateHash(newPassword, out salt, out iterations);

            var update = Builders<User>.Update
                .Set(u => u.PasswordHash, hash)
                .Set(u => u.Salt, salt)
                .Set(u => u.PasswordIterations, iterations)
                .Set(u => u.MustChangePassword, false);
            db.Users.UpdateOne(u => u.Id == me.Id, update);

            TempData["Message"] = "Password updated.";
            return RedirectToDashboard(me.Role);
        }

        private User FindCurrentUser(MongoDbContext db)
        {
            try
            {
                var name = (User.Identity.Name ?? string.Empty).ToLower();
                return db.Users.Find(u => u.StudentNo.ToLower() == name || u.Email.ToLower() == name).FirstOrDefault();
            }
            catch (Exception) { return null; }
        }

        private static void AddPasswordError(List<string> errors, User me, string currentPassword)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentPassword)) errors.Add("Enter your current password.");
            else if (!PasswordHelper.Verify(currentPassword, me.PasswordHash, me.Salt, me.PasswordIterations))
                errors.Add("Your current password is incorrect.");
        }

        private ActionResult EditInfoFailed(string form, List<string> errors, User me)
        {
            TempData["EditInfoErrors"] = errors;
            TempData["EditInfoForm"] = form;
            return RedirectToDashboard(me.Role);
        }

        public static string DashboardController(string role)
        {
            switch (role)
            {
                case Roles.Administrator: return "Admin";
                case Roles.Faculty: return "Faculty";
                default: return "Student";
            }
        }

        private ActionResult RedirectToDashboard(string role) => RedirectToAction("Index", DashboardController(role));

        private string CurrentRole()
        {
            if (User.IsInRole(Roles.Administrator)) return Roles.Administrator;
            if (User.IsInRole(Roles.Faculty)) return Roles.Faculty;
            return Roles.Student;
        }

        private void SignIn(User user)
        {
            var now = DateTime.Now;
            var ticket = new FormsAuthenticationTicket(1, user.StudentNo, now, now.AddMinutes(TimeoutMinutes), false, user.Role + "|" + user.FullName);
            var cookie = new HttpCookie(FormsAuthentication.FormsCookieName, FormsAuthentication.Encrypt(ticket)) { HttpOnly = true };
            Response.Cookies.Add(cookie);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Web.Mvc;
using GradeWise.Data;
using GradeWise.Helpers;
using GradeWise.Models;
using GradeWise.Services;
using MongoDB.Driver;
using Roles = GradeWise.Models.Roles;

namespace GradeWise.Controllers
{
    [Authorize(Roles = Roles.Administrator)]
    public class AdminController : Controller
    {
        private static readonly string[] AllRoles = { Roles.Administrator, Roles.Faculty, Roles.Student };
        private static readonly Regex LoginIdPattern = new Regex(@"^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,50}$");

        public ActionResult Index()
        {
            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            var users = db.Users.Find(_ => true).ToList()
                .OrderBy(u => Array.IndexOf(AllRoles, u.Role))
                .ThenBy(u => u.FullName).ToList();

            var current = db.Terms.Find(t => t.IsCurrent).FirstOrDefault();
            var deleteBlockers = FindDeleteBlockers(db, users.Select(u => u.Id).ToList());
            var activeAdmins = users.Count(u => u.Role == Roles.Administrator && u.IsActive);

            foreach (var u in users)
            {
                var lastAdmin = LastAdministratorReason(u, activeAdmins - (u.Role == Roles.Administrator && u.IsActive ? 1 : 0));
                if (lastAdmin != null && !deleteBlockers.ContainsKey(u.Id)) deleteBlockers[u.Id] = lastAdmin;
            }

            ViewBag.CurrentTerm = current == null ? null : current.Name;
            ViewBag.MeLogin = User.Identity.Name;
            ViewBag.DeleteBlockers = deleteBlockers;
            return View(users);
        }

        public ActionResult CreateUser()
        {
            ViewBag.Role = Roles.Student;
            return View();
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult CreateUser(string fullName, string loginId, string email, string role,
            string firstName, string middleName, string lastName, string suffix)
        {
            firstName = (firstName ?? string.Empty).Trim();
            middleName = (middleName ?? string.Empty).Trim();
            lastName = (lastName ?? string.Empty).Trim();
            suffix = (suffix ?? string.Empty).Trim();
            var validSuffixes = new[] { "", "Jr.", "Sr.", "II", "III", "IV", "V" };
            fullName = string.Join(" ", new[] { firstName, middleName, lastName, suffix }.Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))).Trim();
            loginId = (loginId ?? string.Empty).Trim();
            email = (email ?? string.Empty).Trim().ToLowerInvariant();

            var errors = new List<string>();

            if (firstName.Length == 0) errors.Add("First name is required.");
            if (lastName.Length == 0) errors.Add("Last name is required.");
            if (new[] { firstName, middleName, lastName }.Any(x => x.Length > 40)) errors.Add("Each name field must be 40 characters or fewer.");
            if (!validSuffixes.Contains(suffix)) errors.Add("Choose a valid suffix.");
            if (fullName.Length > 100) errors.Add("Full name must be 100 characters or fewer.");

            if (loginId.Length == 0) errors.Add("Student number or username is required.");
            else if (!LoginIdPattern.IsMatch(loginId))
                errors.Add("Student number or username can only use letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores (up to 50 characters).");

            if (email.Length == 0) errors.Add("Email is required.");
            else if (!ValidationHelper.IsValidEmail(email)) errors.Add("Enter a valid email address.");

            if (!AllRoles.Contains(role)) errors.Add("Choose a role.");

            string tempPassword = null;
            if (errors.Count == 0)
            {
                var db = new MongoDbContext();
                var existingUser = db.Users.Find(u => u.StudentNo.ToLower() == loginId.ToLower()).FirstOrDefault();
                if (existingUser != null) errors.Add("That student number or username is already taken.");

                var existingEmail = db.Users.Find(u => u.Email.ToLower() == email.ToLower()).FirstOrDefault();
                if (existingEmail != null) errors.Add("That email is already used by another account.");

                if (errors.Count == 0)
                {
                    tempPassword = PasswordHelper.GenerateTemporaryPassword();
                    string salt;
                    int iterations;
                    var hash = PasswordHelper.CreateHash(tempPassword, out salt, out iterations);

                    var newUser = new User
                    {
                        Id = "u-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0, 8),
                        StudentNo = loginId,
                        FullName = fullName,
                        FirstName = firstName,
                        MiddleName = middleName,
                        LastName = lastName,
                        Suffix = suffix,
                        Email = email,
                        PasswordHash = hash,
                        Salt = salt,
                        PasswordIterations = iterations,
                        Role = role,
                        IsActive = true,
                        MustChangePassword = true
                    };

                    try
                    {
                        db.Users.InsertOne(newUser);
                        EmailService.SendTempPassword(email, fullName, tempPassword);
                    }
                    catch (MongoWriteException ex) when (ex.WriteError.Category == ServerErrorCategory.DuplicateKey)
                    {
                        errors.Add("A user with that ID or email was just created by someone else. Please try again.");
                    }
                }
            }

            if (errors.Count > 0)
            {
                ViewBag.Errors = errors;
                ViewBag.FullName = fullName;
                ViewBag.LoginId = loginId;
                ViewBag.Email = email;
                ViewBag.Role = role;
                return View();
            }

            TempData["Message"] = "Account created for " + fullName + " (" + loginId + "). An email with their temporary password has been sent.";
            return RedirectToAction("Index");
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult ChangeRole(string id, string role)
        {
            if (!AllRoles.Contains(role))
            {
                TempData["Error"] = "Choose a valid role.";
                return RedirectToAction("Index");
            }

            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            var target = db.Users.Find(u => u.Id == id).FirstOrDefault();

            if (target == null) TempData["Error"] = "That user no longer exists.";
            else if (IsMe(target)) TempData["Error"] = "You cannot change your own role. Ask another administrator.";
            else if (target.Role == role) TempData["Message"] = target.FullName + " is already " + role + ".";
            else
            {
                db.Users.UpdateOne(u => u.Id == id, Builders<User>.Update.Set(u => u.Role, role));
                TempData["Message"] = target.FullName + " is now " + role + ".";
            }
            return RedirectToAction("Index");
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult SetActive(string id, bool active)
        {
            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            var target = db.Users.Find(u => u.Id == id).FirstOrDefault();

            if (target == null) TempData["Error"] = "That user no longer exists.";
            else if (IsMe(target)) TempData["Error"] = "You cannot disable your own account.";
            else
            {
                db.Users.UpdateOne(u => u.Id == id, Builders<User>.Update.Set(u => u.IsActive, active));
                TempData["Message"] = target.FullName + (active ? " can sign in again." : " has been disabled.");
            }
            return RedirectToAction("Index");
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult ResetPassword(string id)
        {
            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            var target = db.Users.Find(u => u.Id == id).FirstOrDefault();

            if (target == null) TempData["Error"] = "That user no longer exists.";
            else
            {
                var tempPassword = PasswordHelper.GenerateTemporaryPassword();
                string salt;
                int iterations;
                var hash = PasswordHelper.CreateHash(tempPassword, out salt, out iterations);

                var update = Builders<User>.Update
                    .Set(u => u.PasswordHash, hash)
                    .Set(u => u.Salt, salt)
                    .Set(u => u.PasswordIterations, iterations)
                    .Set(u => u.MustChangePassword, true); // FORCE CHANGE

                db.Users.UpdateOne(u => u.Id == id, update);
                EmailService.SendTempPassword(target.Email, target.FullName, tempPassword);

                TempData["Message"] = "Password reset for " + target.FullName + ". Email sent.";
            }
            return RedirectToAction("Index");
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult DeleteUser(string id, string confirmLoginId)
        {
            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            var target = string.IsNullOrEmpty(id) ? null : db.Users.Find(u => u.Id == id).FirstOrDefault();

            if (target == null) { TempData["Error"] = "That user no longer exists."; return RedirectToAction("Index"); }
            var label = target.FullName + " (" + target.StudentNo + ")";

            if (IsMe(target)) { TempData["Error"] = "You cannot delete your own account."; return RedirectToAction("Index"); }

            if (!string.Equals((confirmLoginId ?? string.Empty).Trim(), target.StudentNo, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                TempData["Error"] = "The account ID you typed does not match " + label + ". The account was not deleted.";
                return RedirectToAction("Index");
            }

            try
            {
                var otherActiveAdmins = db.Users.CountDocuments(u => u.Role == Roles.Administrator && u.IsActive && u.Id != target.Id);
                var lastAdmin = LastAdministratorReason(target, otherActiveAdmins);
                if (lastAdmin != null) { TempData["Error"] = label + " cannot be deleted. " + lastAdmin; return RedirectToAction("Index"); }

                string reason;
                if (FindDeleteBlockers(db, new List<string> { target.Id }).TryGetValue(target.Id, out reason))
                {
                    TempData["Error"] = label + " cannot be deleted. " + reason; return RedirectToAction("Index");
                }

                var rosterFilter = Builders<Course>.Filter.AnyEq(c => c.StudentIds, target.Id);
                var rosterCourseIds = db.Courses.Find(rosterFilter).ToList().Select(c => c.Id).ToList();
                var unenrolled = rosterCourseIds.Count == 0 ? 0 : db.Courses.UpdateMany(
                    Builders<Course>.Filter.In(c => c.Id, rosterCourseIds) & rosterFilter,
                    Builders<Course>.Update.Pull(c => c.StudentIds, target.Id)).ModifiedCount;

                var gradedNow = db.Grades.CountDocuments(GradedRecordsOf(new List<string> { target.Id })) > 0;
                var hasSnapshots = db.Snapshots.CountDocuments(s => s.StudentId == target.Id) > 0;
                if (gradedNow || hasSnapshots)
                {
                    if (rosterCourseIds.Count > 0) db.Courses.UpdateMany(Builders<Course>.Filter.In(c => c.Id, rosterCourseIds), Builders<Course>.Update.AddToSet(c => c.StudentIds, target.Id));
                    TempData["Error"] = label + " cannot be deleted because grades were just recorded.";
                    return RedirectToAction("Index");
                }

                var emptyRecords = Builders<GradeRecord>.Filter.Eq(g => g.StudentId, target.Id)
                    & Builders<GradeRecord>.Filter.Not(Builders<GradeRecord>.Filter.ElemMatch(g => g.Scores, s => s.Score != null));
                db.Grades.DeleteMany(emptyRecords);
                db.Notifications.DeleteMany(n => n.StudentId == target.Id);

                var deleted = db.Users.DeleteOne(u => u.Id == target.Id).DeletedCount;
                if (deleted != 1) { TempData["Error"] = "That user no longer exists."; return RedirectToAction("Index"); }

                TempData["Message"] = "Account deleted: " + label + "."
                    + (unenrolled > 0 ? " Also removed from " + unenrolled + (unenrolled == 1 ? " course." : " courses.") : string.Empty);
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is MongoException || ex is TimeoutException)
            {
                TempData["Error"] = "The database could not be reached, so " + label + " may not have been deleted.";
            }
            return RedirectToAction("Index");
        }

        public ActionResult Terms()
        {
            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            var terms = db.Terms.Find(_ => true).ToList();

            // Why a term cannot be deleted (in use, or courses use it). Terms not listed can be deleted.
            // AdminController.DeleteTerm enforces the same rules on the server.
            ViewBag.TermDeleteBlockers = FindTermDeleteBlockers(db, terms);
            return View(terms);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Adds a term. startDate / endDate (yyyy-MM-dd) are saved with it; both may be left out
        /// (the basic form used without JavaScript only sends the name), but not just one of them.
        /// </summary>
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult AddTerm(string name, string startDate, string endDate)
        {
            name = (name ?? string.Empty).Trim();
            if (name.Length == 0) TempData["Error"] = "Enter a term name.";
            else if (name.Length > 80) TempData["Error"] = "Term name must be 80 characters or fewer.";
            else
            {
                var db = new MongoDbContext();
                var existingTerm = db.Terms.Find(t => t.Name.ToLower() == name.ToLower()).FirstOrDefault();

                if (existingTerm != null) TempData["Error"] = "That term already exists.";
                else
                {
                    DateTime? start, end;
                    var dateError = CheckTermDates(db, null, name, startDate, endDate, out start, out end);
                    if (dateError != null) TempData["Error"] = "The term was not added. " + dateError;
                    else
                    {
                        db.Terms.InsertOne(new AcademicTerm
                        {
                            Id = "t-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0, 8),
                            Name = name,
                            IsCurrent = false,
                            StartDate = start,
                            EndDate = end
                        });
                        TempData["Message"] = "Term added: " + name + ".";
                    }
                }
            }
            return RedirectToAction("Terms");
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Saves an edited term: its name (semester and academic year) and its dates.
        /// The name cannot change once courses use the term, because courses refer to their term by name.
        /// </summary>
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult EditTerm(string id, string name, string startDate, string endDate)
        {
            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            try
            {
                var target = string.IsNullOrEmpty(id) ? null : db.Terms.Find(t => t.Id == id).FirstOrDefault();
                if (target == null) { TempData["Error"] = "That term no longer exists."; return RedirectToAction("Terms"); }

                name = (name ?? string.Empty).Trim();
                if (name.Length == 0) { TempData["Error"] = "The changes were not saved. Choose an academic year and semester."; return RedirectToAction("Terms"); }
                if (name.Length > 80) { TempData["Error"] = "The changes were not saved. Term name must be 80 characters or fewer."; return RedirectToAction("Terms"); }

                var renamed = !string.Equals(name, target.Name, StringComparison.Ordinal);
                if (renamed)
                {
                    var nameKey = name.ToLower();
                    if (db.Terms.Find(t => t.Id != target.Id && t.Name.ToLower() == nameKey).Any())
                    {
                        TempData["Error"] = "The changes were not saved. " + name + " already exists.";
                        return RedirectToAction("Terms");
                    }
                    var used = CoursesUsingTerm(db, target.Name);
                    if (used.Count > 0)
                    {
                        TempData["Error"] = "The changes were not saved. " + target.Name + " is used by " + used.Count +
                            (used.Count == 1 ? " course" : " courses") + " (" + CourseList(used.Select(c => c.Code)) +
                            "), so its semester and academic year cannot change. You can still change its dates.";
                        return RedirectToAction("Terms");
                    }
                }

                DateTime? start, end;
                var dateError = CheckTermDates(db, target.Id, name, startDate, endDate, out start, out end);
                if (dateError != null) { TempData["Error"] = "The changes were not saved. " + dateError; return RedirectToAction("Terms"); }

                var update = Builders<AcademicTerm>.Update.Set(t => t.Name, name);
                update = start.HasValue ? update.Set(t => t.StartDate, start).Set(t => t.EndDate, end)
                                        : update.Unset(t => t.StartDate).Unset(t => t.EndDate);
                if (db.Terms.UpdateOne(t => t.Id == target.Id, update).MatchedCount != 1)
                {
                    TempData["Error"] = "That term no longer exists.";
                    return RedirectToAction("Terms");
                }
                TempData["Message"] = "Term updated: " + name + (start.HasValue ? " (" + TermDate(start.Value) + " to " + TermDate(end.Value) + ")." : ".");
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is MongoException || ex is TimeoutException)
            {
                TempData["Error"] = "The database could not be reached, so the changes may not have been saved.";
            }
            return RedirectToAction("Terms");
        }

        private static readonly Regex TermNamePattern = new Regex(
            @"^\s*(1st Semester|2nd Semester|Summer)(?: Term)?\s*,\s*[SA]\.?\s*Y\.?\s*(\d{4})\s*-\s*(\d{4})\s*$",
            RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);

        /// <summary>"Aug 9, 2027", the same date format the Academic terms page shows.</summary>
        private static string TermDate(DateTime date) => date.ToString("MMM d, yyyy", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

        /// <summary>
        /// Checks a term's dates with the same rules as the Academic terms page, and returns the reason they
        /// cannot be saved (null when they can). Both dates empty means "no dates" and is allowed.
        /// Rules: real yyyy-MM-dd dates; the end date after the start date; when the name has an academic year
        /// (S.Y. 2026-2027) both dates fall within its two calendar years (Jan 1, 2026 to Dec 31, 2027);
        /// and the dates do not overlap another term's dates.
        /// </summary>
        private static string CheckTermDates(MongoDbContext db, string termId, string name, string startText, string endText,
            out DateTime? start, out DateTime? end)
        {
            start = null; end = null;
            startText = (startText ?? string.Empty).Trim();
            endText = (endText ?? string.Empty).Trim();
            if (startText.Length == 0 && endText.Length == 0) return null;
            if (startText.Length == 0 || endText.Length == 0) return "Enter both a start date and an end date.";

            DateTime s, e;
            if (!DateTime.TryParseExact(startText, "yyyy-MM-dd", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, DateTimeStyles.None, out s) ||
                !DateTime.TryParseExact(endText, "yyyy-MM-dd", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, DateTimeStyles.None, out e))
                return "Enter the dates as calendar dates.";
            if (e <= s) return "The end date must be later than the start date.";

            var m = TermNamePattern.Match(name ?? string.Empty);
            if (m.Success)
            {
                var min = new DateTime(int.Parse(m.Groups[2].Value), 1, 1);
                var max = new DateTime(int.Parse(m.Groups[3].Value), 12, 31);
                if (s < min || s > max || e < min || e > max)
                    return "Both dates must fall within A.Y. " + m.Groups[2].Value + "-" + m.Groups[3].Value +
                           " (" + TermDate(min) + " to " + TermDate(max) + ").";
            }

            var clash = db.Terms.Find(t => t.Id != termId && t.StartDate != null && t.EndDate != null).ToList()
                .Where(t => s <= t.EndDate.Value && e >= t.StartDate.Value)
                .OrderBy(t => t.StartDate.Value).FirstOrDefault();
            if (clash != null)
                return "These dates overlap " + clash.Name + " (" + TermDate(clash.StartDate.Value) + " to " + TermDate(clash.EndDate.Value) + ").";

            start = s; end = e;
            return null;
        }

        /// <summary>The courses that use a term (matched by name, case-insensitively); only each course's term and code are read.</summary>
        private static List<Course> CoursesUsingTerm(MongoDbContext db, string termName)
        {
            var key = (termName ?? string.Empty).ToLower();
            return db.Courses.Find(_ => true)
                .Project<Course>(Builders<Course>.Projection.Include(c => c.Term).Include(c => c.Code)).ToList()
                .Where(c => (c.Term ?? string.Empty).ToLower() == key)
                .ToList();
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult SetCurrentTerm(string id)
        {
            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            var chosen = db.Terms.Find(t => t.Id == id).FirstOrDefault();

            if (chosen == null) TempData["Error"] = "That term no longer exists.";
            else
            {
                db.Terms.UpdateMany(_ => true, Builders<AcademicTerm>.Update.Set(t => t.IsCurrent, false));
                db.Terms.UpdateOne(t => t.Id == id, Builders<AcademicTerm>.Update.Set(t => t.IsCurrent, true));
                TempData["Message"] = chosen.Name + " is now the current term.";
            }
            return RedirectToAction("Terms");
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult DeleteTerm(string id)
        {
            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            try
            {
                var target = string.IsNullOrEmpty(id) ? null : db.Terms.Find(t => t.Id == id).FirstOrDefault();
                if (target == null) { TempData["Error"] = "That term no longer exists."; return RedirectToAction("Terms"); }

                string reason;
                if (FindTermDeleteBlockers(db, new List<AcademicTerm> { target }).TryGetValue(target.Id, out reason))
                {
                    TempData["Error"] = target.Name + " cannot be deleted. " + reason;
                    return RedirectToAction("Terms");
                }

                var deleted = db.Terms.DeleteOne(t => t.Id == target.Id && !t.IsCurrent).DeletedCount;
                if (deleted != 1) { TempData["Error"] = target.Name + " was not deleted. It may have just been made current or removed by someone else."; return RedirectToAction("Terms"); }

                // A course could have been created for this term while it was being deleted: put the term back.
                var termKey = (target.Name ?? string.Empty).ToLower();
                if (db.Courses.CountDocuments(c => c.Term.ToLower() == termKey) > 0)
                {
                    db.Terms.InsertOne(target);
                    TempData["Error"] = target.Name + " was not deleted because a course was just created for it.";
                    return RedirectToAction("Terms");
                }

                TempData["Message"] = "Term deleted: " + target.Name + ".";
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is MongoException || ex is TimeoutException)
            {
                TempData["Error"] = "The database could not be reached, so the term may not have been deleted.";
            }
            return RedirectToAction("Terms");
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Terms that cannot be deleted, with the reason. Courses refer to a term by its name (case-insensitive),
        /// and grades, grade history and notifications belong to courses, so a term without courses has no records.
        /// </summary>
        private static Dictionary<string, string> FindTermDeleteBlockers(MongoDbContext db, List<AcademicTerm> terms)
        {
            var reasons = new Dictionary<string, string>();
            if (terms.Count == 0) return reasons;

            // Only each course's term and code are read; matching is done here because names are compared case-insensitively.
            var keys = new HashSet<string>(terms.Select(t => (t.Name ?? string.Empty).ToLower()));
            var coursesByTerm = db.Courses.Find(_ => true)
                .Project<Course>(Builders<Course>.Projection.Include(c => c.Term).Include(c => c.Code)).ToList()
                .Where(c => keys.Contains((c.Term ?? string.Empty).ToLower()))
                .GroupBy(c => (c.Term ?? string.Empty).ToLower())
                .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.ToList());

            foreach (var t in terms)
            {
                List<Course> used;
                if (coursesByTerm.TryGetValue((t.Name ?? string.Empty).ToLower(), out used) && used.Count > 0)
                    reasons[t.Id] = "It is used by " + used.Count + (used.Count == 1 ? " course" : " courses")
                        + " (" + CourseList(used.Select(c => c.Code)) + "). Archive it instead.";
                else if (t.IsCurrent)
                    reasons[t.Id] = "It is the term in use. Make another term current first.";
            }
            return reasons;
        }

        private bool IsMe(User target) => string.Equals(target.StudentNo, User.Identity.Name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        private static FilterDefinition<GradeRecord> GradedRecordsOf(List<string> userIds)
        {
            return Builders<GradeRecord>.Filter.In(g => g.StudentId, userIds)
                & Builders<GradeRecord>.Filter.ElemMatch(g => g.Scores, s => s.Score != null);
        }

        private static Dictionary<string, string> FindDeleteBlockers(MongoDbContext db, List<string> userIds)
        {
            var reasons = new Dictionary<string, List<string>>();
            Action<string, string> add = (userId, text) => {
                if (!reasons.TryGetValue(userId, out var list)) reasons[userId] = list = new List<string>();
                list.Add(text);
            };

            if (userIds.Count > 0)
            {
                var owned = db.Courses.Find(Builders<Course>.Filter.In(c => c.FacultyId, userIds)).ToList();
                foreach (var group in owned.GroupBy(c => c.FacultyId))
                    add(group.Key, "They own " + group.Count() + " course(s) (" + CourseList(group.Select(c => c.Code)) + ").");

                var graded = db.Grades.Find(GradedRecordsOf(userIds)).ToList();
                if (graded.Count > 0)
                {
                    var courseIds = graded.Select(g => g.CourseId).Distinct().ToList();
                    var codes = db.Courses.Find(Builders<Course>.Filter.In(c => c.Id, courseIds)).ToList().ToDictionary(c => c.Id, c => c.Code);
                    foreach (var group in graded.GroupBy(g => g.StudentId))
                    {
                        var names = group.Select(g => g.CourseId).Distinct().Select(cid => codes.ContainsKey(cid) ? codes[cid] : "removed course");
                        add(group.Key, "They have recorded grades in " + group.Select(g => g.CourseId).Distinct().Count() + " course(s) (" + CourseList(names) + ").");
                    }
                }

                var withHistory = db.Snapshots.Distinct(s => s.StudentId, Builders<ScoreSnapshot>.Filter.In(s => s.StudentId, userIds)).ToList();
                foreach (var userId in withHistory)
                    if (!reasons.ContainsKey(userId)) add(userId, "They have a saved grade history.");
            }

            return reasons.ToDictionary(r => r.Key, r => string.Join(" ", r.Value) + " Disable the account instead.");
        }

        private static string LastAdministratorReason(User target, long otherActiveAdministrators)
        {
            if (target.Role == Roles.Administrator && otherActiveAdministrators < 1)
                return "It is the last active administrator account.";
            return null;
        }

        private static string CourseList(IEnumerable<string> codes)
        {
            var list = codes.Where(c => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(c)).Distinct().OrderBy(c => c).ToList();
            if (list.Count == 0) return "unnamed";
            if (list.Count <= 3) return string.Join(", ", list);
            return string.Join(", ", list.Take(3)) + " and " + (list.Count - 3) + " more";
        }
    }
}

FILE: GradeWise\Controllers\FacultyController.cs

using GradeWise.Data;
using GradeWise.Models;
using GradeWise.Services;
using MongoDB.Driver;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Web.Mvc;

namespace GradeWise.Controllers
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Faculty module: courses, enrollment, grading categories and score entry.
    /// A faculty member can only open the courses they own (the service checks this on every call).
    /// All changes are POST with an anti-forgery token and live in memory (SampleData).
    /// </summary>
    [Authorize(Roles = Roles.Faculty)]
    public class FacultyController : Controller
    {
        // ---------- My courses ----------

        // GET: /Faculty
        public ActionResult Index()
        {
            return View(CourseService.GetCourseList(CurrentFacultyId()));
        }

        // GET: /Faculty/CreateCourse
        public ActionResult CreateCourse()
        {
            return View(CourseService.NewCourseForm());
        }

        // POST: /Faculty/CreateCourse
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult CreateCourse(string code, string name, string section, string term)
        {
            List<string> errors;
            var id = CourseService.CreateCourse(CurrentFacultyId(), code, name, section, term, out errors);

            if (id == null)
            {
                var form = CourseService.NewCourseForm();
                form.Code = code;
                form.Name = name;
                form.Section = section;
                form.Term = term;
                form.Errors = errors;
                return View(form);
            }

            TempData["Message"] = "Course created. Next, set its grading categories and enroll students.";
            return RedirectToAction("Categories", new { id = id });
        }

        // ---------- One course: score entry ----------

        // GET: /Faculty/Course/{id}
        public ActionResult Course(string id, string tab)
        {
            var model = CourseService.GetDetail(id, CurrentFacultyId(), null, tab);
            if (model == null) return HttpNotFound();

            return View(model);
        }

        // POST: /Faculty/SetScope/{id}
        // Faculty choose which numbers the course reflects. Students see the same numbers.
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult SetScope(string id, string scope)
        {
            var facultyId = CurrentFacultyId();
            if (CourseService.GetDetail(id, facultyId, null) == null) return HttpNotFound();

            if (!CourseService.SetReflectedScope(id, facultyId, scope)) return HttpNotFound();

            TempData["Message"] = "Now showing " + GradeScopes.Label(scope) + " numbers.";
            return RedirectToAction("Course", new { id = id });   // no tab: opens on the new scope
        }

        // POST: /Faculty/EditCourse/{id}
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult EditCourse(string id, string code, string name, string section, string term)
        {
            var facultyId = CurrentFacultyId();
            if (CourseService.GetDetail(id, facultyId, null) == null) return HttpNotFound();

            List<string> errors;
            if (!CourseService.UpdateCourse(id, facultyId, code, name, section, term, out errors))
            {
                // Go back to the course; the window opens again by itself with the problems and what was typed.
                TempData["EditCourseErrors"] = errors;
                TempData["EditCourseCode"] = code ?? string.Empty;
                TempData["EditCourseName"] = name ?? string.Empty;
                TempData["EditCourseSection"] = section;
                TempData["EditCourseTerm"] = term ?? string.Empty;
                return RedirectToAction("Course", new { id = id });
            }

            TempData["Message"] = "Course updated.";
            return RedirectToAction("Course", new { id = id });
        }

        // GET: /Faculty/Analytics/{id}?scope=midterm|final-term|final-grade  (no scope = the course's own scope)
        public ActionResult Analytics(string id, string scope)
        {
            var model = ReportService.GetAnalytics(id, CurrentFacultyId(), scope);
            if (model == null) return HttpNotFound();

            return View(model);
        }

        // GET: /Faculty/ExportCsv/{id}?scope=midterm|final-term|final-grade  (no scope = the course's own scope)
        public ActionResult ExportCsv(string id, string scope)
        {
            string fileName;
            var csv = ReportService.BuildClassCsv(id, CurrentFacultyId(), scope, out fileName);
            if (csv == null) return HttpNotFound();

            // The UTF-8 marker at the start makes Excel read names with accents correctly.
            var bytes = new UTF8Encoding(true).GetPreamble().Concat(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(csv)).ToArray();
            return File(bytes, "text/csv", fileName);
        }

        // POST: /Faculty/SaveScores/{id}
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult SaveScores(string id)
        {
            var facultyId = CurrentFacultyId();
            if (CourseService.GetDetail(id, facultyId, null) == null) return HttpNotFound();

            List<string> errors;
            if (!CourseService.SaveScores(id, facultyId, key => Request.Form[key], out errors))
            {
                // Show the page again with what was typed and the problems, nothing was saved.
                var model = CourseService.GetDetail(id, facultyId, key => Request.Form[key], Request.Form["tab"]);
                if (model == null) return HttpNotFound();
                model.Errors = errors;
                return View("Course", model);
            }

            TempData["Message"] = "Scores saved.";
            return RedirectToAction("Course", new { id = id, tab = CourseService.NormalizeTab(Request.Form["tab"]) });
        }

        // ---------- Individual assessment score entry ----------
        public ActionResult Assessment(string id, string category, string assessment)
        {
            var model = CourseService.GetAssessmentScores(id, CurrentFacultyId(), category, assessment);
            if (model == null) return HttpNotFound();
            return View(model);
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult SaveAssessment(string id, string category, string assessment)
        {
            List<string> errors;
            if (!CourseService.SaveAssessmentScores(id, CurrentFacultyId(), category, assessment, key => Request.Form[key], out errors))
            {
                var model = CourseService.GetAssessmentScores(id, CurrentFacultyId(), category, assessment);
                if (model == null) return HttpNotFound();
                model.Errors = errors;

                // Show what was typed again (name, highest possible score and the score boxes).
                var typedName = Request.Form[CourseService.AssessmentNameField];
                var typedMax = Request.Form[CourseService.AssessmentMaxField];
                if (typedName != null) model.EditName = typedName;
                if (typedMax != null) model.EditMax = typedMax;
                foreach (var row in model.Rows)
                {
                    var typed = Request.Form[CourseService.AssessmentFieldName(row.StudentId)];
                    if (typed != null) row.Score = typed;
                }
                return View("Assessment", model);
            }
            TempData["Message"] = "Assessment scores saved.";
            return RedirectToAction("Course", new { id = id, tab = CourseService.TabOfCategory(id, CurrentFacultyId(), category) });
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult AddAssessment(string id, string category, string name, string maxScore)
        {
            var facultyId = CurrentFacultyId();
            string error;
            if (!CourseService.AddAssessment(id, facultyId, category, name, maxScore, out error)) TempData["Error"] = error;
            else TempData["Message"] = "Column added to " + category + ". Enter its highest possible score and the scores in the class record.";
            return RedirectToAction("Course", new { id = id, tab = CourseService.TabOfCategory(id, facultyId, category) });
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult RemoveAssessment(string id, string category, string assessment)
        {
            var facultyId = CurrentFacultyId();
            if (!CourseService.RemoveAssessment(id, facultyId, category, assessment)) TempData["Error"] = "The column could not be removed. Each category must keep at least one column.";
            else TempData["Message"] = "Column removed along with its scores.";
            return RedirectToAction("Course", new { id = id, tab = CourseService.TabOfCategory(id, facultyId, category) });
        }

        // ---------- Enrollment ----------

        // GET: /Faculty/Enroll/{id}
        public ActionResult Enroll(string id)
        {
            var model = CourseService.GetEnrollment(id, CurrentFacultyId());
            if (model == null) return HttpNotFound();

            return View(model);
        }

        // POST: /Faculty/EnrollStudents/{id}
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult EnrollStudents(string id)
        {
            var facultyId = CurrentFacultyId();
            if (CourseService.GetEnrollment(id, facultyId) == null) return HttpNotFound();

            var chosen = Request.Form.GetValues("studentIds") ?? new string[0];

            string error;
            var added = CourseService.Enroll(id, facultyId, chosen, out error);
            if (added == 0) TempData["Error"] = error;
            else TempData["Message"] = added == 1 ? "1 student enrolled." : added + " students enrolled.";

            return RedirectToAction("Enroll", new { id = id });
        }

        // POST: /Faculty/Unenroll/{id}
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult Unenroll(string id, string studentId)
        {
            var facultyId = CurrentFacultyId();
            if (CourseService.GetEnrollment(id, facultyId) == null) return HttpNotFound();

            var removed = CourseService.Unenroll(id, facultyId, studentId);
            if (removed == null) TempData["Error"] = "That student is not enrolled in this course.";
            else TempData["Message"] = removed + " was removed from the course along with their scores.";

            return RedirectToAction("Enroll", new { id = id });
        }

        // ---------- Categories and weights ----------

        // GET: /Faculty/Categories/{id}
        public ActionResult Categories(string id)
        {
            var model = CourseService.GetCategories(id, CurrentFacultyId());
            if (model == null) return HttpNotFound();

            return View(model);
        }

        // POST: /Faculty/Categories/{id}
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult Categories(string id, FormCollection form)
        {
            var facultyId = CurrentFacultyId();
            if (CourseService.GetCategories(id, facultyId) == null) return HttpNotFound();

            var originals = form.GetValues("originals") ?? new string[0];
            var names = form.GetValues("names") ?? new string[0];
            var periods = form.GetValues("periods") ?? new string[0];
            var weights = form.GetValues("weights") ?? new string[0];
            var groups = form.GetValues("groups") ?? new string[0];

            List<string> errors;
            if (!CourseService.SaveCategories(id, facultyId, originals, names, periods, weights, groups, out errors))
            {
                var model = CourseService.EchoCategories(id, facultyId, originals, names, periods, weights, groups, errors);
                if (model == null) return HttpNotFound();
                return View(model);
            }

            TempData["Message"] = "Grading categories saved.";
            return RedirectToAction("Course", new { id = id });
        }

        // ---------- helpers ----------

        /// <summary>Id of the signed-in faculty member (looked up by sign-in name, like the rest of the app).</summary>
        private string CurrentFacultyId()
        {
            try
            {
                var db = new MongoDbContext();
                var identityName = User.Identity.Name.ToLower();
                var me = db.Users.Find(u => u.StudentNo.ToLower() == identityName || u.Email.ToLower() == identityName).FirstOrDefault();
                return me == null ? null : me.Id;
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                return null;
            }
        }
    }
}

using System.Web.Mvc;
using GradeWise.Models;

namespace GradeWise.Controllers
{
    /// <summary>The default route. It has no page of its own; it only sends people where they belong.</summary>
    public class HomeController : Controller
    {
        public ActionResult Index()
        {
            if (!User.Identity.IsAuthenticated)
            {
                return RedirectToAction("Login", "Account");
            }

            var role = User.IsInRole(Roles.Administrator) ? Roles.Administrator
                     : User.IsInRole(Roles.Faculty) ? Roles.Faculty
                     : Roles.Student;

            return RedirectToAction("Index", AccountController.DashboardController(role));
        }
    }
}

FILE: GradeWise\Controllers\NotificationsController.cs
================================================================================
using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Web.Mvc;
using GradeWise.Data;
using GradeWise.Models;
using GradeWise.Services;
using MongoDB.Driver;

namespace GradeWise.Controllers
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The student's bell. The student id always comes from the signed-in account, never from the
    /// request, and every service call is limited to that student.
    /// </summary>
    [Authorize(Roles = Roles.Student)]
    public class NotificationsController : Controller
    {
        // Drawn by the layout: @Html.Action("Bell", "Notifications")
        [ChildActionOnly]
        public ActionResult Bell()
        {
            try
            {
                var me = CurrentStudentUser();
                if (me == null) return new EmptyResult();

                // One query instead of two: a student keeps at most MaxPerStudent messages, so the
                // unread count can be taken from the same list. Only the newest ones are shown.
                var all = NotificationService.ListFor(me.Id, NotificationService.MaxPerStudent);
                var model = new NotificationBellViewModel
                {
                    Items = all.Take(NotificationService.DefaultListLimit).ToList(),
                    Unread = all.Count(n => !n.IsRead)
                };
                return PartialView(model);
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                // A database problem must not break every page, so the bell just does not appear.
                return new EmptyResult();
            }
        }

        // POST: /Notifications/Read
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult Read(string id)
        {
            return Run(me => NotificationService.MarkRead(id, me.Id));
        }

        // POST: /Notifications/Unread
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult Unread(string id)
        {
            return Run(me => NotificationService.MarkUnread(id, me.Id));
        }

        // POST: /Notifications/ReadAll
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult ReadAll()
        {
            return Run(me =>
            {
                NotificationService.MarkAllRead(me.Id);
                return true;
            });
        }

        // POST: /Notifications/Delete
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult Delete(string id)
        {
            return Run(me => NotificationService.Delete(id, me.Id));
        }

        // POST: /Notifications/DeleteAll
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public ActionResult DeleteAll()
        {
            return Run(me =>
            {
                NotificationService.DeleteAll(me.Id);
                return true;
            });
        }

        // ---------- helpers ----------

        /// <summary>Runs one change for the signed-in student and answers { ok, unread }.</summary>
        private ActionResult Run(Func<User, bool> change)
        {
            try
            {
                var me = CurrentStudentUser();
                if (me == null) return Json(new { ok = false, unread = 0 });

                var ok = change(me);
                return Json(new { ok = ok, unread = NotificationService.UnreadCount(me.Id) });
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                return Json(new { ok = false, unread = 0 });
            }
        }

        private User CurrentStudentUser()
        {
            // Global.asax already found the signed-in account for this request.
            var cached = HttpContext.Items["gw.user"] as User;
            if (cached != null) return cached;

            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            var identityName = User.Identity.Name.ToLower();
            return db.Users.Find(u => u.StudentNo.ToLower() == identityName || u.Email.ToLower() == identityName).FirstOrDefault();
        }
    }

using System;
using System.Web.Mvc;
using GradeWise.Data;
using GradeWise.Models;
using GradeWise.Services;
using MongoDB.Driver;

namespace GradeWise.Controllers
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Student dashboard. A student only ever sees their own scores: the id comes from the
    /// signed-in account, never from the address, and the course must be one they are enrolled in.
    /// </summary>
    [Authorize(Roles = Roles.Student)]
    public class StudentController : Controller
    {
        // GET: /Student  or  /Student?id={courseId}
        public ActionResult Index(string id)
        {
            var me = CurrentStudentUser();
            if (me == null) return new HttpUnauthorizedResult();

            var model = StudentService.GetCourseList(me.Id);
            model.StudentNo = me.StudentNo;
            return View(model);
        }

        // GET: /Student/Course/{courseId}  (one course: scores, progress history and class comparison)
        public ActionResult Course(string id)
        {
            var me = CurrentStudentUser();
            if (me == null) return new HttpUnauthorizedResult();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(id)) return RedirectToAction("Index");

            var model = StudentService.GetDashboard(me.Id, id, me);
            if (!model.HasCourse) return RedirectToAction("Index");
            return View(model);
        }

        // GET: /Student/Summary  or  /Student/Summary/{courseId}  (printable page)
        public ActionResult Summary(string id)
        {
            var me = CurrentStudentUser();
            if (me == null) return new HttpUnauthorizedResult();

            return View(StudentService.GetDashboard(me.Id, id, me));
        }

        // GET: /Student/WhatIf  or  /Student/WhatIf/{courseId}
        public ActionResult WhatIf(string id)
        {
            var me = CurrentStudentUser();
            if (me == null) return new HttpUnauthorizedResult();

            var model = StudentService.GetWhatIf(me.Id, id);
            model.StudentNo = me.StudentNo;
            return View(model);
        }

        // ---------- helpers ----------

        private User CurrentStudentUser()
        {
            // Global.asax already found the signed-in account for this request.
            var cached = HttpContext.Items["gw.user"] as User;
            if (cached != null) return cached;

            try
            {
                var db = new MongoDbContext();
                var identityName = User.Identity.Name.ToLower();
                return db.Users.Find(u => u.StudentNo.ToLower() == identityName || u.Email.ToLower() == identityName).FirstOrDefault();
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                return null;
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Configuration;
using MongoDB.Driver;
using GradeWise.Models;

namespace GradeWise.Data
{
    public class MongoDbContext
    {
        // One MongoClient (and one connection pool) for the whole app. The driver is built to be shared
        // and is thread-safe, so every "new MongoDbContext()" just reuses it. Do not dispose it.
        private static readonly Lazy<IMongoDatabase> SharedDatabase = new Lazy<IMongoDatabase>(() =>
        {
            var settings = MongoClientSettings.FromConnectionString(
                ConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings["MongoConnection"].ConnectionString);

            // Keep a few connections open, so a click after a quiet moment does not wait for a new
            // secure connection to Atlas to be set up.
            settings.MinConnectionPoolSize = 3;
            settings.MaxConnectionIdleTime = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30);

            // If Atlas cannot be reached, say so after 10 seconds instead of 30.
            settings.ServerSelectionTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10);

            return new MongoClient(settings).GetDatabase("GradeWiseDb");
        }, System.Threading.LazyThreadSafetyMode.PublicationOnly);   // a failed start is retried, not remembered

        private readonly IMongoDatabase _database;

        public MongoDbContext()
        {
            _database = SharedDatabase.Value;
        }

        // Exposing your collections so your controllers/services can query them
        public IMongoCollection<User> Users => _database.GetCollection<User>("Users");
        public IMongoCollection<Course> Courses => _database.GetCollection<Course>("Courses");
        public IMongoCollection<GradeRecord> Grades => _database.GetCollection<GradeRecord>("Grades");
        public IMongoCollection<AcademicTerm> Terms => _database.GetCollection<AcademicTerm>("Terms");
        public IMongoCollection<ScoreSnapshot> Snapshots => _database.GetCollection<ScoreSnapshot>("Snapshots");
        public IMongoCollection<Notification> Notifications => _database.GetCollection<Notification>("Notifications");
    }
}

FILE: GradeWise\Data\MongodbSeeder.cs
================================================================================
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Configuration;
using System.Linq;
using GradeWise.Helpers;
using GradeWise.Models;
using MongoDB.Driver;

namespace GradeWise.Data
{
    public static class MongoDbSeeder
    {
        // The demo accounts and their demo passwords (see SampleData).
        private static readonly Dictionary<string, string> DemoPasswords =
            new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            {
                { "admin", "Admin@123" },
                { "faculty", "Faculty@123" },
                { "2026-0001", "Student@123" },
                { "2026-0002", "Student@123" },
                { "2026-0003", "Student@123" }
            };

        public static void RestoreDemoPasswords()
        {
            var wanted = ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["RestoreDemoPasswords"];
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(wanted)) return;

            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            var names = wanted.Split(new[] { ',', ';', ' ' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);

            foreach (var raw in names)
            {
                var loginId = raw.Trim();

                string password;
                if (!DemoPasswords.TryGetValue(loginId, out password)) continue;

                var lower = loginId.ToLower();
                var user = db.Users.Find(u => u.StudentNo.ToLower() == lower).FirstOrDefault();
                if (user == null) continue;

                string salt;
                int iterations;
                var hash = PasswordHelper.CreateHash(password, out salt, out iterations);

                db.Users.UpdateOne(
                    u => u.Id == user.Id,
                    Builders<User>.Update
                        .Set(u => u.PasswordHash, hash)
                        .Set(u => u.Salt, salt)
                        .Set(u => u.PasswordIterations, iterations)
                        .Set(u => u.MustChangePassword, false)
                        .Set(u => u.IsActive, true));
            }
        }

        public static void Initialize()
        {
            var db = new MongoDbContext();

            var userCount = db.Users.CountDocuments(Builders<User>.Filter.Empty);
            if (userCount == 0)
            {
                db.Users.InsertMany(SampleData.Users);
            }

            var courseCount = db.Courses.CountDocuments(Builders<Course>.Filter.Empty);
            if (courseCount == 0)
            {
                db.Courses.InsertMany(SampleData.Courses);
            }

            var gradeCount = db.Grades.CountDocuments(Builders<GradeRecord>.Filter.Empty);
            if (gradeCount == 0)
            {
                db.Grades.InsertMany(SampleData.Grades);
            }

            var termCount = db.Terms.CountDocuments(Builders<AcademicTerm>.Filter.Empty);
            if (termCount == 0)
            {
                db.Terms.InsertMany(SampleData.Terms);
            }

            var snapshotCount = db.Snapshots.CountDocuments(Builders<ScoreSnapshot>.Filter.Empty);
            if (snapshotCount == 0)
            {
                db.Snapshots.InsertMany(SampleData.Snapshots);
            }

            EnsureIndexes(db);
        }

        private static void EnsureIndexes(MongoDbContext db)
        {
            // Grades are read per course and per student.
            try
            {
                var keys = Builders<GradeRecord>.IndexKeys
                    .Ascending(g => g.CourseId)
                    .Ascending(g => g.StudentId);
                db.Grades.Indexes.CreateOne(new CreateIndexModel<GradeRecord>(keys));
            }
            catch (System.Exception) { }

            // Progress history is read per course and student, in time order.
            try
            {
                var keys = Builders<ScoreSnapshot>.IndexKeys
                    .Ascending(s => s.CourseId)
                    .Ascending(s => s.StudentId)
                    .Ascending(s => s.TakenAt);
                db.Snapshots.Indexes.CreateOne(new CreateIndexModel<ScoreSnapshot>(keys));
            }
            catch (System.Exception) { }

            // FIX: Every page looks the signed-in account up by its sign-in name. 
            // Enforce Unique constraints to prevent duplicate users.
            try
            {
                var indexOptions = new CreateIndexOptions { Unique = true };

                db.Users.Indexes.CreateOne(new CreateIndexModel<User>(
                    Builders<User>.IndexKeys.Ascending(u => u.StudentNo), indexOptions));

                db.Users.Indexes.CreateOne(new CreateIndexModel<User>(
                    Builders<User>.IndexKeys.Ascending(u => u.Email), indexOptions));
            }
            catch (System.Exception)
            {
                // If this fails, duplicate users exist in the DB. Delete them in Compass and restart.
            }

            // Notifications are listed per student, newest first, so index them that way.
            try
            {
                var keys = Builders<Notification>.IndexKeys
                    .Ascending(n => n.StudentId)
                    .Descending(n => n.CreatedAtUtc);
                db.Notifications.Indexes.CreateOne(new CreateIndexModel<Notification>(keys));
            }
            catch (System.Exception) { }
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace GradeWise.Data

    /// <summary>
    /// In-memory demo data. Everything the app shows or changes lives here until a real
    /// database is added later. Restarting the site resets it to the values below.
    ///
    /// Demo logins:  admin / Admin@123   faculty / Faculty@123
    ///               2026-0001, 2026-0002, 2026-0003 / Student@123
