    public static class SampleData
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Lock this while reading or changing the lists below. Several requests can run at the
        /// same time and a List is not safe to change while another request reads it.
        /// </summary>
        public static readonly object Sync = new object();

        /// <summary>Finds a user by student number / username (not case sensitive).</summary>
        public static User FindByLogin(string loginId)
        {
            lock (Sync)
            {
                return Users.FirstOrDefault(u => string.Equals(u.StudentNo, loginId, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
            }
        }

        /// <summary>Finds a user by student number / username or by email (not case sensitive).</summary>
        public static User FindByLoginOrEmail(string value)
        {
            lock (Sync)
            {
                return Users.FirstOrDefault(u =>
                    string.Equals(u.StudentNo, value, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    string.Equals(u.Email, value, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
            }
        }

        {
            new AcademicTerm { Id = "t-2025-2", Name = "2nd Semester, S.Y. 2025-2026", IsCurrent = false },
            new AcademicTerm { Id = "t-2026-1", Name = "1st Semester, S.Y. 2026-2027", IsCurrent = true },
            new AcademicTerm { Id = "t-2026-2", Name = "2nd Semester, S.Y. 2026-2027", IsCurrent = false }

        /// <summary>
        /// Progress history: a snapshot of each student's standing every time their scores changed.
        /// New ones are added by CourseService when faculty save scores or weights. The demo history
        /// below is built from the scores above, one snapshot per graded category, two weeks apart.
        /// (Keep this field below Courses and Grades: fields are filled in the order they are written.)
        /// </summary>
        public static readonly List<ScoreSnapshot> Snapshots = BuildSnapshots();

        private static List<ScoreSnapshot> BuildSnapshots()
        {
            var list = new List<ScoreSnapshot>();
            var now = DateTime.UtcNow;

            foreach (var course in Courses)
            {
                foreach (var record in Grades.Where(g => g.CourseId == course.Id))
                {
                    var graded = course.Categories
                        .Select(c => record.Scores.FirstOrDefault(s => s.Category == c.Name))
                        .Where(s => s != null && s.Score.HasValue)
                        .ToList();

                    for (var step = 0; step < graded.Count; step++)
                    {
                        var soFar = graded.Take(step + 1).ToList();
                        var result = GradeCalculator.Calculate(course.Categories, soFar);
                        var when = now.AddDays(-14 * (graded.Count - 1 - step)).AddHours(-1);

                        // Each demo snapshot is "one score was entered", so the history can say what changed.
                        var snapshot = HistoryService.Make(course.Id, record.StudentId, when, result);
                        snapshot.Reason = HistoryService.ReasonScores;
                        snapshot.Changes = new List<ScoreChange>
                        {
                            new ScoreChange { Category = graded[step].Category, OldScore = null, NewScore = graded[step].Score }
                        };
                        list.Add(snapshot);
                    }
                }
            }

            return list;
        }
    }

using System;
using System.Web;
using System.Web.Mvc;

namespace GradeWise.Filters
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Tells browsers and intermediary caches not to store the response.
    /// Registered globally in FilterConfig so every MVC page is always fetched fresh.
    /// </summary>
    public class NoCacheAttribute : ActionFilterAttribute
    {
        public override void OnResultExecuting(ResultExecutingContext filterContext)
        {
            var response = filterContext.HttpContext.Response;

            response.Cache.SetCacheability(HttpCacheability.NoCache);
            response.Cache.SetNoStore();
            response.Cache.SetExpires(DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-1));
            response.Cache.SetRevalidation(HttpCacheRevalidation.AllCaches);

            base.OnResultExecuting(filterContext);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Net;
using System.Security.Principal;
using System.Web;
using System.Web.Mvc;
using System.Web.Helpers;
using System.Web.Optimization;
using System.Web.Routing;
using System.Web.Security;
using GradeWise.Data;
using GradeWise.Models;
using MongoDB.Driver;

namespace GradeWise
{
    public class MvcApplication : System.Web.HttpApplication
    {
        protected void Application_Start()
        {
            ServicePointManager.SecurityProtocol |= SecurityProtocolType.Tls12;

            AreaRegistration.RegisterAllAreas();
            FilterConfig.RegisterGlobalFilters(GlobalFilters.Filters);
            RouteConfig.RegisterRoutes(RouteTable.Routes);
            BundleConfig.RegisterBundles(BundleTable.Bundles);

            AntiForgeryConfig.SuppressIdentityHeuristicChecks = true;

            try
            {
                MongoDbSeeder.RestoreDemoPasswords();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Trace.TraceError("Restoring demo passwords failed: " + ex.Message);
            }

            System.Web.Hosting.HostingEnvironment.QueueBackgroundWorkItem(cancellationToken =>
            {
                try
                {
                    MongoDbSeeder.Initialize();
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Trace.TraceError("MongoDB seeding failed: " + ex.Message);
                }
            });
        }

        protected void Application_PostAuthenticateRequest(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            var path = Request.AppRelativeCurrentExecutionFilePath ?? string.Empty;
            if (path.StartsWith("~/Content", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                path.StartsWith("~/Scripts", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                path.StartsWith("~/bundles", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                path.StartsWith("~/favicon", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                return;
            }

            var cookie = Request.Cookies[FormsAuthentication.FormsCookieName];
            if (cookie == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(cookie.Value))
            {
                return;
            }

            FormsAuthenticationTicket ticket;
            try
            {
                ticket = FormsAuthentication.Decrypt(cookie.Value);
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                // FIX: Safely reset the user instead of leaving a half-authenticated state
                Context.User = new GenericPrincipal(new GenericIdentity(string.Empty), new string[0]);
                return;
            }

            if (ticket == null || ticket.Expired)
            {
                // FIX: Safely reset the user if the cookie is expired
                Context.User = new GenericPrincipal(new GenericIdentity(string.Empty), new string[0]);
                return;
            }

            User user = null;
            try
            {
                var db = new MongoDbContext();
                var signedInAs = ticket.Name;

                user = db.Users.Find(u => u.StudentNo == signedInAs).FirstOrDefault()
                    ?? db.Users.Find(u => u.StudentNo.ToLower() == signedInAs.ToLower()).FirstOrDefault();
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                // Ignore DB failure during auth, treat as unauthorized below
            }

            if (user == null || !user.IsActive)
            {
                Context.User = new GenericPrincipal(new GenericIdentity(string.Empty), new string[0]);
                return;
            }

            Context.Items["gw.user"] = user;
            Context.User = new GenericPrincipal(new FormsIdentity(ticket), new[] { user.Role });
        }
    }
}

FILE: GradeWise\Helpers\PasswordHelper.cs

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Security.Cryptography;

namespace GradeWise.Helpers
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Password hashing with PBKDF2 (Rfc2898DeriveBytes) and a random salt per user.
    /// Plain passwords are never stored: only the Base64 hash and salt are kept.
    /// The iteration count is stored per-user so it can be raised later without
    /// invalidating existing accounts.
    /// </summary>
    public static class PasswordHelper
    {
        private const int SaltSize = 16;          // 128-bit salt
        private const int HashSize = 32;          // 256-bit hash
        public const int DefaultIterations = 100000;

        /// <summary>
        /// Hashes a password with a new random salt. Both results are Base64 strings.
        /// Returns the iteration count used so the caller can store it on the user.
        /// </summary>
        public static string CreateHash(string password, out string salt, out int iterations)
        {
            iterations = DefaultIterations;

            var saltBytes = new byte[SaltSize];
            using (var rng = RandomNumberGenerator.Create())
            {
                rng.GetBytes(saltBytes);
            }

            salt = Convert.ToBase64String(saltBytes);
            return Convert.ToBase64String(Derive(password, saltBytes, iterations));
        }

        /// <summary>Back-compat overload: uses DefaultIterations (existing callers keep working).</summary>
        public static string CreateHash(string password, out string salt)
        {
            int ignored;
            return CreateHash(password, out salt, out ignored);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Returns true when the password matches the stored hash and salt. The iteration
        /// count stored on the user is used, so an upgraded iteration count still verifies.
        /// </summary>
        public static bool Verify(string password, string storedHash, string storedSalt, int iterations)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(password) ||
                string.IsNullOrEmpty(storedHash) ||
                string.IsNullOrEmpty(storedSalt))
            {
                return false;
            }

            if (iterations <= 0) iterations = DefaultIterations;

            byte[] expected;
            byte[] saltBytes;
            try
            {
                expected = Convert.FromBase64String(storedHash);
                saltBytes = Convert.FromBase64String(storedSalt);
            }
            catch (FormatException)
            {
                return false;
            }

            var actual = Derive(password, saltBytes, iterations);

            if (actual.Length != expected.Length) return false;
            var diff = 0;
            for (var i = 0; i < actual.Length; i++)
            {
                diff |= actual[i] ^ expected[i];
            }
            return diff == 0;
        }

        /// <summary>Back-compat overload: assumes DefaultIterations.</summary>
        public static bool Verify(string password, string storedHash, string storedSalt)
        {
            return Verify(password, storedHash, storedSalt, DefaultIterations);
        }

        // ----- temporary password generator (unchanged behavior) -----

        private const string UpperLetters = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ";
        private const string LowerLetters = "abcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz";
        private const string Digits = "23456789";

        private static readonly RandomNumberGenerator Rng = RandomNumberGenerator.Create();

        public static string GenerateTemporaryPassword(int length = 10)
        {
            var all = UpperLetters + LowerLetters + Digits;
            var chars = new List<char>
            {
                Pick(UpperLetters),
                Pick(LowerLetters),
                Pick(Digits)
            };
            while (chars.Count < length) chars.Add(Pick(all));

            for (var i = chars.Count - 1; i > 0; i--)
            {
                var j = RandomIndex(i + 1);
                var tmp = chars[i];
                chars[i] = chars[j];
                chars[j] = tmp;
            }
            return new string(chars.ToArray());
        }

        private static char Pick(string set) { return set[RandomIndex(set.Length)]; }

        private static int RandomIndex(int max)
        {
            var buffer = new byte[4];
            var limit = uint.MaxValue - (uint.MaxValue % (uint)max);
            uint value;
            do
            {
                Rng.GetBytes(buffer);
                value = BitConverter.ToUInt32(buffer, 0);
            } while (value >= limit);
            return (int)(value % (uint)max);
        }

        private static byte[] Derive(string password, byte[] salt, int iterations)
        {
            using (var pbkdf2 = new Rfc2898DeriveBytes(password, salt, iterations, HashAlgorithmName.SHA256))
            {
                return pbkdf2.GetBytes(HashSize);
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Net.Mail;

namespace GradeWise.Helpers
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Small input checks shared by the Admin and Account screens, so both apply the same rules.
    /// </summary>
    public static class ValidationHelper
    {
        public const int MaxEmailLength = 254;
        public const int MinPasswordLength = 8;
        public const int MaxPasswordLength = 128;

        /// <summary>True when the text is a plain email address such as name@school.edu.</summary>
        public static bool IsValidEmail(string email)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(email) || email.Length > MaxEmailLength) return false;

            try
            {
                return new MailAddress(email).Address == email;
            }
            catch (FormatException)
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Returns a message when the password is not allowed, or null when it is fine.
        /// Rule: 8 to 128 characters, with at least one letter and at least one number.
        /// </summary>
        public static string PasswordProblem(string password)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(password)) return "Enter a new password.";

            if (password.Length > MaxPasswordLength)
            {
                return "The new password must be " + MaxPasswordLength + " characters or fewer.";
            }

            var hasLetter = false;
            var hasDigit = false;
            foreach (var c in password)
            {
                if (char.IsLetter(c)) hasLetter = true;
                else if (char.IsDigit(c)) hasDigit = true;
            }

            if (password.Length < MinPasswordLength || !hasLetter || !hasDigit)
            {
                return "The new password must be at least " + MinPasswordLength + " characters with at least one letter and one number.";
            }

            return null;
        }
    }
}

using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace GradeWise.Models
{
    /// <summary>One grading category of a course, e.g. { "Quizzes", 20 }.</summary>
    public class GradeCategory
    {
        public string Name { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Percent of its period (0-100). The weights inside one period should total 100.
        /// The category counts for Weight x GradePeriods.Share of the final grade.
        /// </summary>
        public double Weight { get; set; }

        /// <summary>"Midterm" or "Final Term". Documents saved before periods existed have no value and load as Midterm.</summary>
        public string Period { get; set; } = GradePeriods.Midterm;

        /// <summary>Top-level grading group: Class Standing or Exam.</summary>
        public string Group { get; set; } = GradeGroups.ClassStanding;

        /// <summary>Individual assessment columns inside this category (Quiz 1, Quiz 2, etc.).</summary>
        public List<GradeAssessment> Assessments { get; set; } = new List<GradeAssessment>();
    }

    public class GradeAssessment
    {
        public string Id { get; set; }
        public string Name { get; set; }
        public int Order { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Highest possible score (HPS) of this assessment, like the HIGHEST POSSIBLE SCORE row of the class record.</summary>
        public double MaxScore { get; set; } = 100;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The two major grading groups inside a period. Class Standing must total 60 and Exam 40
    /// (100 combined), so the period still totals 100.
    /// </summary>
    public static class GradeGroups
    {
        public const string ClassStanding = "Class Standing";
        public const string Exam = "Exam";

        public static readonly string[] All = { ClassStanding, Exam };

        /// <summary>Anything that is not "Exam" (including a missing value from an old document) is Class Standing.</summary>
        public static string Normalize(string group)
        {
            return string.Equals((group ?? string.Empty).Trim(), Exam, System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? Exam : ClassStanding;
        }

        /// <summary>The weight a group must total inside one period.</summary>
        public static double RequiredTotal(string group)
        {
            return Normalize(group) == Exam ? 40 : 60;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>A course.</summary>
    public class Course
    {
        public string Id { get; set; }

        public string Code { get; set; }

        public string Name { get; set; }

        public string Term { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Section the course is for (e.g. SBIT-3D). Empty until the sections module exists.</summary>
        public string Section { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        /// <summary>Id of the faculty user who owns the course.</summary>
        public string FacultyId { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Which numbers the course reflects: "midterm" (default), "final-term" or "final-grade".
        /// Documents saved before this field existed load as midterm. Read it with GradeScopes.Normalize.
        /// </summary>
        public string ReflectedScope { get; set; } = GradeScopes.Midterm;

        public List<GradeCategory> Categories { get; set; } = new List<GradeCategory>();

        /// <summary>Ids of enrolled student users.</summary>
        public List<string> StudentIds { get; set; } = new List<string>();
    }
}

FILE: GradeWise\Models\GradePeriods.cs
================================================================================
namespace GradeWise.Models
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The two grading periods of a course. Every category belongs to one of them.
    /// Each period's weights add up to 100, and each period counts for <see cref="Share"/> of the final grade.
    /// </summary>
    public static class GradePeriods
    {
        public const string Midterm = "Midterm";
        public const string FinalTerm = "Final Term";

        public static readonly string[] All = { Midterm, FinalTerm };

        /// <summary>Each period is half of the final grade. Change it here, in one place.</summary>
        public const double Share = 0.5;

        /// <summary>Anything that is not "Final Term" (including a missing value from an old document) is Midterm.</summary>
        public static string Normalize(string period)
        {
            return period == FinalTerm ? FinalTerm : Midterm;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The "grade scope" of a course: which numbers students and faculty see.
    /// The keys match the tab keys of the faculty Course page. Anything else means Midterm.
    /// </summary>
    public static class GradeScopes
    {
        public const string Midterm = "midterm";
        public const string FinalTerm = "final-term";
        public const string FinalGrade = "final-grade";

        public static readonly string[] All = { Midterm, FinalTerm, FinalGrade };

        /// <summary>The key when it is valid, otherwise Midterm (so old and bad values are safe).</summary>
        public static string Normalize(string scope)
        {
            return scope == FinalTerm || scope == FinalGrade ? scope : Midterm;
        }

        public static string Label(string scope)
        {
            switch (Normalize(scope))
            {
                case FinalTerm: return "Final Term";
                case FinalGrade: return "Final Grade";
                default: return "Midterm";
            }
        }

        /// <summary>The grading period behind a scope, or null for Final Grade (both periods).</summary>
        public static string PeriodOf(string scope)
        {
            switch (Normalize(scope))
            {
                case FinalTerm: return GradePeriods.FinalTerm;
                case FinalGrade: return null;
                default: return GradePeriods.Midterm;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>True when the category counts in this scope (every category counts in Final Grade).</summary>
        public static bool Includes(string scope, GradeCategory category)
        {
            var period = PeriodOf(scope);
            return period == null || GradePeriods.Normalize(category.Period) == period;
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using GradeWise.Services;

namespace GradeWise.Models
{
    /// <summary>One score that changed in a save: Category, what it was and what it became (null = empty).</summary>
    public class ScoreChange
    {
        public string Category { get; set; }

        public double? OldScore { get; set; }

        public double? NewScore { get; set; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A student's standing in one course at one moment. A new one is kept each time a score
    /// or a weight changes the student's numbers, so the progress history can be drawn later.
    /// Snapshots saved before Reason and Changes existed have neither; they load with empty values.
    /// </summary>
    public class ScoreSnapshot
    {
        public string Id { get; set; }

        public string CourseId { get; set; }

        public string StudentId { get; set; }

        /// <summary>When the snapshot was taken. New snapshots are written in UTC.</summary>
        public DateTime TakenAt { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Weighted average of the graded work at that time (percent). Null when nothing was graded. Kept for old snapshots.</summary>
        public double? Average { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Earned Grade at that time: points collected out of 100 (ungraded work counts as 0).</summary>
        public double Earned { get; set; }

        public double GradedWeight { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Midterm-only Earned Grade (0-100) at that time. Null on snapshots saved before scopes existed.</summary>
        public double? MidtermEarned { get; set; }

        public double? MidtermGradedWeight { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Final-Term-only Earned Grade (0-100) at that time. Null on snapshots saved before scopes existed.</summary>
        public double? FinalTermEarned { get; set; }

        public double? FinalTermGradedWeight { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Why it was taken, e.g. "Scores updated" or "Categories changed". Empty on old snapshots.</summary>
        public string Reason { get; set; }

        /// <summary>The scores that changed in that save. Empty on old snapshots and on category changes.</summary>
        public List<ScoreChange> Changes { get; set; } = new List<ScoreChange>();
    }

        public string Iso { get; set; }

        /// <summary>The date and time as text, e.g. "10/26/2026 3:05 PM" (server time; the page replaces it with the viewer's time).</summary>
        public string Label { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Earned Grade at that moment (points out of 100).</summary>
        public double Earned { get; set; }

    {
        /// <summary>The scope being shown: "midterm", "final-term" or "final-grade".</summary>
        public string Scope { get; set; } = GradeScopes.Midterm;

        public string ScopeLabel { get; set; } = "Midterm";

        /// <summary>The scope students currently see (the course's reflected scope).</summary>
        public string CourseScope { get; set; } = GradeScopes.Midterm;

        public string CourseScopeLabel { get; set; } = "Midterm";

        public string CourseId { get; set; }
        public string Code { get; set; }
        public string Name { get; set; }
        public string Term { get; set; }

        public int StudentCount { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Students with no score at all yet. They are not in any range.</summary>
        public int NotGraded { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Percentage of enrolled students with no score yet (0 to 100), rounded to 2 decimals.</summary>
        public double NotGradedPercent { get; set; }

        public string NotGradedPercentText
        {
            get { return NotGradedPercent.ToString("0.##", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "%"; }
        }

        public double WeightTotal { get; set; }
        public ClassSummary Summary { get; set; }
        public List<DistributionBin> Bins { get; set; } = new List<DistributionBin>();
        public List<DistributionStudent> NotGradedStudents { get; set; } = new List<DistributionStudent>();
        public List<CategoryStat> Categories { get; set; } = new List<CategoryStat>();

        /// <summary>Set by the service: true when the scope has categories and they total 100.</summary>
        public bool WeightsOk { get; set; }

        // ---------- More statistics (all for the scope shown, graded students only) ----------

        /// <summary>The middle Earned Grade. Null when nobody is graded.</summary>
        public double? Median { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Standard deviation of the Earned Grades (how spread out the class is). Null when nobody is graded.</summary>
        public double? StdDev { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Highest minus lowest Earned Grade. Null when nobody is graded.</summary>
        public double? Range { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Graded students at or above the passing line, and below it.</summary>
        public int Passing { get; set; }

        public int Failing { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Percent of graded students who pass. Null when nobody is graded.</summary>
        public double? PassRate { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Final Grade scope only: students marked INC (class standing is fine, Final Term exam still blank).</summary>
        public int Incomplete { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Category scores entered out of the scores the class could have (students x categories).</summary>
        public int ScoresEntered { get; set; }

        public int ScoresExpected { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Percent of possible category scores entered (0 to 100). Null when there is nothing to enter.</summary>
        public double? CompletionPercent { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Weighted average of the Class Standing and of the Exam categories (percent). Null when nothing is graded there.</summary>
        public double? ClassStandingAverage { get; set; }

        public double? ExamAverage { get; set; }

        public int Declined { get; set; }

        public int Unchanged { get; set; }

using System;

namespace GradeWise.Models
{
    /// <summary>The three roles in GradeWise. Stored as plain strings.</summary>
    public static class Roles
    {
        public const string Student = "Student";
        public const string Faculty = "Faculty";
        public const string Administrator = "Administrator";

        public static readonly string[] All = { Administrator, Faculty, Student };

        public static bool IsValid(string role)
        {
            return role == Administrator || role == Faculty || role == Student;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>A user account.</summary>
    public class User
    {
        public string Id { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Student number or username used to sign in. Unique, case-insensitive.</summary>
        public string StudentNo { get; set; }

        public string FullName { get; set; }

        // Name components mirror the Admin > Add user form. FullName remains the display name.
        public string FirstName { get; set; }
        public string MiddleName { get; set; }
        public string LastName { get; set; }
        public string Suffix { get; set; }

        public string Email { get; set; }

        /// <summary>PBKDF2 hash. Never store plain passwords.</summary>
        public string PasswordHash { get; set; }

        public string Salt { get; set; }

        /// <summary>One of the values in <see cref="Roles"/>.</summary>
        public string Role { get; set; }

        /// <summary>False = account disabled by admin; sign-in is refused.</summary>
        public bool IsActive { get; set; } = true;

        // ---------- auth audit fields (required for DB team / Sprint 2) ----------

        /// <summary>When the account was created (UTC). Set once.</summary>
        public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Last successful sign-in (UTC). Null until the first login.</summary>
        public DateTime? LastLoginAt { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// True until the user has changed the temporary password an admin generated.
        /// Sprint 2 will force a change-password screen when this is true.
        /// </summary>
        public bool MustChangePassword { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// PBKDF2 iteration count used to produce PasswordHash. Stored per-user so the
        /// hash can be upgraded later without invalidating old accounts.
        /// </summary>
        public int PasswordIterations { get; set; }
    }

    /// <summary>What the profile modal shows about the signed-in account.</summary>
    public class ProfileInfo
    {
        public string FullName { get; set; }

        public string StudentNo { get; set; }

        public string Email { get; set; }

        public string FirstName { get; set; }
        public string MiddleName { get; set; }
        public string LastName { get; set; }
        public string Suffix { get; set; }

        public string Role { get; set; }
    }
}

// Account > Change your password (Views/Account/ForceChangePassword.cshtml), shown after signing in
// with a temporary password. Client-side help only: show / hide buttons, the password rules ticked off
// while typing, a "passwords match" line, and messages under the fields before the form is sent.
// The server checks everything again (ValidationHelper.PasswordProblem and the match check in
// AccountController.ForceChangePassword); the rules and messages here are the same as there.

(function () {
    var formEl = document.getElementById("gw-forcepw-form");
    if (!(formEl instanceof HTMLFormElement)) { return; }
    var form = formEl;

    /** @param {string} id @returns {HTMLInputElement} */
    function requireInput(id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!(el instanceof HTMLInputElement)) { throw new Error("Change password page: #" + id + " is missing."); }
        return el;
    }
    /** @param {string} id @returns {HTMLElement} */
    function requireElement(id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!el) { throw new Error("Change password page: #" + id + " is missing."); }
        return el;
    }

    var newPw = requireInput("newPassword");
    var confirmPw = requireInput("confirmPassword");
    var newError = requireElement("newPassword-error");
    var confirmError = requireElement("confirmPassword-error");
    var rulesList = requireElement("gw-pw-rules");
    var matchLine = requireElement("gw-pw-match");
    var submitBtn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');

    // the same limits as ValidationHelper (passed in by the page)
    var MIN = parseInt(rulesList.getAttribute("data-min") || "8", 10);
    var MAX = parseInt(rulesList.getAttribute("data-max") || "128", 10);
    // char.IsLetter / char.IsDigit on the server: any Unicode letter / decimal digit.
    // (Built with RegExp so older script targets accept the file; very old browsers fall back to A-Z / 0-9.)
    var LETTER = unicodeClass("\\p{L}", /[A-Za-z]/);
    var DIGIT = unicodeClass("\\p{Nd}", /[0-9]/);

    /**
     * @param {string} pattern  a Unicode property escape
     * @param {RegExp} fallback
     * @returns {RegExp}
     */
    function unicodeClass(pattern, fallback) {
        try { return new RegExp(pattern, "u"); } catch (err) { return fallback; }
    }

    var tried = false;   // after the first Save, messages update while typing
    form.noValidate = true;   // the messages below replace the browser's bubbles (without JavaScript, "required" still works)

    // ---------- show / hide ----------
    var toggles = form.querySelectorAll("[data-password-toggle]");
    for (var t = 0; t < toggles.length; t++) {
        var toggleEl = toggles[t];
        if (toggleEl instanceof HTMLButtonElement) { setUpToggle(toggleEl); }
    }

    /** @param {HTMLButtonElement} toggle */
    function setUpToggle(toggle) {
        var input = document.getElementById(toggle.getAttribute("data-password-toggle") || "");
        if (!(input instanceof HTMLInputElement)) { return; }
        var field = input;
        var iconVisible = toggle.querySelector('[data-icon="visible"]');   // plain eye
        var iconHidden = toggle.querySelector('[data-icon="hidden"]');     // eye with a line through it

        function sync() {
            var visible = field.type === "text";
            if (iconVisible instanceof SVGElement) { iconVisible.style.display = visible ? "block" : "none"; }
            if (iconHidden instanceof SVGElement) { iconHidden.style.display = visible ? "none" : "block"; }
            var label = visible ? "Hide password" : "Show password";
            toggle.setAttribute("aria-pressed", visible ? "true" : "false");
            toggle.setAttribute("aria-label", label);
            toggle.title = label;
        }

        field.type = "password";   // always start hidden
        sync();
        toggle.hidden = false;
        toggle.addEventListener("click", function () {
            // keep the caret where it was
            var start = field.selectionStart, end = field.selectionEnd;
            field.type = field.type === "password" ? "text" : "password";
            sync();
            field.focus();
            if (start !== null && end !== null) { field.setSelectionRange(start, end); }
        });
    }

    // ---------- rules ----------
    /** @param {string} value */
    function rulesFor(value) {
        return {
            length: value.length >= MIN,
            letter: LETTER.test(value),
            number: DIGIT.test(value)
        };
    }

    /**
     * The server's message for a new password, or "" when it is fine (ValidationHelper.PasswordProblem).
     * @param {string} value
     */
    function passwordProblem(value) {
        if (!value) { return "Enter a new password."; }
        if (value.length > MAX) { return "The new password must be " + MAX + " characters or fewer."; }
        var r = rulesFor(value);
        if (!r.length || !r.letter || !r.number) {
            return "The new password must be at least " + MIN + " characters with at least one letter and one number.";
        }
        return "";
    }

    /** The server's message for the confirmation, or "" when it is fine. */
    function confirmProblem() {
        if (!confirmPw.value) { return "Confirm your new password."; }
        if (confirmPw.value !== newPw.value) { return "The new password and its confirmation do not match."; }
        return "";
    }

    /**
     * @param {HTMLInputElement} input
     * @param {HTMLElement} errorEl
     * @param {string} text  "" clears the message
     */
    function showError(input, errorEl, text) {
        errorEl.textContent = text;
        errorEl.hidden = !text;
        input.classList.toggle("gw-input-bad", !!text);
        input.setAttribute("aria-invalid", text ? "true" : "false");
    }

    /** Ticks the rules off while typing; a rule that is still not met is marked only after the first Save. */
    function renderRules() {
        var value = newPw.value;
        /** @type {Record<string, boolean>} */
        var met = rulesFor(value);
        var items = rulesList.querySelectorAll("[data-rule]");
        for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
            var item = items[i];
            var rule = item.getAttribute("data-rule") || "";
            var ok = !!met[rule];
            item.classList.toggle("gw-pw-rule-ok", ok);
            item.classList.toggle("gw-pw-rule-bad", !ok && tried);
            var state = item.querySelector(".gw-sr-only");
            if (!state) {
                state = document.createElement("span");
                state.className = "gw-sr-only";
                item.appendChild(state);
            }
            state.textContent = ok ? " (done)" : " (not yet)";
        }
    }

    /** "Passwords match" / "do not match yet" under the confirmation, once something is typed there. */
    function renderMatch() {
        var c = confirmPw.value;
        if (!c) {
            matchLine.hidden = true;
            matchLine.textContent = "";
            return;
        }
        var same = c === newPw.value;
        matchLine.hidden = false;
        matchLine.textContent = same ? "Passwords match." : "Passwords do not match yet.";
        matchLine.classList.toggle("gw-pw-match-ok", same);
        matchLine.classList.toggle("gw-pw-match-bad", !same);
    }

    function renderErrors() {
        if (!tried) { return; }
        showError(newPw, newError, passwordProblem(newPw.value));
        showError(confirmPw, confirmError, confirmProblem());
    }

    function update() {
        renderRules();
        renderMatch();
        renderErrors();
    }

    newPw.addEventListener("input", update);
    confirmPw.addEventListener("input", update);

    form.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
        tried = true;
        update();
        var bad = passwordProblem(newPw.value) ? newPw : confirmProblem() ? confirmPw : null;
        if (bad) {
            e.preventDefault();
            bad.focus();
            return;
        }
        // send once
        if (submitBtn instanceof HTMLButtonElement) {
            submitBtn.disabled = true;
            submitBtn.textContent = "Saving...";
        }
    });

    update();
})();
