using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using GradeWise.Models;

namespace GradeWise.Services
{
    /// <summary>Result of the weighted-grade formula for one student in one course.</summary>
    public class GradeResult
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Points earned so far = sum of (weight x score / 100) over the graded categories. Ungraded work counts as 0,
        /// so for a whole course (effective weights) this is out of 100, and for one period (CalculatePeriod) too.
        /// </summary>
        public double Earned { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Total weight of the categories that already have a score.</summary>
        public double GradedWeight { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Total weight of all categories in the course (should be 100).</summary>
        public double TotalWeight { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Weight of the categories that are not graded yet.</summary>
        public double RemainingWeight
        {
            get { return Math.Max(0, TotalWeight - GradedWeight); }
        }

        public bool HasGrades
        {
            get { return GradedWeight > 0; }
        }

        /// <summary>Earned points, or null when nothing is graded yet (so reports show a dash, not 0 or 5.00).</summary>
        public double? EarnedOrNull
        {
            get { return HasGrades ? (double?)Earned : null; }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Weighted average of the graded work, as a percent: earned / graded weight x 100.
        /// Null when nothing is graded yet.
        /// </summary>
        public double? Average
        {
            get { return HasGrades ? (double?)(Earned / GradedWeight * 100) : null; }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Average, highest and lowest across a class.</summary>
    public class ClassSummary
    {
        /// <summary>How many students have at least one score.</summary>
        public int Graded { get; set; }

        public double? Average { get; set; }

        public double? Highest { get; set; }

        public double? Lowest { get; set; }
    }

    /// <summary>What a target final grade needs, as worked out by <see cref="GradeCalculator.CheckTarget"/>.</summary>
    public enum TargetStatus
    {
        /// <summary>Every category is already graded, so there is nothing left to simulate.</summary>
        NothingLeft,

        /// <summary>The points already earned meet the target; even a 0 on the rest is enough.</summary>
        Secured,

        /// <summary>The target needs an average between 0 and 100 on the remaining work.</summary>
        Reachable,

        /// <summary>The target needs more than 100 on the remaining work, so it cannot be reached.</summary>
        OutOfReach
    }

    public class TargetResult
    {
        public TargetStatus Status { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Average (percent) needed on the remaining work. Can be 0 or below (secured) or above 100
        /// (out of reach). Null when nothing is left to grade.
        /// </summary>
        public double? Required { get; set; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The one place the grade formula lives, so it can be checked on its own.
    /// The What-If page repeats the same formulas in Scripts/whatif.js and checks itself against this class.
    /// Scores are percentages from 0 to 100; weights are percentages of the final grade.
    /// </summary>
    public static class GradeCalculator
    {
        /// <summary>Tolerance when checking that the weights add up to 100.</summary>
        public const double WeightTolerance = 0.005;

        /// <summary>
        /// The weight a category counts for in the whole course: its weight inside its period x the period's share.
        /// With both periods at 100 and a share of 0.5, the course total is still 100, so the rest of the app is unchanged.
        /// </summary>
        public static double EffectiveWeight(GradeCategory category)
        {
            return category.Weight * GradePeriods.Share;
        }

        /// <summary>Whole-course result. Uses effective weights, so Earned is out of 100.</summary>
        public static GradeResult Calculate(IEnumerable<GradeCategory> categories, IEnumerable<ScoreEntry> scores)
        {
            return Accumulate(categories, scores, EffectiveWeight);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Result for one period only ("Midterm" or "Final Term"), using the raw weights, which total 100 per period.
        /// Earned is then 0-100 for that period.
        /// </summary>
        public static GradeResult CalculatePeriod(IEnumerable<GradeCategory> categories, IEnumerable<ScoreEntry> scores, string period)
        {
            var wanted = GradePeriods.Normalize(period);
            var inPeriod = (categories ?? Enumerable.Empty<GradeCategory>())
                .Where(c => GradePeriods.Normalize(c.Period) == wanted);
            return Accumulate(inPeriod, scores, c => c.Weight);
        }

        private static GradeResult Accumulate(IEnumerable<GradeCategory> categories, IEnumerable<ScoreEntry> scores, Func<GradeCategory, double> weightOf)
        {
            var result = new GradeResult();
            var scoreList = scores == null ? new List<ScoreEntry>() : scores.ToList();

            foreach (var category in categories ?? Enumerable.Empty<GradeCategory>())
            {
                var weight = weightOf(category);
                result.TotalWeight += weight;

                var entry = scoreList.FirstOrDefault(s =>
                    string.Equals(s.Category, category.Name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

                if (entry != null && entry.Score.HasValue)
                {
                    result.GradedWeight += weight;
                    result.Earned += weight * entry.Score.Value / 100.0;
                }
            }

            return result;
        }

        /// <summary>Raw weight total of one period (should be 100 once the period is set up).</summary>
        public static double PeriodTotal(IEnumerable<GradeCategory> categories, string period)
        {
            var wanted = GradePeriods.Normalize(period);
            return (categories ?? Enumerable.Empty<GradeCategory>())
                .Where(c => GradePeriods.Normalize(c.Period) == wanted)
                .Sum(c => c.Weight);
        }

        // ---------- grade scope (Midterm / Final Term / Final Grade) ----------

        /// <summary>Result for a scope: one period with raw weights, or the whole course with effective weights.</summary>
        public static GradeResult CalculateScope(IEnumerable<GradeCategory> categories, IEnumerable<ScoreEntry> scores, string scope)
        {
            var period = GradeScopes.PeriodOf(scope);
            return period == null
                ? Calculate(categories, scores)
                : CalculatePeriod(categories, scores, period);
        }

        /// <summary>The weight a category counts for in a scope (raw inside a period, effective for Final Grade).</summary>
        public static double ScopeWeight(GradeCategory category, string scope)
        {
            return GradeScopes.PeriodOf(scope) == null ? EffectiveWeight(category) : category.Weight;
        }

        /// <summary>The categories that belong to a scope.</summary>
        public static IEnumerable<GradeCategory> ScopeCategories(IEnumerable<GradeCategory> categories, string scope)
        {
            return (categories ?? Enumerable.Empty<GradeCategory>()).Where(c => GradeScopes.Includes(scope, c));
        }

        /// <summary>Weight total of a scope (100 once it is set up).</summary>
        public static double ScopeTotal(IEnumerable<GradeCategory> categories, string scope)
        {
            return ScopeCategories(categories, scope).Sum(c => ScopeWeight(c, scope));
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// True when the scope has categories and they total 100. For Final Grade both periods
        /// must be set and each must total 100.
        /// </summary>
        public static bool ScopeReady(IEnumerable<GradeCategory> categories, string scope)
        {
            var list = (categories ?? Enumerable.Empty<GradeCategory>()).ToList();

            if (GradeScopes.PeriodOf(scope) == null)
            {
                return GradePeriods.All.All(p =>
                    list.Any(c => GradePeriods.Normalize(c.Period) == p) && IsFullWeight(PeriodTotal(list, p)));
            }

            return ScopeCategories(list, scope).Any() && IsFullWeight(ScopeTotal(list, scope));
        }

        /// <summary>Equivalent grade of the points earned (zero-based). Null when nothing is graded, so reports show a dash.</summary>
        public static double? EquivalentFromEarned(GradeResult result)
        {
            return result != null && result.HasGrades ? EquivalentGrade(result.Earned) : null;
        }

        /// <summary>Summarises the students' averages. Students with no scores yet (null) are skipped.</summary>
        public static ClassSummary Summarize(IEnumerable<double?> averages)
        {
            var values = (averages ?? Enumerable.Empty<double?>())
                .Where(a => a.HasValue)
                .Select(a => a.Value)
                .ToList();

            var summary = new ClassSummary { Graded = values.Count };
            if (values.Count > 0)
            {
                summary.Average = values.Average();
                summary.Highest = values.Max();
                summary.Lowest = values.Min();
            }

            return summary;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// What-If: the final grade (percent of the whole course) if the remaining categories get the given scores.
        /// final = earned + sum of (weight x score / 100). Scores are limited to 0-100.
        /// </summary>
        public static double ProjectFinal(double earned, IEnumerable<double> weights, IEnumerable<double> scores)
        {
            var total = earned;
            var weightList = (weights ?? Enumerable.Empty<double>()).ToList();
            var scoreList = (scores ?? Enumerable.Empty<double>()).ToList();

            for (var i = 0; i < weightList.Count && i < scoreList.Count; i++)
            {
                var score = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(100, scoreList[i]));
                total += weightList[i] * score / 100.0;
            }

            return total;
        }

        /// <summary>Tolerance for the target checks, so rounding noise cannot flip a result.</summary>
        public const double TargetTolerance = 0.000001;

        /// <summary>
        /// What-If: the average needed on the remaining work to reach a target final grade.
        /// required = (target - earned) / remaining weight x 100.
        /// </summary>
        public static TargetResult CheckTarget(double target, double earned, double remainingWeight)
        {
            var result = new TargetResult();

            if (remainingWeight <= WeightTolerance)
            {
                result.Status = TargetStatus.NothingLeft;
                return result;
            }

            var required = (target - earned) / remainingWeight * 100.0;
            result.Required = required;

            if (required <= TargetTolerance) result.Status = TargetStatus.Secured;
            else if (required > 100 + TargetTolerance) result.Status = TargetStatus.OutOfReach;
            else result.Status = TargetStatus.Reachable;

            return result;
        }

        // Lower end of each distribution range. The last range runs up to 100.
        private static readonly double[] BinEdges = { 0, 60, 70, 80, 90 };

        private static readonly string[] BinLabels =
        {
            "Below 60", "60 to below 70", "70 to below 80", "80 to below 90", "90 to 100"
        };

        /// <summary>
        /// Counts students per score range. Each average is rounded to 2 decimals first (the same way it is
        /// shown), so the counts always agree with the numbers in the score table. Null (not graded) is skipped.
        /// </summary>
        public static List<DistributionBin> Distribution(IEnumerable<double?> averages)
        {
            var bins = new List<DistributionBin>();
            for (var i = 0; i < BinEdges.Length; i++)
            {
                bins.Add(new DistributionBin
                {
                    Label = BinLabels[i],
                    Min = BinEdges[i],
                    Max = i + 1 < BinEdges.Length ? BinEdges[i + 1] : 100
                });
            }

            foreach (var average in averages ?? Enumerable.Empty<double?>())
            {
                if (!average.HasValue) continue;

                var value = Math.Round(average.Value, 2);
                for (var i = bins.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
                {
                    if (value >= bins[i].Min || i == 0)
                    {
                        bins[i].Count++;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }

            return bins;
        }

        /// <summary>Total effective weight of the course (both periods together). It is 100 when each period totals 100.</summary>
        public static double TotalWeight(IEnumerable<GradeCategory> categories)
        {
            return (categories ?? Enumerable.Empty<GradeCategory>()).Sum(c => EffectiveWeight(c));
        }

        public static bool IsFullWeight(double totalWeight)
        {
            return Math.Abs(totalWeight - 100) < WeightTolerance;
        }

        // Lowest average (percent) for each equivalent grade, highest first. Anything below the last
        // line (64.5) is 5.00 (failed). Lower bounds only, no rounding before the lookup.
        // This is the "INTERVAL RANGES" table of the class record (SBIT3D_CLASSRECORD_ZERO_BASED_GRADING),
        // looked up with VLOOKUP on the unrounded average. The What-If page reads this table from the
        // server, so nothing else needs editing.
        //
        // Boundary checks (average -> equivalent):
        //   100 -> 1.00   96.5 -> 1.00   96.49 -> 1.25   92.5 -> 1.25   92.49 -> 1.50   88.5 -> 1.50
        //   88.49 -> 1.75   84.5 -> 1.75   84.49 -> 2.00   80.5 -> 2.00   80.49 -> 2.25   76.5 -> 2.25
        //   76.49 -> 2.50   72.5 -> 2.50   72.49 -> 2.75   68.5 -> 2.75   68.49 -> 3.00   64.5 -> 3.00
        //   64.49 -> 5.00   0 -> 5.00
        private static readonly double[][] GradeScale =
        {
            new[] { 96.5, 1.00 }, new[] { 92.5, 1.25 }, new[] { 88.5, 1.50 },
            new[] { 84.5, 1.75 }, new[] { 80.5, 2.00 }, new[] { 76.5, 2.25 },
            new[] { 72.5, 2.50 }, new[] { 68.5, 2.75 }, new[] { 64.5, 3.00 }
        };

        /// <summary>Lowest average (percent) that passes (the "PASSED" line of the class record).</summary>
        public const double PassingAverage = 64.5;

        /// <summary>
        /// The class record marks a Final Grade "INC" (incomplete) when the student passed the Midterm and the
        /// Final Term class standing with at least this percent but the Final Term exam is still blank.
        /// The class record uses 65 here, not the 64.5 passing line.
        /// </summary>
        public const double IncompleteThreshold = 65.0;

        /// <summary>True for an exam category (the class record's exam columns). Matches by name, like the rest of the app.</summary>
        public static bool IsExamCategory(GradeCategory category)
        {
            return category != null && category.Name != null
                && category.Name.IndexOf("exam", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Class record rule for the Final Grade: INC when the Midterm grade is at least 65, the Final Term class
        /// standing (every Final Term category that is not an exam, ungraded counted as 0) is at least 65, and
        /// no Final Term exam score has been entered yet. False when the Final Term has no exam category.
        /// </summary>
        public static bool IsIncomplete(IEnumerable<GradeCategory> categories, IEnumerable<ScoreEntry> scores)
        {
            var list = (categories ?? Enumerable.Empty<GradeCategory>()).ToList();
            var scoreList = scores == null ? new List<ScoreEntry>() : scores.ToList();

            var finalTerm = list.Where(c => GradePeriods.Normalize(c.Period) == GradePeriods.FinalTerm).ToList();
            var exams = finalTerm.Where(c => IsExamCategory(c)).ToList();
            if (exams.Count == 0) return false;

            foreach (var exam in exams)
            {
                if (ScoreOf(scoreList, exam.Name).HasValue) return false;
            }

            var standing = finalTerm.Where(c => !IsExamCategory(c)).ToList();
            var standingWeight = standing.Sum(c => c.Weight);
            if (standingWeight <= 0) return false;

            var standingEarned = standing.Sum(c => c.Weight * (ScoreOf(scoreList, c.Name) ?? 0) / 100.0);
            var standingGrade = standingEarned / standingWeight * 100.0;
            var midterm = CalculatePeriod(list, scoreList, GradePeriods.Midterm);

            return Math.Round(midterm.Earned, 6) >= IncompleteThreshold
                && Math.Round(standingGrade, 6) >= IncompleteThreshold;
        }

        private static double? ScoreOf(List<ScoreEntry> scores, string category)
        {
            var entry = scores.FirstOrDefault(s => string.Equals(s.Category, category, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
            return entry == null ? null : entry.Score;
        }

        /// <summary>True when the average is at least the passing average. No average means not passing.</summary>
        public static bool IsPassing(double? average)
        {
            return average.HasValue && Math.Round(average.Value, 6) >= PassingAverage;
        }

        public const double FailingGrade = 5.00;

        /// <summary>Equivalent grade (1.00 to 5.00) for an average percent. Null when there is no average yet.</summary>
        public static double? EquivalentGrade(double? average)
        {
            if (!average.HasValue) return null;

            // Round away floating-point noise so an exact 85 is never read as 84.99999999.
            var value = Math.Round(average.Value, 6);

            foreach (var step in GradeScale)
            {
                if (value >= step[0]) return step[1];
            }

            return FailingGrade;
        }

        /// <summary>The grade table, highest first. The What-If page uses it for its target buttons.</summary>
        public static List<GradeStep> Scale()
        {
            return GradeScale.Select(s => new GradeStep { MinAverage = s[0], Grade = s[1] }).ToList();
        }

        /// <summary>A number written the same way on every computer (dot decimal), for HTML attributes read by JavaScript.</summary>
        public static string Raw(double value)
        {
            return value.ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        }

        /// <summary>Text for showing a grade or weight: two decimals, or a dash when there is no value.</summary>
        public static string Format(double? value)
        {
            return value.HasValue ? value.Value.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "\u2014";
        }
    }
}

FILE: GradeWise\Services\HistoryService.cs

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using GradeWise.Data;
using GradeWise.Models;
using MongoDB.Driver;

namespace GradeWise.Services
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Keeps and reads the progress history backed by MongoDB Atlas.
    /// </summary>
    public static class HistoryService
    {
        public const int MaxPerStudent = 100;

        public const string ReasonScores = "Scores updated";
        public const string ReasonCategories = "Categories changed";

        public const int MaxNamed = 3;

        private const double Same = 0.000000001;

        public static void RecordChange(Course course, string studentId, IEnumerable<ScoreEntry> savedScores,
            DateTime whenUtc, string reason, IList<ScoreChange> changes)
        {
            if (course == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(studentId)) return;
            if (changes == null || changes.Count == 0) return;

            var scoreList = (savedScores ?? new List<ScoreEntry>()).ToList();
            var result = GradeCalculator.Calculate(course.Categories, scoreList);
            var snapshot = Make(course.Id, studentId, whenUtc, result, course.Categories, scoreList);
            snapshot.Reason = string.IsNullOrEmpty(reason) ? ReasonScores : reason;
            snapshot.Changes = changes.ToList();

            Insert(snapshot);
        }

        public static void RecordCategoriesChanged(Course course, string studentId, IEnumerable<ScoreEntry> savedScores, DateTime whenUtc)
        {
            if (course == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(studentId)) return;

            var scoreList = (savedScores ?? new List<ScoreEntry>()).ToList();
            var result = GradeCalculator.Calculate(course.Categories, scoreList);
            var midterm = GradeCalculator.CalculatePeriod(course.Categories, scoreList, GradePeriods.Midterm);
            var finalTerm = GradeCalculator.CalculatePeriod(course.Categories, scoreList, GradePeriods.FinalTerm);

            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            var last = db.Snapshots
                .Find(s => s.CourseId == course.Id && s.StudentId == studentId)
                .SortByDescending(s => s.TakenAt)
                .FirstOrDefault();

            if (last == null && !result.HasGrades) return;

            if (last != null
                && last.MidtermEarned.HasValue && last.FinalTermEarned.HasValue
                && Math.Abs(last.Earned - result.Earned) <= Same
                && Math.Abs(last.MidtermEarned.Value - midterm.Earned) <= Same
                && Math.Abs(last.FinalTermEarned.Value - finalTerm.Earned) <= Same) return;

            var snapshot = Make(course.Id, studentId, whenUtc, result, course.Categories, scoreList);
            snapshot.Reason = ReasonCategories;

            Insert(snapshot);
        }

        public static ScoreSnapshot Make(string courseId, string studentId, DateTime when, GradeResult result,
            IEnumerable<GradeCategory> categories = null, IEnumerable<ScoreEntry> scores = null)
        {
            var snapshot = new ScoreSnapshot
            {
                Id = "s-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0, 8),
                CourseId = courseId,
                StudentId = studentId,
                TakenAt = when,
                Average = result.Average,
                Earned = result.Earned,
                GradedWeight = result.GradedWeight
            };

            if (categories != null && scores != null)
            {
                var scoreList = scores.ToList();
                var midterm = GradeCalculator.CalculatePeriod(categories, scoreList, GradePeriods.Midterm);
                var finalTerm = GradeCalculator.CalculatePeriod(categories, scoreList, GradePeriods.FinalTerm);
                snapshot.MidtermEarned = midterm.Earned;
                snapshot.MidtermGradedWeight = midterm.GradedWeight;
                snapshot.FinalTermEarned = finalTerm.Earned;
                snapshot.FinalTermGradedWeight = finalTerm.GradedWeight;
            }

            return snapshot;
        }

        private static void Insert(ScoreSnapshot snapshot)
        {
            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            db.Snapshots.InsertOne(snapshot);

            var courseId = snapshot.CourseId;
            var studentId = snapshot.StudentId;

            var tooOld = db.Snapshots
                .Find(s => s.CourseId == courseId && s.StudentId == studentId)
                .SortByDescending(s => s.TakenAt)
                .Skip(MaxPerStudent)
                .Project(s => s.Id)
                .ToList();

            if (tooOld.Count > 0)
            {
                db.Snapshots.DeleteMany(s => tooOld.Contains(s.Id));
            }
        }

        public static List<HistoryPoint> GetHistory(Course course, string studentId, string scope, out int hidden)
        {
            hidden = 0;
            var points = new List<HistoryPoint>();
            if (course == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(studentId)) return points;

            scope = GradeScopes.Normalize(scope);
            var period = GradeScopes.PeriodOf(scope);
            var courseId = course.Id;

            var periodOf = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            foreach (var c in course.Categories ?? new List<GradeCategory>())
            {
                if (c.Name != null) periodOf[c.Name] = GradePeriods.Normalize(c.Period);
            }

            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            var snapshots = db.Snapshots
                .Find(s => s.CourseId == courseId && s.StudentId == studentId)
                .SortBy(s => s.TakenAt)
                .ToList();

            double? previous = null;

            foreach (var s in snapshots)
            {
                double earned;
                double gradedWeight;

                if (period == null)
                {
                    earned = s.Earned;
                    gradedWeight = s.GradedWeight;
                }
                else if (period == GradePeriods.Midterm)
                {
                    if (!s.MidtermEarned.HasValue) { hidden++; continue; }
                    earned = s.MidtermEarned.Value;
                    gradedWeight = s.MidtermGradedWeight ?? 0;
                }
                else
                {
                    if (!s.FinalTermEarned.HasValue) { hidden++; continue; }
                    earned = s.FinalTermEarned.Value;
                    gradedWeight = s.FinalTermGradedWeight ?? 0;
                }

                var hasGrades = gradedWeight > GradeCalculator.WeightTolerance;

                if (period != null)
                {
                    if (!previous.HasValue && !hasGrades) continue;
                    if (previous.HasValue && Math.Abs(earned - previous.Value) <= Same) continue;
                }

                // FIX: Force UTC safely so JS Date() doesn't misinterpret timezones.
                var utc = ToUtc(s.TakenAt);
                var point = new HistoryPoint
                {
                    TakenAt = utc,
                    Iso = utc.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                    Label = utc.ToLocalTime().ToString("MM/dd/yyyy h:mm tt", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                    Earned = earned,
                    HasGrades = hasGrades,
                    Equivalent = hasGrades ? GradeCalculator.EquivalentGrade(earned) : null
                };

                if (previous.HasValue)
                {
                    point.Change = earned - previous.Value;
                }

                var shown = s;
                if (period != null && s.Changes != null && s.Changes.Count > 0)
                {
                    shown = new ScoreSnapshot
                    {
                        Reason = s.Reason,
                        Changes = s.Changes
                            .Where(c =>
                            {
                                string p;
                                return c.Category != null && periodOf.TryGetValue(c.Category, out p) && p == period;
                            })
                            .ToList()
                    };
                }

                point.Summary = Describe(shown, MaxNamed);
                point.Details = Describe(shown, int.MaxValue);

                previous = earned;
                points.Add(point);
            }

            return points;
        }

        public static string Describe(ScoreSnapshot snapshot, int maxNamed)
        {
            if (snapshot.Changes == null || snapshot.Changes.Count == 0)
            {
                return string.IsNullOrEmpty(snapshot.Reason) ? ReasonScores : snapshot.Reason;
            }

            var parts = snapshot.Changes
                .Take(maxNamed)
                .Select(c => c.Category + " " + ScoreText(c.OldScore) + " -> " + ScoreText(c.NewScore))
                .ToList();

            var text = string.Join(", ", parts);
            var more = snapshot.Changes.Count - parts.Count;
            if (more > 0) text += " and " + more + " more";

            return text;
        }

        private static string ScoreText(double? score)
        {
            return score.HasValue ? score.Value.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "-";
        }

        private static DateTime ToUtc(DateTime value)
        {
            // FIX: Ensure MongoDB dates are properly recognized as UTC.
            if (value.Kind == DateTimeKind.Utc) return value;
            if (value.Kind == DateTimeKind.Unspecified) return DateTime.SpecifyKind(value, DateTimeKind.Utc);
            return value.ToUniversalTime();
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using GradeWise.Data;
using GradeWise.Models;
using MongoDB.Driver;

namespace GradeWise.Services
{
    public static class NotificationService
    {
        public const int MaxPerStudent = 100;
        public const int DefaultListLimit = 50;
        public const int MaxNamesListed = 3;

        public static void Add(string studentId, string courseId, string courseCode, string kind, string title, string message)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(studentId)) return;

            try
            {
                var db = new MongoDbContext();
                db.Notifications.InsertOne(new Notification
                {
                    Id = "n-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0, 12), // FIX: Added prefix and length
                    StudentId = studentId,
                    CourseId = courseId,
                    CourseCode = courseCode,
                    Kind = kind,
                    Title = title,
                    Message = message,
                    CreatedAtUtc = DateTime.SpecifyKind(DateTime.UtcNow, DateTimeKind.Utc), // FIX: Force UTC
                    IsRead = false
                });

                var tooOld = db.Notifications
                    .Find(n => n.StudentId == studentId)
                    .SortByDescending(n => n.CreatedAtUtc)
                    .Skip(MaxPerStudent)
                    .Project(n => n.Id)
                    .ToList();

                if (tooOld.Count > 0)
                {
                    db.Notifications.DeleteMany(n => n.StudentId == studentId && tooOld.Contains(n.Id));
                }
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                // intentionally ignored
            }
        }

        public static void NotifyScoresChanged(Course course, string studentId, IList<string> changedCategories)
        {
            if (course == null || changedCategories == null || changedCategories.Count == 0) return;

            Add(studentId, course.Id, course.Code, NotificationKinds.Scores,
                course.Code + " scores updated",
                DescribeChanged(changedCategories));
        }

        public static void NotifyCategoriesChanged(Course course, string studentId)
        {
            if (course == null) return;

            Add(studentId, course.Id, course.Code, NotificationKinds.Categories,
                course.Code + " grading categories updated",
                "Your instructor changed the grading categories or weights for " + course.Name + ".");
        }

        public static void NotifyEnrolled(Course course, string studentId)
        {
            if (course == null) return;

            Add(studentId, course.Id, course.Code, NotificationKinds.Enrolled,
                "Enrolled in " + course.Code,
                "You were added to " + course.Code + ": " + course.Name + ".");
        }

        public static void NotifyRemoved(Course course, string studentId)
        {
            if (course == null) return;

            Add(studentId, course.Id, course.Code, NotificationKinds.Removed,
                "Removed from " + course.Code,
                "You were removed from " + course.Code + ": " + course.Name + ".");
        }

        public static string DescribeChanged(IList<string> names)
        {
            var list = names.Where(n => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(n)).Distinct().ToList();
            if (list.Count == 0) return "Your scores were updated.";
            if (list.Count == 1) return list[0] + " was updated.";

            if (list.Count <= MaxNamesListed)
            {
                return string.Join(", ", list.Take(list.Count - 1)) + " and " + list[list.Count - 1] + " were updated.";
            }

            var extra = list.Count - MaxNamesListed;
            return string.Join(", ", list.Take(MaxNamesListed)) + " and " + extra + " more were updated.";
        }

        public static List<Notification> ListFor(string studentId, int limit = DefaultListLimit)
        {
            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            return db.Notifications
                .Find(n => n.StudentId == studentId)
                .SortByDescending(n => n.CreatedAtUtc)
                .Limit(limit)
                .ToList();
        }

        public static int UnreadCount(string studentId)
        {
            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            return (int)db.Notifications.CountDocuments(n => n.StudentId == studentId && n.IsRead == false);
        }

        public static bool MarkRead(string id, string studentId)
        {
            return SetRead(id, studentId, true);
        }

        public static bool MarkUnread(string id, string studentId)
        {
            return SetRead(id, studentId, false);
        }

        public static void MarkAllRead(string studentId)
        {
            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            db.Notifications.UpdateMany(
                n => n.StudentId == studentId && n.IsRead == false,
                Builders<Notification>.Update.Set(n => n.IsRead, true));
        }

        public static bool Delete(string id, string studentId)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(id) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(studentId)) return false;

            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            var result = db.Notifications.DeleteOne(n => n.Id == id && n.StudentId == studentId);
            return result.DeletedCount > 0;
        }

        public static void DeleteAll(string studentId)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(studentId)) return;

            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            db.Notifications.DeleteMany(n => n.StudentId == studentId);
        }

        private static bool SetRead(string id, string studentId, bool read)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(id) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(studentId)) return false;

            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            var result = db.Notifications.UpdateOne(
                n => n.Id == id && n.StudentId == studentId,
                Builders<Notification>.Update.Set(n => n.IsRead, read));
            return result.MatchedCount > 0;
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using GradeWise.Data;
using GradeWise.Models;
using MongoDB.Driver;

namespace GradeWise.Services
{
    public static class ReportService
    {
        public static AnalyticsViewModel GetAnalytics(string courseId, string facultyId, string scope = null)
        {
            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            var course = FindOwned(db, courseId, facultyId);
            if (course == null) return null;

            var courseScope = GradeScopes.Normalize(course.ReflectedScope);
            scope = string.IsNullOrEmpty(scope) ? courseScope : GradeScopes.Normalize(scope);

            var students = EnrolledStudents(db, course);
            var byStudent = ScoresByStudent(db, course);

            var earned = students
                .Select(s => GradeCalculator.CalculateScope(course.Categories, ScoresFrom(byStudent, s.Id), scope).EarnedOrNull)
                .ToList();

            var summary = GradeCalculator.Summarize(earned);
            var bins = GradeCalculator.Distribution(earned);

            var notGradedStudents = new List<DistributionStudent>();
            for (var sIdx = 0; sIdx < students.Count; sIdx++)
            {
                var student = students[sIdx];
                var avg = earned[sIdx];
                var entry = new DistributionStudent
                {
                    StudentNo = student.StudentNo,
                    FullName = student.FullName,
                    Average = avg
                };

                if (!avg.HasValue)
                {
                    notGradedStudents.Add(entry);
                    continue;
                }

                var rounded = Math.Round(avg.Value, 2);
                // FIX: Ensure students with exactly 100 or slight floating point errors above 100 go to the last bin.
                var binIndex = bins.Count - 1;
                for (var i = bins.Count - 2; i >= 0; i--)
                {
                    if (rounded >= bins[i].Min)
                    {
                        binIndex = i;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                bins[binIndex].Students.Add(entry);
            }

            var totalStudents = Math.Max(1, students.Count);
            foreach (var bin in bins)
            {
                bin.Percent = Math.Round(bin.Count * 100.0 / totalStudents, 2);
                bin.BarPercent = (int)Math.Round(bin.Percent);
            }

            var notGradedCount = students.Count - summary.Graded;
            var model = new AnalyticsViewModel
            {
                Scope = scope,
                ScopeLabel = GradeScopes.Label(scope),
                CourseScope = courseScope,
                CourseScopeLabel = GradeScopes.Label(courseScope),
                CourseId = course.Id,
                Code = course.Code,
                Name = course.Name,
                Term = course.Term,
                StudentCount = students.Count,
                NotGraded = notGradedCount,
                NotGradedPercent = Math.Round(notGradedCount * 100.0 / totalStudents, 2),
                WeightTotal = GradeCalculator.ScopeTotal(course.Categories, scope),
                WeightsOk = GradeCalculator.ScopeReady(course.Categories, scope),
                Summary = summary,
                Bins = bins,
                NotGradedStudents = notGradedStudents
            };

            foreach (var category in GradeCalculator.ScopeCategories(course.Categories, scope))
            {
                var catStudents = new List<DistributionStudent>();
                foreach (var s in students)
                {
                    var entryScore = FindScore(ScoresFrom(byStudent, s.Id), category.Name);
                    if (entryScore.HasValue) catStudents.Add(new DistributionStudent { StudentNo = s.StudentNo, FullName = s.FullName, Average = entryScore });
                }
                var scores = catStudents.Select(x => x.Average.Value).ToList();

                model.Categories.Add(new CategoryStat
                {
                    Name = category.Name,
                    Group = GradeGroups.Normalize(category.Group),
                    Period = GradePeriods.Normalize(category.Period),
                    Weight = GradeCalculator.ScopeWeight(category, scope),
                    Graded = scores.Count,
                    Average = scores.Count > 0 ? (double?)scores.Average() : null,
                    Lowest = scores.Count > 0 ? (double?)scores.Min() : null,
                    Highest = scores.Count > 0 ? (double?)scores.Max() : null,
                    PassRate = scores.Count > 0 ? (double?)Math.Round(scores.Count(v => GradeCalculator.IsPassing(v)) * 100.0 / scores.Count, 2) : null,
                    Students = catStudents.OrderByDescending(x => x.Average).ThenBy(x => x.FullName).ToList()
                });
            }

            AddExtraStatistics(model, course, students, byStudent, earned, scope);
            return model;
        }

        // Median, spread, pass rate, completion, top and attention lists, equivalent grades and the term comparison.
        private static void AddExtraStatistics(AnalyticsViewModel model, Course course, List<User> students,
            Dictionary<string, List<ScoreEntry>> byStudent, List<double?> earned, string scope)
        {
            var graded = new List<DistributionStudent>();
            for (var i = 0; i < students.Count; i++)
            {
                if (!earned[i].HasValue) continue;
                graded.Add(new DistributionStudent { StudentNo = students[i].StudentNo, FullName = students[i].FullName, Average = earned[i] });
            }

            if (graded.Count > 0)
            {
                var values = graded.Select(g => g.Average.Value).OrderBy(v => v).ToList();
                var mid = values.Count / 2;
                model.Median = values.Count % 2 == 1 ? values[mid] : (values[mid - 1] + values[mid]) / 2.0;

                var mean = values.Average();
                model.StdDev = Math.Sqrt(values.Sum(v => (v - mean) * (v - mean)) / values.Count);
                model.Range = values[values.Count - 1] - values[0];

                model.Passing = graded.Count(g => GradeCalculator.IsPassing(g.Average));
                model.Failing = graded.Count - model.Passing;
                model.PassRate = Math.Round(model.Passing * 100.0 / graded.Count, 2);

                model.TopStudents = graded.OrderByDescending(g => g.Average).ThenBy(g => g.FullName).Take(5).ToList();
                model.AttentionStudents = graded.Where(g => !GradeCalculator.IsPassing(g.Average))
                    .OrderBy(g => g.Average).ThenBy(g => g.FullName).Take(5).ToList();

                model.PassingStudents = graded.Where(g => GradeCalculator.IsPassing(g.Average))
                    .OrderByDescending(g => g.Average).ThenBy(g => g.FullName).ToList();
                model.FailingStudents = graded.Where(g => !GradeCalculator.IsPassing(g.Average))
                    .OrderBy(g => g.Average).ThenBy(g => g.FullName).ToList();

                var labels = new[] { 1.00, 1.25, 1.50, 1.75, 2.00, 2.25, 2.50, 2.75, 3.00, 5.00 };
                var counts = new Dictionary<double, int>();
                var eqStudents = new Dictionary<double, List<DistributionStudent>>();
                foreach (var g in graded)
                {
                    var eq = GradeCalculator.EquivalentGrade(g.Average);
                    if (!eq.HasValue) continue;
                    var key = Math.Round(eq.Value, 2);
                    int n;
                    counts[key] = counts.TryGetValue(key, out n) ? n + 1 : 1;
                    List<DistributionStudent> list;
                    if (!eqStudents.TryGetValue(key, out list)) { list = new List<DistributionStudent>(); eqStudents[key] = list; }
                    list.Add(g);
                }
                foreach (var label in labels)
                {
                    int n;
                    counts.TryGetValue(label, out n);
                    List<DistributionStudent> inBin;
                    eqStudents.TryGetValue(label, out inBin);
                    model.EquivalentBins.Add(new EquivalentBin
                    {
                        Label = label.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                        Count = n,
                        Percent = Math.Round(n * 100.0 / graded.Count, 2),
                        Students = (inBin ?? new List<DistributionStudent>()).OrderByDescending(x => x.Average).ThenBy(x => x.FullName).ToList()
                    });
                }
            }

            if (scope == GradeScopes.FinalGrade)
            {
                model.Incomplete = students.Count(s => GradeCalculator.IsIncomplete(course.Categories, ScoresFrom(byStudent, s.Id)));
            }

            // Score completion: category scores entered out of students x categories.
            model.ScoresEntered = model.Categories.Sum(c => c.Graded);
            model.ScoresExpected = students.Count * model.Categories.Count;
            if (model.ScoresExpected > 0)
            {
                model.CompletionPercent = Math.Round(model.ScoresEntered * 100.0 / model.ScoresExpected, 2);
            }

            // Class Standing and Exam averages, weighted by the categories' own weights.
            model.ClassStandingAverage = GroupAverage(model.Categories, GradeGroups.ClassStanding);
            model.ExamAverage = GroupAverage(model.Categories, GradeGroups.Exam);

            // Midterm vs Final Term, for the students graded in both.
            if (GradeCalculator.ScopeReady(course.Categories, GradeScopes.Midterm) && GradeCalculator.ScopeReady(course.Categories, GradeScopes.FinalTerm))
            {
                var midterms = new List<double>();
                var finals = new List<double>();
                foreach (var student in students)
                {
                    var scores = ScoresFrom(byStudent, student.Id);
                    var m = GradeCalculator.CalculatePeriod(course.Categories, scores, GradePeriods.Midterm).EarnedOrNull;
                    var f = GradeCalculator.CalculatePeriod(course.Categories, scores, GradePeriods.FinalTerm).EarnedOrNull;
                    if (!m.HasValue || !f.HasValue) continue;

                    midterms.Add(m.Value);
                    finals.Add(f.Value);
                    var rm = Math.Round(m.Value, 2);
                    var rf = Math.Round(f.Value, 2);
                    string status;
                    if (rf > rm) { model.Improved++; status = "Improved"; }
                    else if (rf < rm) { model.Declined++; status = "Declined"; }
                    else { model.Unchanged++; status = "Unchanged"; }

                    model.TermStudents.Add(new TermStudent
                    {
                        StudentNo = student.StudentNo,
                        FullName = student.FullName,
                        Midterm = m.Value,
                        FinalTerm = f.Value,
                        Change = f.Value - m.Value,
                        Status = status
                    });
                }

                if (midterms.Count > 0)
                {
                    model.HasTermComparison = true;
                    model.TermCompared = midterms.Count;
                    model.MidtermAverage = midterms.Average();
                    model.FinalTermAverage = finals.Average();
                    model.TermChange = model.FinalTermAverage - model.MidtermAverage;
                }
            }
        }

        private static double? GroupAverage(IEnumerable<CategoryStat> categories, string group)
        {
            var rows = categories.Where(c => c.Group == group && c.Average.HasValue && c.Weight > 0).ToList();
            var weight = rows.Sum(c => c.Weight);
            return weight > 0 ? (double?)(rows.Sum(c => c.Average.Value * c.Weight) / weight) : null;
        }

        public static string BuildClassCsv(string courseId, string facultyId, string scope, out string fileName)
        {
            fileName = null;

            var db = new MongoDbContext();
            var course = FindOwned(db, courseId, facultyId);
            if (course == null) return null;

            scope = string.IsNullOrEmpty(scope) ? GradeScopes.Normalize(course.ReflectedScope) : GradeScopes.Normalize(scope);
            var wholeCourse = scope == GradeScopes.FinalGrade;
            var scopeLabel = GradeScopes.Label(scope);

            fileName = SafeFileName(course.Code) + "-" + scope + "-class-record-"
                + DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ".csv";

            var students = EnrolledStudents(db, course);
            var byStudent = ScoresByStudent(db, course);
            var cats = GradeCalculator.ScopeCategories(course.Categories, scope).ToList();
            var gradeColumns = wholeCourse ? 3 : 1;
            var width = 2 + cats.Count + gradeColumns * 2;
            var sb = new StringBuilder();

            var header = new List<string> { Text("Student No"), Text("Name") };
            header.AddRange(cats.Select(c => Text(wholeCourse
                ? c.Name + " (" + GradePeriods.Normalize(c.Period) + " " + Whole(c.Weight) + "%)"
                : c.Name + " (" + Whole(c.Weight) + "%)")));
            if (wholeCourse)
            {
                header.Add(Text("Midterm Earned"));
                header.Add(Text("Midterm Equivalent"));
                header.Add(Text("Final Term Earned"));
                header.Add(Text("Final Term Equivalent"));
                header.Add(Text("Final Grade"));
                header.Add(Text("Equivalent"));
            }
            else
            {
                header.Add(Text(scopeLabel + " Earned"));
                header.Add(Text(scopeLabel + " Equivalent"));
            }
            AppendRow(sb, header);

            var columns = Enumerable.Range(0, gradeColumns).Select(i => new List<double?>()).ToList();
            var categoryScores = cats.Select(c => new List<double>()).ToList();

            foreach (var student in students)
            {
                var scores = ScoresFrom(byStudent, student.Id);
                var cells = new List<string> { Text(student.StudentNo), Text(student.FullName) };

                for (var i = 0; i < cats.Count; i++)
                {
                    var value = FindScore(scores, cats[i].Name);
                    cells.Add(value.HasValue ? Whole(value.Value) : string.Empty);
                    if (value.HasValue) categoryScores[i].Add(value.Value);
                }

                var results = wholeCourse
                    ? new[]
                    {
                        GradeCalculator.CalculatePeriod(course.Categories, scores, GradePeriods.Midterm),
                        GradeCalculator.CalculatePeriod(course.Categories, scores, GradePeriods.FinalTerm),
                        GradeCalculator.Calculate(course.Categories, scores)
                    }
                    : new[] { GradeCalculator.CalculateScope(course.Categories, scores, scope) };

                var incomplete = wholeCourse && GradeCalculator.IsIncomplete(course.Categories, scores);
                for (var i = 0; i < results.Length; i++)
                {
                    columns[i].Add(results[i].EarnedOrNull);
                    cells.Add(Cell(results[i].EarnedOrNull));
                    // The last column of a whole-course row is the Final Grade, which can be INC (incomplete).
                    cells.Add(wholeCourse && i == results.Length - 1 && incomplete
                        ? "INC"
                        : Cell(GradeCalculator.EquivalentFromEarned(results[i])));
                }

                AppendRow(sb, cells);
            }

            var summaries = columns.Select(c => GradeCalculator.Summarize(c)).ToList();
            if (summaries[summaries.Count - 1].Graded > 0)
            {
                AppendRow(sb, Enumerable.Repeat(string.Empty, width));

                var categoryAverages = categoryScores.Select(l => l.Count > 0 ? Fixed(l.Average()) : string.Empty).ToList();
                var noCategoryCells = Enumerable.Repeat(string.Empty, cats.Count).ToList();

                AppendRow(sb, ClassRow("Class average", categoryAverages, summaries.Select(x => x.Average)));
                AppendRow(sb, ClassRow("Highest", noCategoryCells, summaries.Select(x => x.Highest)));
                AppendRow(sb, ClassRow("Lowest", noCategoryCells, summaries.Select(x => x.Lowest)));
            }

            return sb.ToString();
        }

        public static string Text(string value)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value)) return string.Empty;

            var first = value[0];
            if (first == '=' || first == '+' || first == '-' || first == '@' || first == '\t' || first == '\r' || first == '\n')
            {
                value = "'" + value;
            }

            if (value.IndexOfAny(new[] { ',', '"', '\r', '\n' }) >= 0 || value != value.Trim())
            {
                value = "\"" + value.Replace("\"", "\"\"") + "\"";
            }

            return value;
        }

        public static string SafeFileName(string value)
        {
            var chars = (value ?? string.Empty)
                .Select(c => (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') || (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c == '_' ? c : '-')
                .ToArray();

            var name = new string(chars).Trim('-');
            return name.Length == 0 ? "course" : name;
        }

        private static List<string> ClassRow(string label, IEnumerable<string> categoryCells, IEnumerable<double?> gradeValues)
        {
            var cells = new List<string> { string.Empty, Text(label) };
            cells.AddRange(categoryCells);
            foreach (var value in gradeValues)
            {
                cells.Add(Cell(value));
                cells.Add(Cell(GradeCalculator.EquivalentGrade(value)));
            }
            return cells;
        }

        private static string Cell(double? value)
        {
            return value.HasValue ? Fixed(value.Value) : string.Empty;
        }

        private static void AppendRow(StringBuilder sb, IEnumerable<string> cells)
        {
            sb.Append(string.Join(",", cells));
            sb.Append("\r\n");
        }

        private static string Fixed(double value)
        {
            return value.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        }

        private static string Whole(double value)
        {
            return value.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        }

        private static Course FindOwned(MongoDbContext db, string courseId, string facultyId)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(courseId) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(facultyId)) return null;
            return db.Courses.Find(c => c.Id == courseId && c.FacultyId == facultyId).FirstOrDefault();
        }

        private static List<User> EnrolledStudents(MongoDbContext db, Course course)
        {
            return db.Users.Find(u => course.StudentIds.Contains(u.Id))
                .SortBy(u => u.FullName)
                .ToList();
        }

        private static Dictionary<string, List<ScoreEntry>> ScoresByStudent(MongoDbContext db, Course course)
        {
            var courseId = course.Id;
            var enrolled = course.StudentIds;
            var map = new Dictionary<string, List<ScoreEntry>>();
            foreach (var record in db.Grades.Find(g => g.CourseId == courseId && enrolled.Contains(g.StudentId)).ToList())
            {
                if (record.StudentId != null && !map.ContainsKey(record.StudentId))
                {
                    map[record.StudentId] = record.Scores ?? new List<ScoreEntry>();
                }
            }
            return map;
        }

        private static List<ScoreEntry> ScoresFrom(Dictionary<string, List<ScoreEntry>> map, string studentId)
        {
            List<ScoreEntry> scores;
            return studentId != null && map.TryGetValue(studentId, out scores) ? scores : new List<ScoreEntry>();
        }

        private static double? FindScore(IEnumerable<ScoreEntry> scores, string category)
        {
            var entry = scores.FirstOrDefault(s => string.Equals(s.Category, category, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
            return entry == null ? null : entry.Score;
        }
    }
}

FILE: GradeWise\Services\StudentService.cs

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using GradeWise.Data;
using GradeWise.Models;
using MongoDB.Driver;

namespace GradeWise.Services
{
    public static class StudentService
    {
        public const int MinClassSize = 3;

        public static StudentDashboardViewModel GetDashboard(string studentId, string requestedCourseId, User student = null)
        {
            var model = new StudentDashboardViewModel { MinClassSize = MinClassSize };
            var db = new MongoDbContext();

            var me = student != null && student.Id == studentId
                ? student
                : db.Users.Find(u => u.Id == studentId).FirstOrDefault();
            model.StudentName = me == null ? null : me.FullName;
            model.StudentNo = me == null ? null : me.StudentNo;

            var mine = db.Courses
                .Find(c => c.StudentIds.Contains(studentId))
                .SortBy(c => c.Code)
                .ThenBy(c => c.Name)
                .ToList();

            if (mine.Count == 0)
            {
                model.Courses = CourseOptions(db, mine);
                return model;
            }

            // FIX: Removed Task.Run. It's an anti-pattern in ASP.NET MVC.
            var course = mine.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Id == requestedCourseId) ?? mine[0];

            FillCourse(db, model, course, studentId);

            model.Courses = CourseOptions(db, mine);
            return model;
        }

        /// <summary>The "My courses" list: every course with what the student has earned so far in its shown term.</summary>
        public static StudentDashboardViewModel GetCourseList(string studentId)
        {
            var model = new StudentDashboardViewModel { MinClassSize = MinClassSize };
            var db = new MongoDbContext();

            var mine = db.Courses
                .Find(c => c.StudentIds.Contains(studentId))
                .SortBy(c => c.Code)
                .ThenBy(c => c.Name)
                .ToList();

            model.Courses = CourseOptions(db, mine);
            model.HasCourse = mine.Count > 0;

            for (var i = 0; i < mine.Count; i++)
            {
                var course = mine[i];
                var scope = GradeScopes.Normalize(course.ReflectedScope);
                var result = GradeCalculator.CalculateScope(course.Categories, ScoresOf(db, course, studentId), scope);
                var option = model.Courses[i];
                option.ScopeLabel = GradeScopes.Label(scope);
                option.Earned = result.Earned;
                option.EarnedGrade = result.EarnedOrNull;
                option.RemainingWeight = result.RemainingWeight;
                option.Ready = GradeCalculator.ScopeCategories(course.Categories, scope).Any()
                    && GradeCalculator.ScopeReady(course.Categories, scope);
            }

            return model;
        }

        public static WhatIfViewModel GetWhatIf(string studentId, string requestedCourseId)
        {
            var model = new WhatIfViewModel();
            var db = new MongoDbContext();

            var mine = db.Courses
                .Find(c => c.StudentIds.Contains(studentId))
                .SortBy(c => c.Code)
                .ThenBy(c => c.Name)
                .ToList();

            model.Courses = CourseOptions(db, mine);
            if (mine.Count == 0) return model;

            var course = mine.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Id == requestedCourseId) ?? mine[0];
            var scope = GradeScopes.Normalize(course.ReflectedScope);
            var scores = ScoresOf(db, course, studentId);
            var result = GradeCalculator.CalculateScope(course.Categories, scores, scope);

            model.HasCourse = true;
            model.SelectedId = course.Id;
            model.Code = course.Code;
            model.Name = course.Name;
            model.Term = course.Term;
            model.Scope = scope;
            model.ScopeLabel = GradeScopes.Label(scope);
            model.ScopeHasCategories = GradeCalculator.ScopeCategories(course.Categories, scope).Any();
            model.HasCategories = model.ScopeHasCategories;
            model.WeightTotal = GradeCalculator.ScopeTotal(course.Categories, scope);
            model.WeightsOk = GradeCalculator.ScopeReady(course.Categories, scope);
            model.Average = result.Average;
            model.Equivalent = GradeCalculator.EquivalentFromEarned(result);
            model.Earned = result.Earned;
            model.RemainingWeight = result.RemainingWeight;
            model.NothingLeft = model.WeightsOk && result.RemainingWeight <= GradeCalculator.WeightTolerance;

            model.DefaultScore = result.Average.HasValue
                ? Math.Max(0, Math.Min(100, Math.Round(result.Average.Value)))
                : 75;

            var perTerm = new Dictionary<string, int>();
            foreach (var category in GradeCalculator.ScopeCategories(course.Categories, scope))
            {
                var own = FindScore(scores, category.Name);
                var weight = GradeCalculator.ScopeWeight(category, scope);
                var period = GradePeriods.Normalize(category.Period);
                var group = GradeGroups.Normalize(category.Group);

                int position;
                perTerm.TryGetValue(period, out position);
                perTerm[period] = position + 1;
                model.Positions[period + "|" + category.Name] = position;

                if (own.HasValue)
                {
                    model.Graded.Add(new BreakdownRow
                    {
                        Category = category.Name,
                        Period = period,
                        Group = group,
                        Weight = weight,
                        Score = own,
                        WeightedPoints = weight * own.Value / 100.0
                    });
                }
                else
                {
                    model.Ungraded.Add(new GradeCategory { Name = category.Name, Period = period, Group = group, Weight = weight });
                }
            }

            model.Scale = GradeCalculator.Scale();
            return model;
        }

        private static List<StudentCourseOption> CourseOptions(MongoDbContext db, List<Course> courses)
        {
            var facultyIds = courses
                .Select(c => c.FacultyId)
                .Where(id => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))
                .Distinct()
                .ToList();

            var names = new Dictionary<string, string>();
            if (facultyIds.Count > 0)
            {
                foreach (var teacher in db.Users.Find(u => facultyIds.Contains(u.Id)).ToList())
                {
                    names[teacher.Id] = teacher.FullName;
                }
            }

            return courses.Select(c => new StudentCourseOption
            {
                Id = c.Id,
                Code = c.Code,
                Name = c.Name,
                FacultyName = FacultyNameOf(names, c.FacultyId)
            }).ToList();
        }

        private static string FacultyNameOf(Dictionary<string, string> names, string facultyId)
        {
            string name;
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(facultyId) && names.TryGetValue(facultyId, out name) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name))
            {
                return name;
            }

            return "Unassigned";
        }

        private static void FillCourse(MongoDbContext db, StudentDashboardViewModel model, Course course, string studentId)
        {
            var historyScope = GradeScopes.Normalize(course.ReflectedScope);
            int hiddenCount;

            // FIX: Straight execution instead of background threads
            var historyPoints = HistoryService.GetHistory(course, studentId, historyScope, out hiddenCount);

            var courseId = course.Id;
            var enrolled = course.StudentIds;
            var records = db.Grades.Find(g => g.CourseId == courseId && enrolled.Contains(g.StudentId)).ToList();
            var byStudent = new Dictionary<string, List<ScoreEntry>>();
            foreach (var record in records)
            {
                if (record.StudentId != null && !byStudent.ContainsKey(record.StudentId))
                {
                    byStudent[record.StudentId] = record.Scores ?? new List<ScoreEntry>();
                }
            }

            var scope = GradeScopes.Normalize(course.ReflectedScope);
            var mine = ScoresFrom(byStudent, studentId);
            var result = GradeCalculator.CalculateScope(course.Categories, mine, scope);

            model.HasCourse = true;
            model.SelectedId = course.Id;
            model.Code = course.Code;
            model.Name = course.Name;
            model.Term = course.Term;
            model.Scope = scope;
            model.ScopeLabel = GradeScopes.Label(scope);
            model.ScopeHasCategories = GradeCalculator.ScopeCategories(course.Categories, scope).Any();
            model.HasCategories = model.ScopeHasCategories;
            model.WeightTotal = GradeCalculator.ScopeTotal(course.Categories, scope);
            model.WeightsOk = GradeCalculator.ScopeReady(course.Categories, scope);
            model.Average = result.Average;
            model.Equivalent = GradeCalculator.EquivalentFromEarned(result);
            model.Earned = result.Earned;
            model.EarnedGrade = result.EarnedOrNull;
            model.RemainingWeight = result.RemainingWeight;
            model.Incomplete = scope == GradeScopes.FinalGrade && GradeCalculator.IsIncomplete(course.Categories, mine);

            model.History = historyPoints;
            model.HistoryHidden = hiddenCount;

            var everyone = course.StudentIds.Select(id => ScoresFrom(byStudent, id)).ToList();
            var earned = everyone.Select(s => GradeCalculator.CalculateScope(course.Categories, s, scope).EarnedOrNull).ToList();
            var summary = GradeCalculator.Summarize(earned);
            model.ClassGraded = summary.Graded;
            model.ClassAverage = summary.Graded >= MinClassSize ? summary.Average : null;

            FillTerms(model, course, mine, everyone, scope);

            foreach (var category in GradeCalculator.ScopeCategories(course.Categories, scope))
            {
                var own = FindScore(mine, category.Name);

                var classScores = everyone
                    .Select(s => FindScore(s, category.Name))
                    .Where(v => v.HasValue)
                    .Select(v => v.Value)
                    .ToList();

                var weight = GradeCalculator.ScopeWeight(category, scope);
                model.Rows.Add(new BreakdownRow
                {
                    Category = category.Name,
                    Period = GradePeriods.Normalize(category.Period),
                    Weight = weight,
                    Score = own,
                    WeightedPoints = own.HasValue ? (double?)(weight * own.Value / 100.0) : null,
                    ClassAverage = classScores.Count >= MinClassSize ? (double?)classScores.Average() : null
                });
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Builds the term tables the same way the faculty score table is built: Class Standing then Exam,
        /// every assessment box, Total, PS, and the Earned grade and Eq. of each term.
        /// </summary>
        private static void FillTerms(StudentDashboardViewModel model, Course course, List<ScoreEntry> mine, List<List<ScoreEntry>> everyone, string scope)
        {
            model.ActiveTab = scope;
            model.ShowFinalGrade = scope == GradeScopes.FinalGrade;

            var midterm = GradeCalculator.CalculatePeriod(course.Categories, mine, GradePeriods.Midterm);
            var finalTerm = GradeCalculator.CalculatePeriod(course.Categories, mine, GradePeriods.FinalTerm);
            model.MidtermEarned = midterm.EarnedOrNull;
            model.MidtermEquivalent = GradeCalculator.EquivalentFromEarned(midterm);
            model.FinalTermEarned = finalTerm.EarnedOrNull;
            model.FinalTermEquivalent = GradeCalculator.EquivalentFromEarned(finalTerm);

            foreach (var period in GradePeriods.All)
            {
                // Only what the instructor released: one term, or both for the Final Grade.
                if (!GradeScopes.Includes(scope, new GradeCategory { Period = period })) continue;

                var result = period == GradePeriods.Midterm ? midterm : finalTerm;
                var table = new StudentTermTable
                {
                    Period = period,
                    Key = period == GradePeriods.Midterm ? GradeScopes.Midterm : GradeScopes.FinalTerm,
                    WeightTotal = GradeCalculator.PeriodTotal(course.Categories, period),
                    Earned = result.EarnedOrNull,
                    Equivalent = GradeCalculator.EquivalentFromEarned(result)
                };

                var categories = course.Categories
                    .Where(c => GradePeriods.Normalize(c.Period) == period)
                    .OrderBy(c => GradeGroups.Normalize(c.Group) == GradeGroups.Exam ? 1 : 0)
                    .ToList();

                foreach (var category in categories)
                {
                    var entry = mine.FirstOrDefault(s => string.Equals(s.Category, category.Name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                    var cell = new StudentCategoryCell
                    {
                        Name = category.Name,
                        Group = GradeGroups.Normalize(category.Group),
                        Weight = category.Weight
                    };

                    double total = 0, gradedMax = 0;
                    var any = false;

                    foreach (var assessment in CourseService.OrderedAssessments(category))
                    {
                        var own = entry == null || entry.AssessmentScores == null
                            ? null
                            : entry.AssessmentScores.FirstOrDefault(a => a.AssessmentId == assessment.Id);

                        cell.Assessments.Add(new StudentAssessmentCell
                        {
                            Name = assessment.Name,
                            MaxScore = assessment.MaxScore,
                            Score = own != null ? own.Score : null
                        });
                        cell.HighestTotal += assessment.MaxScore;

                        if (own != null && own.Score.HasValue)
                        {
                            any = true;
                            total += own.Score.Value;
                            gradedMax += assessment.MaxScore;
                        }
                    }

                    cell.GradedMax = gradedMax;
                    cell.Total = any ? (double?)Math.Round(total, 2) : null;
                    cell.Percent = any && gradedMax > 0 ? (double?)(total / gradedMax * 100.0) : null;
                    table.Categories.Add(cell);

                    // Anonymous class average of the category's PS, only when enough students have a score.
                    var classScores = everyone
                        .Select(s => FindScore(s, category.Name))
                        .Where(v => v.HasValue)
                        .Select(v => v.Value)
                        .ToList();
                    if (classScores.Count >= MinClassSize)
                    {
                        model.CategoryAverages.Add(new CategoryAverage { Name = category.Name, Period = period, Average = classScores.Average() });
                    }
                }

                model.Terms.Add(table);
            }
        }

        private static List<ScoreEntry> ScoresFrom(Dictionary<string, List<ScoreEntry>> byStudent, string studentId)
        {
            List<ScoreEntry> scores;
            return studentId != null && byStudent.TryGetValue(studentId, out scores) ? scores : new List<ScoreEntry>();
        }

        private static List<ScoreEntry> ScoresOf(MongoDbContext db, Course course, string studentId)
        {
            var record = db.Grades.Find(g => g.CourseId == course.Id && g.StudentId == studentId).FirstOrDefault();
            return record == null ? new List<ScoreEntry>() : record.Scores;
        }

        private static double? FindScore(IEnumerable<ScoreEntry> scores, string category)
        {
            var entry = scores.FirstOrDefault(s => string.Equals(s.Category, category, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
            return entry == null ? null : entry.Score;
        }
    }
}

@section scripts {
    <script>
        // Clear What-If targets left in this tab by a previous sign-in. They are saved per course, not per
        // student, so without this the next person to sign in would see the last student's target on My grades.
        (function () {
            try {
                for (var i = sessionStorage.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    var k = sessionStorage.key(i);
                    if (k && k.indexOf("gwWhatIfGoal:") === 0) { sessionStorage.removeItem(k); }
                }
            } catch (e) { }
        })();

        // Back / Forward protection and double-submit protection.
        // The form's security token belongs to whoever was signed in when this page was loaded.
        // If the page comes back from the browser's history after a sign-in, that token is stale,
        // so ask the server again instead of letting the old form be submitted.
        (function () {
            var form = document.querySelector(".gw-login-card form");
            if (!form) { return; }
            var submit = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
            var submitText = submit ? submit.textContent : "";

            // The home page sends signed-in users to their dashboard and everyone else to a fresh sign-in page.
            // A plain GET, so it can never resend a password or show a "resubmit form?" prompt.
            var freshUrl = "@Url.Action("Index", "Home")";
            var leaving = false;

            function reloadFromServer() {
                if (leaving) { return; }
                leaving = true;
                if (submit) { submit.disabled = true; }
                window.location.replace(freshUrl); // replace: the stale page does not stay in history
            }

            function cameFromHistory() {
                try {
                    var nav = window.performance && performance.getEntriesByType
                        ? performance.getEntriesByType("navigation")[0] : null;
                    if (nav) { return nav.type === "back_forward"; }
                    return !!(window.performance && performance.navigation && performance.navigation.type === 2);
                } catch (e) {
                    return false;
                }
            }

            // Case 1: the browser reloaded this page from its cache because of Back / Forward.
            if (cameFromHistory()) {
                reloadFromServer();
                return;
            }

            // Case 2: the browser restored the page exactly as it was (back-forward cache); scripts do not rerun.
            window.addEventListener("pageshow", function (e) {
                if (e.persisted) { reloadFromServer(); }
            });

            // Only send the form once. A second click or Enter press is ignored while the first is on its way.
            var sent = false;
            form.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
                if (sent || leaving) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    return;
                }
                sent = true;
                if (submit) {
                    // Disable after this click is handled, so the first submission still goes through normally.
                    setTimeout(function () {
                        submit.disabled = true;
                        submit.textContent = "Signing in...";
                    }, 0);
                    // Safety net: if the network stalls or the user stops the page, allow another try.
                    setTimeout(function () {
                        sent = false;
                        submit.disabled = false;
                        submit.textContent = submitText;
                    }, 15000);
                }
            });
        })();

        // Show / hide the password. Only changes how the field is displayed; the value and its name are untouched.
        (function () {
            var input = document.getElementById("password");
            var toggle = document.getElementById("password-toggle");
            if (!input || !toggle) { return; }

            var iconVisible = toggle.querySelector('[data-icon="visible"]'); // plain eye
            var iconHidden = toggle.querySelector('[data-icon="hidden"]');   // eye with a diagonal line

            // Match the button to the field's real state:
            // hidden password -> eye-off icon, visible password -> plain eye icon.
            function sync() {
                var visible = input.type === "text";
                iconVisible.style.display = visible ? "block" : "none";
                iconHidden.style.display = visible ? "none" : "block";
                var label = visible ? "Hide password" : "Show password";
                toggle.setAttribute("aria-pressed", visible ? "true" : "false");
                toggle.setAttribute("aria-label", label);
                toggle.setAttribute("title", label);
            }

            // Always start hidden.
            input.type = "password";
            sync();
            toggle.hidden = false;

            // Keep the cursor in the password box when the icon is clicked with a mouse.
            toggle.addEventListener("mousedown", function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });

            toggle.addEventListener("click", function () {
                input.type = input.type === "password" ? "text" : "password";
                sync();
            });

            // Always submit as a password field, so the browser treats it as a password.
            if (input.form) {
                input.form.addEventListener("submit", function () { input.type = "password"; sync(); });
            }
        })();
    </script>
}

@{
    ViewBag.Title = "Accounts and terms";

    var users = Model.ToList();
    var meLogin = ViewBag.MeLogin as string;
    var currentTerm = ViewBag.CurrentTerm as string;
    var roles = new[] { GradeWise.Models.Roles.Administrator, GradeWise.Models.Roles.Faculty, GradeWise.Models.Roles.Student };

    var message = TempData["Message"] as string;
    var error = TempData["Error"] as string;
    var tempPassword = TempData["TempPassword"] as string;
    var tempPasswordFor = TempData["TempPasswordFor"] as string;

    // Why an account cannot be deleted (owns courses, has grades or grade history, last administrator).
    // Accounts not listed can be deleted. AdminController.DeleteUser enforces the same rules on the server.
    var deleteBlockers = ViewBag.DeleteBlockers as Dictionary<string, string> ?? new Dictionary<string, string>();

    // Accounts per role, for the role tabs.
    var byRole = roles.ToDictionary(r => r, r => users.Count(u => u.Role == r));
}
