@model IEnumerable<GradeWise.Models.AcademicTerm>
@functions {
    // Server-side display details, used for the first render and when JavaScript is off.
    // Semester and academic year are read from the saved name ("1st Semester, S.Y. 2026-2027").
    public class TermRow
    {
        public GradeWise.Models.AcademicTerm Term;
        public string Semester;       // "1st Semester", "2nd Semester" or "Summer"; null if the name has another format
        public string AcademicYear;   // "2026-2027"; null if unknown
        public int Order;             // sort key (later terms are larger); 0 if unknown
    }

    private static readonly System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex TermPattern = new System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex(
        @"^\s*(1st Semester|2nd Semester|Summer)(?: Term)?\s*,\s*[SA]\.?\s*Y\.?\s*(\d{4})\s*-\s*(\d{4})\s*$",
        System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);

    public static TermRow ReadTerm(GradeWise.Models.AcademicTerm term)
    {
        var row = new TermRow { Term = term };
        var m = TermPattern.Match(term.Name ?? string.Empty);
        if (m.Success)
        {
            var sem = m.Groups[1].Value.ToLowerInvariant();
            int semIndex = sem.StartsWith("1") ? 1 : sem.StartsWith("2") ? 2 : 3;
            row.Semester = semIndex == 1 ? "1st Semester" : semIndex == 2 ? "2nd Semester" : "Summer";
            row.AcademicYear = m.Groups[2].Value + "-" + m.Groups[3].Value;
            row.Order = int.Parse(m.Groups[2].Value) * 10 + semIndex;
        }
        return row;
    }
}
@{
    ViewBag.Title = "Academic terms";

    var message = TempData["Message"] as string;
    var error = TempData["Error"] as string;

    var rows = Model.Select(ReadTerm).OrderByDescending(x => x.Order).ToList();

    // Academic years offered in the form: last year to three years ahead, plus any year already in use.
    var thisYear = DateTime.Now.Year;
    var ayOptions = Enumerable.Range(thisYear - 1, 5).Select(x => x + "-" + (x + 1))
        .Union(rows.Where(x => x.AcademicYear != null).Select(x => x.AcademicYear))
        .Distinct().OrderBy(x => x).ToList();

    // Why a term cannot be deleted (in use, or courses use it). AdminController.DeleteTerm enforces the same rules.
    var deleteBlockers = ViewBag.TermDeleteBlockers as Dictionary<string, string> ?? new Dictionary<string, string>();

    // The real terms from the database, handed to the page script: id, name, isCurrent, the saved dates
    // (yyyy-MM-dd, or "" for terms saved without dates) and why the term cannot be deleted.
    Func<DateTime?, string> isoDate = d => d.HasValue ? d.Value.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "";
    var termsJson = System.Web.Helpers.Json.Encode(Model.Select(x => new {
        id = x.Id, name = x.Name, isCurrent = x.IsCurrent,
        startDate = isoDate(x.StartDate), endDate = isoDate(x.EndDate),
        deleteBlocked = deleteBlockers.ContainsKey(x.Id) ? deleteBlockers[x.Id] : ""
    }).ToList());
    // Dates in the table rendered by the server (before the script runs, or without JavaScript).
    Func<DateTime?, string> shownDate = d => d.HasValue ? d.Value.ToString("MMM d, yyyy", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "Not set";
}

                    </div>
                    <div data-manage-delete-allowed>
                        <p class="gw-muted gw-editinfo-current">No courses, grades or history use this term. Deleting removes it from the database permanently. This cannot be undone.</p>
                        <div class="gw-form-buttons">

================================================================================

@model GradeWise.Models.AnalyticsViewModel
@using System.Collections.Generic
@using System.Linq
@using GradeWise.Models
@using GradeWise.Services
@{
    ViewBag.Title = Model.Code + " analytics";
    var graded = Model.Summary.Graded;

    // ---- chart helpers (the SVG is built as text so Razor never sees the <text> tag) ----
    var inv = System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
    Func<double, string> n2 = v => v.ToString("0.####", inv);
    Func<string, string> enc = t => System.Web.HttpUtility.HtmlAttributeEncode(t ?? "");
    var sw = Model.StudentCount == 1 ? "student" : "students";
    Func<string, double, double, string, string> svgText = (c0, x0, y0, body) =>
        "<text class=\"" + c0 + "\" x=\"" + n2(x0) + "\" y=\"" + n2(y0) + "\">" + System.Web.HttpUtility.HtmlEncode(body) + "</text>";
    Func<string, int, int, bool, string> tipOf = (label, count, total, clickable) =>
        label + ": " + count + " of " + total + " " + (total == 1 ? "student" : "students")
        + " (" + n2(total > 0 ? Math.Round(count * 100.0 / total, 2) : 0) + "%)" + (clickable ? ". Click to view students" : "");

    // ---- popups opened by clicking a chart (rendered once, at the bottom of the page) ----
    var modalDefs = new List<StudentModalDef>();
    Action<string, string, string, string, string, string, List<StudentModalRow>> addModal =
        (mid, mtitle, mbadge, mmeta, mvalue, mempty, mrows) => modalDefs.Add(new StudentModalDef
        {
            Id = mid, Title = mtitle, Badge = mbadge, Meta = mmeta, ValueHeader = mvalue, EmptyText = mempty, Rows = mrows
        });
    Func<IEnumerable<DistributionStudent>, List<StudentModalRow>> gradeRows = list => list.Select(x => new StudentModalRow
    {
        FullName = x.FullName,
        StudentNo = x.StudentNo,
        Value = GradeCalculator.Format(x.Average) + (GradeCalculator.EquivalentGrade(x.Average).HasValue ? " (eq. " + GradeCalculator.Format(GradeCalculator.EquivalentGrade(x.Average)) + ")" : "")
    }).ToList();
    Func<IEnumerable<DistributionStudent>, List<StudentModalRow>> scoreRows = list => list.Select(x => new StudentModalRow
    {
        FullName = x.FullName,
        StudentNo = x.StudentNo,
        Value = GradeCalculator.Format(x.Average) + "%"
    }).ToList();

    // ---- donut chart and its clickable legend ----
    Func<string, string[], int[], string[], string[], string, string, string> donut = (aria, cls, counts, targets, tips, big, small) =>
    {
        var total = counts.Sum();
        var live = counts.Count(v => v > 0);
        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        sb.Append("<svg class=\"gw-chart gw-donut-svg\" viewBox=\"0 0 200 200\" role=\"img\" aria-label=\"" + enc(aria) + "\">");
        sb.Append("<circle class=\"gw-donut-bg\" cx=\"100\" cy=\"100\" r=\"70\"></circle>");
        double done = 0;
        for (var k = 0; k < counts.Length; k++)
        {
            if (counts[k] <= 0 || total <= 0) continue;
            var pct = counts[k] * 100.0 / total;
            var len = live > 1 ? Math.Max(pct - 0.7, 0.2) : pct;
            sb.Append("<circle class=\"gw-hit gw-donut-seg " + cls[k] + "\" cx=\"100\" cy=\"100\" r=\"70\" pathLength=\"100\" transform=\"rotate(-90 100 100)\""
                + " stroke-dasharray=\"" + n2(len) + " " + n2(100 - len) + "\" stroke-dashoffset=\"" + n2(0 - done) + "\""
                + " data-tooltip=\"" + enc(tips[k]) + "\""
                + (targets[k] != null ? " data-modal-target=\"" + targets[k] + "\" role=\"button\" tabindex=\"0\" aria-label=\"" + enc(tips[k]) + "\"" : "")
                + "></circle>");
            done += pct;
        }
        sb.Append("<circle class=\"gw-donut-ring\" cx=\"100\" cy=\"100\" r=\"83\"></circle>");
        sb.Append("<circle class=\"gw-donut-ring\" cx=\"100\" cy=\"100\" r=\"57\"></circle>");
        sb.Append(svgText("gw-donut-big", 100, 103, big));
        sb.Append(svgText("gw-donut-small", 100, 121, small));
        sb.Append("</svg>");
        return sb.ToString();
    };
    Func<string[], string[], int[], string[], string[], string> legend = (labels, cls, counts, targets, tips) =>
    {
        var total = counts.Sum();
        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        for (var k = 0; k < counts.Length; k++)
        {
            var inner = "<span class=\"gw-swatch " + cls[k] + "\"></span><span class=\"gw-legend-name\">" + System.Web.HttpUtility.HtmlEncode(labels[k]) + "</span>"
                + "<span class=\"gw-legend-num\">" + counts[k] + " <span class=\"gw-muted\">(" + n2(total > 0 ? Math.Round(counts[k] * 100.0 / total, 2) : 0) + "%)</span></span>";
            if (targets[k] != null)
            {
                sb.Append("<li><button type=\"button\" class=\"gw-legend-btn\" data-modal-target=\"" + targets[k] + "\" title=\"" + enc(tips[k]) + "\">" + inner + "</button></li>");
            }
            else
            {
                sb.Append("<li><div class=\"gw-legend-btn gw-legend-static\">" + inner + "</div></li>");
            }
        }
        return sb.ToString();
    };

    if (graded > 0)
    {
        addModal("gw-pass-modal", Model.ScopeLabel + " grade: passing", n2(Math.Round(Model.Passing * 100.0 / graded, 2)) + "%",
            Model.Passing + " of " + graded + " graded pass (64.5 and up)", "Grade (eq.)", "Nobody is at or above passing yet.", gradeRows(Model.PassingStudents));
        addModal("gw-fail-modal", Model.ScopeLabel + " grade: below passing", n2(Math.Round(Model.Failing * 100.0 / graded, 2)) + "%",
            Model.Failing + " of " + graded + " graded are below 64.5", "Grade (eq.)", "Nobody is below passing.", gradeRows(Model.FailingStudents));

        for (var ei = 0; ei < Model.EquivalentBins.Count; ei++)
        {
            var ebin = Model.EquivalentBins[ei];
            if (ebin.Count == 0) { continue; }
            addModal("gw-eq-modal-" + ei, "Equivalent grade " + ebin.Label, ebin.PercentText,
                ebin.Count + " of " + graded + " graded " + (graded == 1 ? "student" : "students"), "Grade", "No students.", gradeRows(ebin.Students));
        }
    }

    if (Model.HasTermComparison)
    {
        var termNames = new[] { "Improved", "Declined", "Unchanged" };
        var termMeta = new[] { "Final Term is higher than Midterm", "Final Term is lower than Midterm", "Final Term is the same as Midterm" };
        for (var ti = 0; ti < termNames.Length; ti++)
        {
            var tname = termNames[ti];
            var tlist = Model.TermStudents.Where(x => x.Status == tname);
            tlist = tname == "Improved" ? tlist.OrderByDescending(x => x.Change).ThenBy(x => x.FullName)
                : tname == "Declined" ? tlist.OrderBy(x => x.Change).ThenBy(x => x.FullName)
                : tlist.OrderBy(x => x.FullName);
            var trows = tlist.Select(x => new StudentModalRow
            {
                FullName = x.FullName,
                StudentNo = x.StudentNo,
                Value = GradeCalculator.Format(x.Midterm) + " to " + GradeCalculator.Format(x.FinalTerm) + " (" + (x.Change > 0 ? "+" : "") + GradeCalculator.Format(x.Change) + ")"
            }).ToList();
            addModal("gw-term-modal-" + ti, tname, trows.Count + " of " + Model.TermCompared, termMeta[ti], "Midterm to Final Term", "No students.", trows);
        }
    }

    for (var ci0 = 0; ci0 < Model.Categories.Count; ci0++)
    {
        var cat0 = Model.Categories[ci0];
        if (cat0.Graded == 0) { continue; }
        addModal("gw-cat-modal-" + ci0, cat0.Name + " (" + cat0.Period + ")", cat0.Graded + " of " + Model.StudentCount,
            "Scores in this category, highest first", "Score", "No scores.", scoreRows(cat0.Students));
    }
}

<section class="gw-panel gw-sr-panel">

                <thead>

                <tbody>
                    @for (var i = 0; i < Model.Bins.Count; i++)
                    {

                        var studentWord = Model.StudentCount == 1 ? "student" : "students";

        }

        if (Model.NotGraded > 0)
        {

            var notGradedWord = Model.StudentCount == 1 ? "student" : "students";
            <div id="@notGradedModalId" class="gw-modal-backdrop" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="@(notGradedModalId)-title" hidden>

        }
    }
</section>

@if (Model.StudentCount > 0 && graded > 0)
{

    var passCounts = new[] { Model.Passing, Model.Failing, Model.NotGraded };
    var passTargets = new string[] { Model.Passing > 0 ? "gw-pass-modal" : null, Model.Failing > 0 ? "gw-fail-modal" : null, Model.NotGraded > 0 ? "gw-bin-modal-notgraded" : null };
    var passTips = new string[3];
    for (var pi = 0; pi < 3; pi++) { passTips[pi] = tipOf(passLabels[pi], passCounts[pi], Model.StudentCount, passTargets[pi] != null); }

    <section class="gw-panel gw-sr-panel">

    // Column chart of graded students per equivalent grade.
    var eqMax = 1;
    foreach (var eb in Model.EquivalentBins) { if (eb.Count > eqMax) { eqMax = eb.Count; } }
    var eqStep = (int)Math.Ceiling(eqMax / 4.0);
    var eqTop = eqStep * 4;
    double plotL = 40, plotR = 632, plotT = 24, plotB = 212;
    var colW = (plotR - plotL) / Model.EquivalentBins.Count;
    var cs = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
    cs.Append("<svg class=\"gw-chart gw-col-chart\" viewBox=\"0 0 640 262\" role=\"img\" aria-label=\"Graded students per equivalent grade\">");
    for (var gi = 0; gi <= 4; gi++)
    {
        var gy = plotB - (plotB - plotT) * gi / 4.0;
        cs.Append("<line class=\"gw-chart-grid\" x1=\"" + n2(plotL) + "\" x2=\"" + n2(plotR) + "\" y1=\"" + n2(gy) + "\" y2=\"" + n2(gy) + "\"></line>");
        cs.Append(svgText("gw-chart-label gw-chart-ytick", plotL - 8, gy + 4, (eqStep * gi).ToString()));
    }
    for (var ci = 0; ci < Model.EquivalentBins.Count; ci++)
    {
        var ebar = Model.EquivalentBins[ci];

        var bw = colW * 0.62;

        var bh = (plotB - plotT) * ebar.Count / (double)eqTop;
        var colTip = tipOf("Equivalent " + ebar.Label, ebar.Count, graded, ebar.Count > 0).Replace(" students (", " graded (").Replace(" student (", " graded (");
        var colAttr = ebar.Count > 0 ? " data-modal-target=\"gw-eq-modal-" + ci + "\" role=\"button\" tabindex=\"0\" aria-label=\"" + enc(colTip) + "\"" : "";

        cs.Append("<rect class=\"gw-hit-area\" x=\"" + n2(cx0) + "\" y=\"" + n2(plotT - 14) + "\" width=\"" + n2(colW) + "\" height=\"" + n2(plotB - plotT + 14) + "\"></rect>");
        if (ebar.Count > 0)
        {
            cs.Append("<rect class=\"gw-col-bar" + (ebar.Label == "5.00" ? " gw-col-fail" : "") + "\" x=\"" + n2(bx) + "\" y=\"" + n2(plotB - bh) + "\" width=\"" + n2(bw) + "\" height=\"" + n2(bh) + "\"></rect>");
            cs.Append(svgText("gw-col-value", bx + bw / 2, plotB - bh - 6, ebar.Count.ToString()));

{
    double rLeft = 210, rW = 400, rTop = 34, rowH = 48;
    Func<double, double> rx = v => rLeft + Math.Max(0, Math.Min(100, v)) * rW / 100.0;
    var rangeH = rTop + Model.Categories.Count * rowH + 10;
    var rs = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
    rs.Append("<svg class=\"gw-chart gw-range-chart\" viewBox=\"0 0 640 " + n2(rangeH) + "\" role=\"img\" aria-label=\"Lowest, average and highest score per category\">");
    foreach (var tick in new[] { 0, 25, 50, 75, 100 })
    {
        rs.Append("<line class=\"gw-chart-grid\" x1=\"" + n2(rx(tick)) + "\" x2=\"" + n2(rx(tick)) + "\" y1=\"" + n2(rTop - 6) + "\" y2=\"" + n2(rangeH - 8) + "\"></line>");
        rs.Append(svgText("gw-chart-label gw-chart-xtick", rx(tick), rTop - 14, tick.ToString()));
    }
    rs.Append("<line class=\"gw-chart-pass\" x1=\"" + n2(rx(64.5)) + "\" x2=\"" + n2(rx(64.5)) + "\" y1=\"" + n2(rTop - 6) + "\" y2=\"" + n2(rangeH - 8) + "\"></line>");
    rs.Append(svgText("gw-chart-passlabel gw-chart-xtick", rx(64.5), rTop - 24, "pass 64.5"));
    for (var ri = 0; ri < Model.Categories.Count; ri++)
    {
        var rc = Model.Categories[ri];
        var rowY = rTop + ri * rowH;
        var midY = rowY + rowH / 2;
        var shortName = rc.Name.Length > 24 ? rc.Name.Substring(0, 23) + "..." : rc.Name;
        var hasScores = rc.Graded > 0 && rc.Average.HasValue && rc.Lowest.HasValue && rc.Highest.HasValue;
        var rangeTip = hasScores
            ? rc.Name + ": average " + GradeCalculator.Format(rc.Average) + "%, lowest " + GradeCalculator.Format(rc.Lowest) + ", highest " + GradeCalculator.Format(rc.Highest) + " (" + rc.Graded + " of " + Model.StudentCount + " graded). Click to view scores"
            : rc.Name + ": no scores yet";
        var rangeAttr = hasScores ? " data-modal-target=\"gw-cat-modal-" + ri + "\" role=\"button\" tabindex=\"0\" aria-label=\"" + enc(rangeTip) + "\"" : "";
        rs.Append("<g class=\"gw-hit\" data-tooltip=\"" + enc(rangeTip) + "\"" + rangeAttr + ">");
        rs.Append("<rect class=\"gw-hit-area\" x=\"2\" y=\"" + n2(rowY) + "\" width=\"636\" height=\"" + n2(rowH) + "\"></rect>");
        rs.Append(svgText("gw-range-name", 10, midY - 2, shortName));
        rs.Append(svgText("gw-chart-label", 10, midY + 14, rc.Period + ", " + GradeCalculator.Format(rc.Weight) + "%"));
        if (hasScores)
        {
            var lx = rx(rc.Lowest.Value);
            var hx = rx(rc.Highest.Value);
            var ax = rx(rc.Average.Value);
            rs.Append("<line class=\"gw-range-line\" x1=\"" + n2(lx) + "\" x2=\"" + n2(hx) + "\" y1=\"" + n2(midY) + "\" y2=\"" + n2(midY) + "\"></line>");
            rs.Append("<line class=\"gw-range-cap\" x1=\"" + n2(lx) + "\" x2=\"" + n2(lx) + "\" y1=\"" + n2(midY - 7) + "\" y2=\"" + n2(midY + 7) + "\"></line>");

            rs.Append("<circle class=\"gw-range-dot\" cx=\"" + n2(ax) + "\" cy=\"" + n2(midY) + "\" r=\"7\"></circle>");
            rs.Append(svgText("gw-chart-label gw-chart-xtick gw-range-avg", ax, midY - 12, GradeCalculator.Format(rc.Average)));

@section scripts {
    <script>
        // Bars, slices, columns and rows open their popup through the shared component (gw-modal.js), which also
        // handles Close buttons, Esc, a click on the dark backdrop, the Tab key and returning focus.
        (function () {
            function openFrom(el) {
                var id = el.getAttribute("data-modal-target");
                if (id && window.GW) GW.modal.open(id);
            }

            document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
                var info = e.target.closest("[data-info-toggle]");
                if (info) {
                    var box = document.getElementById(info.getAttribute("data-info-toggle"));
                    if (box) {
                        var show = box.hasAttribute("hidden");
                        if (show) box.removeAttribute("hidden"); else box.setAttribute("hidden", "");
                        info.setAttribute("aria-expanded", show ? "true" : "false");
                    }
                    return;
                }
                var trigger = e.target.closest("[data-modal-target]");
                if (trigger) openFrom(trigger);
            });

            document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
                if (e.key !== "Enter" && e.key !== " ") return;
                var focused = document.activeElement;
                if (focused && focused.hasAttribute && focused.hasAttribute("data-modal-target") && focused.tagName.toLowerCase() !== "button") {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    openFrom(focused);
                }
            });
        })();

        // Hover tooltip for the charts (anything with class gw-hit and a data-tooltip).
        (function () {
            var tip = document.createElement("div");
            tip.className = "gw-tip";
            tip.setAttribute("role", "tooltip");
            tip.hidden = true;
            document.body.appendChild(tip);

            function place(x, y) {
                var w = tip.offsetWidth, h = tip.offsetHeight;
                var left = Math.max(8, Math.min(x - w / 2, window.innerWidth - w - 8));
                var top = y - h - 14;
                if (top < 8) top = y + 20;
                tip.style.left = left + "px";
                tip.style.top = top + "px";
            }

            function hit(node) {
                return node && node.closest ? node.closest(".gw-hit[data-tooltip]") : null;
            }

            document.addEventListener("mousemove", function (e) {
                var el = hit(e.target);
                if (!el) { tip.hidden = true; return; }
                tip.textContent = el.getAttribute("data-tooltip");
                tip.hidden = false;
                place(e.clientX, e.clientY);
            });
            document.addEventListener("focusin", function (e) {
                var el = hit(e.target);
                if (!el) return;
                var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                tip.textContent = el.getAttribute("data-tooltip");
                tip.hidden = false;
                place(r.left + r.width / 2, r.top);
            });
            document.addEventListener("focusout", function () { tip.hidden = true; });
            window.addEventListener("scroll", function () { tip.hidden = true; }, true);
            document.addEventListener("click", function (e) { if (hit(e.target)) tip.hidden = true; });
        })();
    </script>
}

@model GradeWise.Models.AssessmentScoreViewModel
@using GradeWise.Services
@{
    ViewBag.Title = Model.CategoryName + " / " + Model.AssessmentName;

    // Same standing colours as the class record: lime at 75 and above, gold from 65, orange below.
    Func<double?, string> gradeTone = v => !v.HasValue ? "none" : v.Value >= 75 ? "high" : v.Value >= 65 ? "mid" : "low";

    Func<string, string> initialsOf = n =>
    {
        var parts = (n ?? "").Split(new[] { ' ' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        return parts.Length == 0 ? "?" : (parts[0].Substring(0, 1) + (parts.Length > 1 ? parts[parts.Length - 1].Substring(0, 1) : "")).ToUpperInvariant();
    };

    // Percent of the highest possible score, for the chip beside each box.
    Func<string, double?> percentOf = text =>
    {
        double parsed;
        return !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text)
            && double.TryParse(text, System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Float, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out parsed)
            && Model.MaxScore > 0
            ? (double?)(parsed / Model.MaxScore * 100) : null;
    };

    var percents = Model.Rows.Select(r => percentOf(r.Score)).ToList();
    var entered = percents.Count(v => v.HasValue);
    var missing = Model.Rows.Count - entered;
    double? average = entered == 0 ? (double?)null : percents.Where(v => v.HasValue).Average(v => v.Value);
    var dash = "\u2014";
}

@section scripts {
    <script>
        (function () {
            var PERIODS = ["Midterm", "Final Term"];
            var CAPS = { "Class Standing": 60, "Exam": 40 };
            var form = document.getElementById("cat-form");
            var tabs = [].slice.call(form.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]'));
            var finalNote = document.getElementById("final-note");
            var confirmed = false;

            // The Final Term list follows the Midterm list until the faculty member changes it by hand.
            var finalTouched = form.getAttribute("data-autocopy") !== "1";

            function round2(n) { return Math.round(n * 100) / 100; }
            function listOf(period, group) { return form.querySelector('.gw-cat-list[data-body="' + period + '"][data-group="' + group + '"]'); }
            function rowsOf(period) { return [].slice.call(form.querySelectorAll('.gw-cat-list[data-body="' + period + '"] .gw-cat-row')); }
            function weightOf(row) { return row.querySelector("input[name=weights]"); }
            function nameOf(row) { return row.querySelector("input[name=names]"); }
            function originalOf(row) { return row.querySelector("input[name=originals]").value; }
            function groupInput(row) { return row.querySelector("input[name=groups]"); }
            function periodOfRow(row) { return row.closest(".gw-cat-list").getAttribute("data-body"); }

            // removed rows are hidden (and emptied), so they never count
            function liveRows(period) {
                return rowsOf(period).filter(function (row) { return !row.hidden; });
            }

            function totalFor(period, skipRow) {
                var total = 0;
                liveRows(period).forEach(function (row) {
                    if (row === skipRow) { return; }
                    var v = parseFloat(weightOf(row).value);
                    if (!isNaN(v)) { total += v; }
                });
                return round2(total);
            }

            function totalForGroup(period, groupName) {
                var total = 0;
                liveRows(period).forEach(function (row) {
                    var weight = parseFloat(weightOf(row).value);
                    if (groupInput(row).value === groupName && !isNaN(weight)) { total += weight; }
                });
                return round2(total);
            }

            // A period can never go over 100: cut the typed value down to what is left.
            function clampRow(row) {
                var input = weightOf(row);
                var v = parseFloat(input.value);
                if (isNaN(v)) { return; }
                var max = round2(100 - totalFor(periodOfRow(row), row));
                if (max <= 0) { input.value = ""; }
                else if (v > max) { input.value = max; }
            }

            function refresh() {
                PERIODS.forEach(function (p) {
                    var total = totalFor(p, null);
                    var left = round2(100 - total);
                    var box = form.querySelector('.gw-period-total[data-period="' + p + '"]');
                    box.querySelector("[data-total]").textContent = total;
                    box.querySelector("[data-left]").textContent = "(" + (left > 0 ? left + " left" : "full") + ")";
                    box.querySelector("[data-standing]").textContent = totalForGroup(p, "Class Standing");
                    box.querySelector("[data-exam]").textContent = totalForGroup(p, "Exam");
                    form.querySelector('.gw-tab[data-period="' + p + '"] [data-tab-note]').textContent = total + " / 100";

                    // each group bar shows what it holds against its share of the term
                    Object.keys(CAPS).forEach(function (g) {
                        var bar = form.querySelector('.gw-student-major[data-period="' + p + '"][data-group="' + g + '"]');
                        if (!bar) { return; }
                        var sum = totalForGroup(p, g);
                        bar.querySelector("[data-grp-total]").textContent = sum;
                        bar.classList.toggle("is-full", Math.abs(sum - CAPS[g]) < 0.005);
                        bar.classList.toggle("is-over", sum > CAPS[g] + 0.005);
                        var list = listOf(p, g);
                        var any = [].some.call(list.children, function (row) { return !row.hidden; });
                        bar.querySelector("[data-empty]").hidden = any;
                    });
                });
                if (finalNote) {
                    finalNote.textContent = finalTouched
                        ? "Edited by hand, so it no longer follows the Midterm. Use Copy from Midterm to reset."
                        : "This list copies the Midterm until you edit it.";
                }
            }

            // ---------- tabs ----------
            function selectTab(tab, focus) {
                tabs.forEach(function (t) {
                    var on = t === tab;
                    t.setAttribute("aria-selected", on ? "true" : "false");
                    t.tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1;
                    document.getElementById(t.getAttribute("aria-controls")).hidden = !on;
                });
                if (focus) { tab.focus(); }
            }

            tabs.forEach(function (tab) {
                tab.addEventListener("click", function () { selectTab(tab, false); });
                tab.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
                    if (e.key !== "ArrowRight" && e.key !== "ArrowLeft") { return; }
                    var next = tabs[(tabs.indexOf(tab) + (e.key === "ArrowRight" ? 1 : tabs.length - 1)) % tabs.length];
                    selectTab(next, true);
                });
            });

            // ---------- rows ----------
            function setGroup(row, group) {
                groupInput(row).value = group;
            }

            function makeRow(period, name, weight, group) {
                var row = document.createElement("div");
                row.className = "gw-cat-row";
                row.innerHTML =
                    '<input type="hidden" name="originals" value="" />' +
                    '<input type="hidden" name="periods" value="" />' +
                    '<input type="hidden" name="groups" value="" />' +
                    '<input type="text" name="names" class="gw-cat-name" maxlength="40" placeholder="Category name" aria-label="Category name" />' +
                    '<label class="gw-cat-weight"><input type="number" name="weights" min="0.01" max="100" step="any" inputmode="decimal" aria-label="Weight in percent" /><span aria-hidden="true">%</span></label>' +
                    '<button type="button" class="gw-btn gw-btn-small gw-btn-outline" data-remove="1">Remove</button>';
                row.querySelector("input[name=periods]").value = period;
                nameOf(row).value = name || "";
                weightOf(row).value = weight || "";
                setGroup(row, group || "Class Standing");
                return row;
            }

            // "Quiz" becomes "Final Quiz", "Midterm Quizzes" becomes "Final Quizzes" (names must stay unique in the course).
            function finalName(name) {
                var base = name.replace(/^Midterm\s+/i, "").trim();
                return ("Final " + base).slice(0, 40);
            }

            // Rebuild the Final Term list from the Midterm list. Rows that already exist in the database
            // (they have an original name) are never touched here.
            function copyMidterm() {
                rowsOf("Final Term").forEach(function (row) {
                    if (!originalOf(row)) { row.parentNode.removeChild(row); }
                });
                liveRows("Midterm").forEach(function (row) {
                    var name = nameOf(row).value.trim();
                    var weight = weightOf(row).value;
                    var group = groupInput(row).value;
                    if (!name && !weight) { return; }
                    listOf("Final Term", group).appendChild(makeRow("Final Term", name ? finalName(name) : "", weight, group));
                });
                refresh();
            }

            function syncFinal() {
                if (!finalTouched) { copyMidterm(); }
            }

            // a change in a Midterm row flows into the Final Term copy; a change in a Final Term row ends the copying
            function touched(period) {
                if (period === "Final Term") { finalTouched = true; }
                else { syncFinal(); }
            }

            form.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
                var btn = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest("button") : null;
                if (!btn) { return; }

                var addFor = btn.getAttribute("data-add");
                if (addFor) {
                    var row = makeRow(addFor, "", "", btn.getAttribute("data-group"));
                    listOf(addFor, btn.getAttribute("data-group")).appendChild(row);
                    if (addFor === "Final Term") { finalTouched = true; }
                    refresh();
                    nameOf(row).focus();
                    return;
                }

                if (btn.id === "cat-copy") {
                    finalTouched = false;
                    // rows that exist in the database are emptied and hidden: saving removes them
                    rowsOf("Final Term").forEach(function (r) {
                        if (originalOf(r)) {
                            if (nameOf(r).value) { r.setAttribute("data-removed", nameOf(r).value); }
                            nameOf(r).value = "";
                            weightOf(r).value = "";
                            r.hidden = true;
                        }
                    });
                    copyMidterm();
                    if (window.GW && window.GW.toast) { window.GW.toast("success", "Copied from Midterm. Save to keep it."); }
                    return;
                }

                // Remove = empty the row and hide it. The server ignores empty rows.
                if (btn.getAttribute("data-remove")) {
                    var gone = btn.closest(".gw-cat-row");
                    var goneOf = periodOfRow(gone);
                    if (originalOf(gone) && nameOf(gone).value) { gone.setAttribute("data-removed", nameOf(gone).value); }
                    nameOf(gone).value = "";
                    weightOf(gone).value = "";
                    gone.hidden = true;
                    touched(goneOf);
                    refresh();
                    if (window.GW && window.GW.toast) { window.GW.toast("success", "Category removed. Save to keep it."); }
                }
            });

            form.addEventListener("input", function (e) {
                var row = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest(".gw-cat-row") : null;
                if (!row) { return; }
                if (e.target.name === "weights") { clampRow(row); }
                touched(periodOfRow(row));
                refresh();
            });

            // Warn before saving if a category that has scores is being removed.
            form.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
                if (confirmed) { return; }

                var removed = [];
                form.querySelectorAll(".gw-cat-row").forEach(function (row) {
                    var original = originalOf(row);
                    if (original && !nameOf(row).value.trim() && !weightOf(row).value.trim()) { removed.push(original); }
                });
                if (removed.length === 0) { return; }

                e.preventDefault();
                GW.confirm({
                    title: "Delete category scores?",
                    message: "Removing " + removed.join(", ") + " deletes the scores already entered for it.",
                    okText: "Delete",
                    tone: "danger"
                }).then(function (ok) {
                    if (!ok) { return; }
                    confirmed = true;
                    HTMLFormElement.prototype.submit.call(form);
                });
            });

            // first load: fill the Final Term copy, and after a failed save open the tab that needs fixing
            syncFinal();
            refresh();

            var hasErrors = document.querySelector(".gw-error-list") !== null;
            if (hasErrors) {
                for (var i = 0; i < PERIODS.length; i++) {
                    var rows = liveRows(PERIODS[i]).filter(function (row) { return nameOf(row).value.trim() || weightOf(row).value.trim(); });
                    if (rows.length > 0 && Math.abs(totalFor(PERIODS[i], null) - 100) >= 0.005) {
                        selectTab(tabs[i], false);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        })();
    </script>
}

    var message = TempData["Message"] as string;
    var error = TempData["Error"] as string;

    // The Edit course window: current values, or what was typed when the last save failed.
    var editErrors = TempData["EditCourseErrors"] as List<string> ?? new List<string>();
    var edit = Model.EditCourse;
    var editCode = TempData["EditCourseCode"] as string ?? edit.Code;
    var editName = TempData["EditCourseName"] as string ?? edit.Name;
    var editSection = TempData["EditCourseSection"] as string ?? edit.Section;
    var editTerm = TempData["EditCourseTerm"] as string ?? edit.Term;
    var dash = "\u2014";

    // Colours borrowed from the admin Accounts page: lime, blue, gold, plus lavender and orange.
    var tones = new[] { "lime", "blue", "gold", "lav", "orange" };

    // Passing mark is 65: lime at 75 and above, gold from 65, orange below.
    Func<double?, string> gradeTone = v => !v.HasValue ? "none" : v.Value >= 75 ? "high" : v.Value >= 65 ? "mid" : "low";

    Func<string, string> initialsOf = n =>
    {
        var parts = (n ?? "").Split(new[] { ' ' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        return parts.Length == 0 ? "?" : (parts[0].Substring(0, 1) + (parts.Length > 1 ? parts[parts.Length - 1].Substring(0, 1) : "")).ToUpperInvariant();
    };
}

                                        <th scope="col" class="gw-sr-cat gw-sr-tone-@tone @(p == 0 ? "is-open" : "")" data-cat="@x.Index">
                                            <div class="gw-sr-headtop">
                                                <button type="button" class="gw-sr-cathead" data-sr-cat="@x.Index" aria-expanded="@(p == 0 ? "true" : "false")" title="@x.Category.Name, @GradeCalculator.Format(x.Category.Weight)%, @x.Category.Group">
                                                    <span class="gw-sr-catname">@x.Category.Name</span>
                                                    <span class="gw-sr-catsub">@GradeCalculator.Format(x.Category.Weight)%<span class="gw-sr-catgroup"> &middot; @x.Category.Group</span></span>
                                                </button>
                                                <button type="button" class="gw-sr-tool gw-sr-open-only" data-modal-open="gw-cols-@x.Index" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-label="Edit columns of @x.Category.Name" title="Add, edit or remove columns">
                                                    <img src="@Url.Content("~/Content/img/icons/edit.svg")" alt="" width="14" height="14" />
                                                    <span>Columns</span>
                                                </button>
                                            </div>
                                            <div class="gw-sr-open-only">
                                                <div class="gw-sr-grid gw-sr-grid-head" style="--sr-n:@(x.Category.Assessments.Count + 3)">
                                                    @foreach (var assessment in x.Category.Assessments)
                                                    {
                                                        <span class="gw-sr-gi">@Html.ActionLink(assessment.Name, "Assessment", "Faculty", new { id = Model.CourseId, category = x.Category.Name, assessment = assessment.Id }, new { title = "Edit " + assessment.Name + " and its scores" })</span>
                                                    }
                                                    <span class="gw-sr-gi gw-sr-gi-calc"><span class="gw-sr-fit">Total</span></span>
                                                    <span class="gw-sr-gi gw-sr-gi-calc"><span class="gw-sr-fit">PS</span></span>
                                                    <span class="gw-sr-gi gw-sr-gi-add"><button type="button" class="gw-sr-addtile" data-modal-open="gw-cols-@x.Index" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-label="Add a column to @x.Category.Name" title="Add a column"><span class="gw-sr-fit">+</span></button></span>
                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                        </th>
                                    }
                                    <th scope="col" class="gw-sr-fin">Earned<span class="gw-th-sub"> /100</span></th>
                                    <th scope="col" class="gw-sr-fin gw-sr-eq">Eq.</th>
                                </tr>
                            </thead>
                            <tbody>
                                <tr class="gw-sr-hps">
                                    <td class="gw-sr-student"><strong>Highest possible score</strong></td>
                                    @for (var p = 0; p < periodCategories.Count; p++)
                                    {
                                        var x = periodCategories[p];
                                        <td class="gw-sr-cat gw-sr-tone-@tones[p % tones.Length] @(p == 0 ? "is-open" : "")" data-cat="@x.Index">
                                            <div class="gw-sr-sum"><strong>@GradeCalculator.Format(x.Category.Assessments.Sum(a => a.MaxScore))</strong></div>
                                            <div class="gw-sr-grid" style="--sr-n:@(x.Category.Assessments.Count + 3)">
                                                @foreach (var assessment in x.Category.Assessments)
                                                {
                                                    <span class="gw-sr-gi" data-name="@assessment.Name">
                                                        <input type="number" min="0.01" step="any" inputmode="decimal"
                                                               class="gw-score-input gw-sr-input gw-hps-input"
                                                               name="@CourseService.HpsFieldName(assessment.Id)"

@model GradeWise.Models.EnrollViewModel
@{
    ViewBag.Title = Model.Code + " students";

    var message = TempData["Message"] as string;
    var error = TempData["Error"] as string;

    // Avatar colours cycle through the same accents the course pages use.
    var tones = new[] { "lime", "blue", "gold", "lav", "orange" };

    Func<string, string> initialsOf = n =>
    {
        var parts = (n ?? "").Split(new[] { ' ' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        return parts.Length == 0 ? "?" : (parts[0].Substring(0, 1) + (parts.Length > 1 ? parts[parts.Length - 1].Substring(0, 1) : "")).ToUpperInvariant();
    };
}

<div class="gw-faculty-courses gw-fcourse gw-fpage">

</p>

@if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(error))
{

}
@if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(message))

@section scripts {
    <script>
        (function () {
            function plural(n, word) { return n + " " + word + (n === 1 ? "" : "s"); }

            // ---------- enrolled students: search ----------
            var enTools = document.getElementById("gw-en-tools");
            var enSearch = document.getElementById("gw-en-search");
            var enCount = document.getElementById("gw-en-count");
            if (enTools && enSearch && enCount) {
                var rows = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("#gw-en-table tr[data-student]"));
                var noMatch = document.querySelector(".gw-fp-nomatch");
                var applyEn = function () {
                    var q = enSearch.value.trim().toLowerCase();
                    var shown = 0;
                    rows.forEach(function (r) {
                        var hit = q === "" || (r.getAttribute("data-student") || "").indexOf(q) !== -1;
                        r.hidden = !hit;
                        if (hit) { shown++; }
                    });
                    if (noMatch) { noMatch.hidden = shown !== 0; }
                    enCount.textContent = q === "" ? plural(rows.length, "student") : shown + " of " + plural(rows.length, "student");
                };
                var clearEn = function () { var had = enSearch.value !== ""; enSearch.value = ""; applyEn(); enSearch.focus(); if (had && window.GW && window.GW.toast) { window.GW.toast("success", "Search cleared."); } };
                enSearch.addEventListener("input", applyEn);
                document.getElementById("gw-en-clear").addEventListener("click", clearEn);
                [].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll("[data-en-clear]"), function (b) { b.addEventListener("click", clearEn); });
                enTools.hidden = false;
                applyEn();
            }

            // ---------- available students: search, select all, selected count ----------
            var addForm = document.getElementById("gw-add-form");
            if (!addForm) { return; }
            var addTools = document.getElementById("gw-add-tools");
            var addSearch = document.getElementById("gw-add-search");
            var addCount = document.getElementById("gw-add-count");
            var addSelected = document.getElementById("gw-add-selected");
            var addSubmit = document.getElementById("gw-add-submit");
            var addNoMatch = document.getElementById("gw-add-nomatch");
            var selectAll = document.getElementById("select-all");
            var picks = [].slice.call(addForm.querySelectorAll(".gw-fp-pick"));

            var checkedCount = function () {
                return picks.filter(function (p) { return p.querySelector("input").checked; }).length;
            };

            var refreshAdd = function () {
                var n = checkedCount();
                addSelected.textContent = n === 0 ? "Select students to add." : plural(n, "student") + " selected.";
                addSubmit.disabled = n === 0;
                var visible = picks.filter(function (p) { return !p.hidden; });
                var allVisibleOn = visible.length > 0 && visible.every(function (p) { return p.querySelector("input").checked; });
                selectAll.textContent = allVisibleOn ? "Clear selection" : "Select all";
                var q = addSearch ? addSearch.value.trim().toLowerCase() : "";
                if (addCount) { addCount.textContent = q === "" ? plural(picks.length, "student") : visible.length + " of " + plural(picks.length, "student"); }
                if (addNoMatch) { addNoMatch.hidden = visible.length !== 0; }
            };

            var applyAdd = function () {
                var q = addSearch.value.trim().toLowerCase();
                picks.forEach(function (p) {
                    p.hidden = !(q === "" || (p.getAttribute("data-student") || "").indexOf(q) !== -1);
                });
                refreshAdd();
            };

            if (addSearch) {
                addSearch.addEventListener("input", applyAdd);
                if (addTools) { addTools.hidden = false; }
            }

            // "Select all" only touches the students that match the search
            selectAll.addEventListener("click", function () {
                var visible = picks.filter(function (p) { return !p.hidden; });
                var allVisibleOn = visible.length > 0 && visible.every(function (p) { return p.querySelector("input").checked; });
                visible.forEach(function (p) { p.querySelector("input").checked = !allVisibleOn; });
                refreshAdd();
                if (window.GW && window.GW.toast && visible.length) {
                    window.GW.toast("success", allVisibleOn ? "Selection cleared." : plural(visible.length, "student") + " selected.");
                }
            });

            addForm.addEventListener("change", refreshAdd);
            refreshAdd();
        })();
    </script>
}

@model GradeWise.Models.ProfileInfo
@{
    // Keep the original GradeWise profile modal structure and styling.
    var errors = TempData["EditInfoErrors"] as List<string> ?? new List<string>();
    var which = TempData["EditInfoForm"] as string;
    var posted = TempData["EditInfoProfile"] as Dictionary<string, string> ?? new Dictionary<string, string>();
    Func<string, string, string> value = (key, fallback) => posted.ContainsKey(key) ? posted[key] : fallback;

    var suffixes = new[] { "Jr.", "Sr.", "II", "III", "IV", "V" };
    var legacyParts = (Model.FullName ?? string.Empty).Split(new[] { ' ' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries).ToList();
    var legacySuffix = legacyParts.Count > 0 && suffixes.Contains(legacyParts[legacyParts.Count - 1]) ? legacyParts[legacyParts.Count - 1] : string.Empty;
    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(legacySuffix))
    {
        legacyParts.RemoveAt(legacyParts.Count - 1);
    }
    var fallbackFirst = Model.FirstName;
    var fallbackMiddle = Model.MiddleName;
    var fallbackLast = Model.LastName;
    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fallbackFirst) && legacyParts.Count > 0)
    {
        fallbackFirst = legacyParts[0];
        fallbackLast = legacyParts.Count > 1 ? legacyParts[legacyParts.Count - 1] : string.Empty;
        fallbackMiddle = legacyParts.Count > 2 ? string.Join(" ", legacyParts.Skip(1).Take(legacyParts.Count - 2)) : string.Empty;
    }
    var firstName = value("FirstName", fallbackFirst ?? string.Empty);
    var middleName = value("MiddleName", fallbackMiddle ?? string.Empty);
    var lastName = value("LastName", fallbackLast ?? string.Empty);
    var suffix = value("Suffix", Model.Suffix ?? legacySuffix);
    var loginId = value("LoginId", Model.StudentNo ?? string.Empty);
    var email = value("Email", Model.Email ?? string.Empty);
    var profileErrors = which == "profile" ? errors : new List<string>();
    var passwordErrors = which == "password" ? errors : new List<string>();
    var reopen = profileErrors.Count > 0 || passwordErrors.Count > 0;
    var isFaculty = string.Equals(Model.Role, GradeWise.Models.Roles.Faculty, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    var accountIdLabel = isFaculty ? "Faculty username" : "Student number";
    var accountIdHint = isFaculty
        ? "Your faculty username is used to sign in (e.g. fac_juan)."
        : "Your student number is used to sign in (e.g. 26-0001).";
}

            <h2 id="gw-editinfo-title" class="gw-panel-title">My profile</h2>
        </div>
        <div class="gw-modal-top">
            <div class="gw-modal-meta gw-modal-meta-stack">
                <strong class="gw-profile-name">@Model.FullName</strong>
                <span>@accountIdLabel: @Model.StudentNo</span>
                <span class="gw-muted">@(isFaculty ? "Update your faculty account details or password." : "Update your student account details or password.")</span>
            </div>
            <button type="button" class="gw-iconbtn gw-modal-close" data-modal-close aria-label="Close" title="Close">
                <img src="@Url.Content("~/Content/img/icons/close.svg")" alt="" width="20" height="20" />

        @* Same form style as the admin Add user page (the .gw-user-* classes). *@

                <span class="gw-badge gw-user-locked-badge">@Model.Role</span>

            </div>

            <section class="gw-user-form-block" aria-labelledby="gw-ei-profile-h">
                @if (profileErrors.Count > 0)
                {
                    <div class="gw-alert" role="alert" data-gw-flash="error" data-gw-flash-keep>
                        <strong>Your profile was not updated.</strong>
                        <ul class="gw-error-list">
                            @foreach (var e in profileErrors) { <li>@e</li> }
                        </ul>
                    </div>
                }
                @using (Html.BeginForm("UpdateProfile", "Account", FormMethod.Post))
                {
                    @Html.AntiForgeryToken()
                    <h3 id="gw-ei-profile-h" class="gw-sr-only">Personal and account details</h3>

                    <fieldset class="gw-user-step">
                        <legend class="gw-user-legend"><span class="gw-user-step-no">1</span> Name</legend>
                        <div class="gw-user-grid">

<script>
(function () {
    var modal = document.getElementById('gw-editinfo-modal');
    if (!modal || modal.getAttribute('data-profile-preview-bound') === '1') return;
    modal.setAttribute('data-profile-preview-bound', '1');
    var ids = ['gw-ei-first', 'gw-ei-middle', 'gw-ei-last', 'gw-ei-suffix'];
    var preview = document.getElementById('gw-ei-name-preview');
    function updatePreview() {
        var parts = ids.map(function (id) {
            var el = document.getElementById(id);
            return el ? el.value.trim() : '';
        }).filter(Boolean);
        if (preview) preview.textContent = parts.join(' ') || 'Enter your first and last name';
    }
    ids.forEach(function (id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) {
            el.addEventListener('input', updatePreview);
            el.addEventListener('change', updatePreview);
        }
    });
    updatePreview();
})();
</script>

@using GradeWise.Data
@using MongoDB.Driver
@{
    // Who is signed in? Look the account up in MongoDB so updates show right away.
    string role = null;
    string userName = null;
    string userEmail = null;
    string userNo = null;
    GradeWise.Models.User profileUser = null;
    if (User.Identity.IsAuthenticated)
    {
        try
        {
            // Global.asax already found the account for this request; only look it up again if it did not.
            var me = Context.Items["gw.user"] as GradeWise.Models.User;
            if (me == null)
            {
                var db = new MongoDbContext();
                var identityName = User.Identity.Name;
                me = db.Users.Find(u => u.StudentNo == identityName || u.Email == identityName).FirstOrDefault();
            }
            if (me != null)
            {
                profileUser = me;
                role = me.Role;
                userName = me.FullName;
                userEmail = me.Email;
                userNo = me.StudentNo;
            }
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            role = null;
            userName = null;
            userEmail = null;
            userNo = null;
            profileUser = null;
        }
    }
}

    <script>
        // Instant feedback when something is clicked: a thin bar at the top of the page, and the
        // pressed button is switched off so it cannot be sent twice while the next page loads.
        (function () {
            var root = document.documentElement;
            var timer = null;

            function stop() {
                root.classList.remove("gw-loading");
                clearTimeout(timer);
                var busy = document.querySelectorAll(".gw-busy");
                for (var i = 0; i < busy.length; i++) {
                    busy[i].classList.remove("gw-busy");
                    busy[i].disabled = false;
                }
            }

            function start() {
                root.classList.add("gw-loading");
                clearTimeout(timer);
                timer = setTimeout(stop, 12000);   // never get stuck if the page does not change
            }

            document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
                if (e.defaultPrevented || e.button !== 0 || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.altKey) { return; }
                var a = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest("a[href]") : null;
                if (!a) { return; }
                var href = a.getAttribute("href") || "";
                if (href === "" || href.charAt(0) === "#" || /^(javascript|mailto|tel):/i.test(href)) { return; }
                if ((a.target && a.target !== "_self") || a.hasAttribute("download") || a.hasAttribute("data-no-progress") || a.hasAttribute("data-modal-open")) { return; }
                if (a.origin && a.origin !== window.location.origin) { return; }
                if (/\/Export/i.test(a.pathname)) { return; }   // a file download never leaves the page
                start();
            });

            document.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
                var form = e.target;
                if (e.defaultPrevented || !form || form.hasAttribute("data-no-progress") || (form.target && form.target !== "_self")) { return; }
                start();
                var button = e.submitter || form.querySelector('button[type="submit"], input[type="submit"]');
                if (button && !button.disabled) {
                    // After this click is handled, so the button's own value is still sent with the form.
                    setTimeout(function () { button.disabled = true; button.classList.add("gw-busy"); }, 0);
                }
            });

            // Back to a page that was kept as it was: clear the bar and switch the buttons on again.
            window.addEventListener("pageshow", stop);
        })();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

@model GradeWise.Models.StudentDashboardViewModel
@using System.Globalization
@using GradeWise.Models
@using GradeWise.Services
@{
    // The student's scores, laid out exactly like the faculty Course page: Class Standing then Exam, every assessment box,
    // Total, PS, then Earned /100 and Eq. per term, and the Midterm / Final Term / Final Grade summary.
    // ViewData["Print"] = true (printable summary): no tabs, every released table is listed one after the other.
    var print = (ViewData["Print"] as bool?) == true;

    // Colours borrowed from the admin Accounts page: lime, blue, gold, plus lavender and orange.
    var tones = new[] { "lime", "blue", "gold", "lav", "orange" };

    // Passing mark is 65: lime at 75 and above, gold from 65, orange below (same as the faculty page).
    Func<double?, string> gradeTone = v => !v.HasValue ? "none" : v.Value >= 75 ? "high" : v.Value >= 65 ? "mid" : "low";

    Func<string, string> initialsOf = n =>
    {
        var parts = (n ?? "").Split(new[] { ' ' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        return parts.Length == 0 ? "?" : (parts[0].Substring(0, 1) + (parts.Length > 1 ? parts[parts.Length - 1].Substring(0, 1) : "")).ToUpperInvariant();
    };

    Func<double?, string> scoreText = v => v.HasValue ? v.Value.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "\u2014";

    // The tabs the student can open: the released terms, and the Final Grade when the course reflects it.
    var tabs = Model.Terms.Select(t => new { Key = t.Key, Label = t.Period }).ToList();
    if (Model.ShowFinalGrade) { tabs.Add(new { Key = GradeScopes.FinalGrade, Label = "Final Grade" }); }
    var showTabs = !print && tabs.Count > 1;
    var active = tabs.Count == 0 ? "" : tabs.Any(t => t.Key == Model.ActiveTab) ? Model.ActiveTab : tabs[0].Key;
}

@* The student cell, same look as the faculty table. *@
@helper StudentCell(string name, string no, string initials, string tone)
{
    <td class="gw-sr-student">
        <div class="gw-sr-person">
            <span class="gw-sr-avatar gw-sr-avatar-@tone" aria-hidden="true">@initials</span>
            <span class="gw-sr-person-text">
                <span class="gw-sr-name">@name</span>
                <code class="gw-sr-id">@no</code>
            </span>
        </div>
    </td>
}

<section class="gw-panel gw-sr-panel gw-sg-scores">

    </div>

    @if (!print)
    {
        <div class="gw-panel-body gw-fp-note">
            <p>Each term: <strong>Class Standing 60%</strong> + <strong>Exam 40%</strong> = <strong>100%</strong>. Final grade = &frac12; Midterm + &frac12; Final Term.</p>
        </div>
    }

    @if (Model.Terms.Count == 0 || tabs.Count == 0)
    {
        <div class="gw-panel-body gw-empty-block">Your scores appear once your instructor sets the categories.</div>
    }
    else
    {
        if (showTabs)
        {
            <div class="gw-panel-body gw-tabs-wrap">

                    {

                                aria-selected="@(on ? "true" : "false")" tabindex="@(on ? 0 : -1)" data-tab="@t.Key">@t.Label</button>
                    }
                </div>
            </div>
        }

        foreach (var term in Model.Terms)
        {
            var key = term.Key;
            var isFinal = term.Period == GradePeriods.FinalTerm;

            var groupBlocks = GradeGroups.All
                .Select(g => new
                {
                    Name = g,
                    Key = g == GradeGroups.Exam ? "ex" : "cs",
                    Items = term.Categories.Where(c => c.Group == g).ToList()
                })
                .Where(b => b.Items.Count > 0)
                .ToList();

            <div class="gw-tabpanel" role="tabpanel" id="panel-@key" aria-labelledby="tab-@key" hidden="@(print || key == active ? null : "hidden")">

                {

                }

                }
                else
                {
                    if (!print)
                    {
                        @* Which category is open, grouped as Class Standing and Exam. One is open at a time, so the table always fits the page. *@

                            <span class="gw-sr-bar-label">View scores for</span>
                            @foreach (var block in groupBlocks)
                            {
                                <div class="gw-sr-chipgroup gw-sr-chipgroup-@block.Key" role="group" aria-label="@block.Name categories">
                                    <span class="gw-sr-chipgroup-name">@block.Name <span class="gw-sr-chip-w">@GradeCalculator.Format(block.Items.Sum(i => i.Weight))%</span></span>
                                    <div class="gw-sr-chips">
                                        @foreach (var x in block.Items)
                                        {
                                            var p = term.Categories.IndexOf(x);
                                            <button type="button" class="gw-sr-chip gw-sr-chip-@tones[p % tones.Length]" data-sr-cat="@p" aria-pressed="@(p == 0 ? "true" : "false")">
                                                @x.Name <span class="gw-sr-chip-w">@GradeCalculator.Format(x.Weight)%</span>
                                            </button>
                                        }
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            }
                        </div>
                    }

                    <div class="gw-table-wrap">
                    <table class="gw-table gw-sr-table" data-sr-table>
                        <colgroup>
                            <col class="gw-sr-student" />
                            @for (var p = 0; p < term.Categories.Count; p++)
                            {
                                <col class="gw-sr-cat @(p == 0 && !print ? "is-open" : "")" data-cat="@p" />

                                {

                                        <span class="gw-sr-group-name">@block.Name</span>
                                        <span class="gw-sr-group-w">@GradeCalculator.Format(block.Items.Sum(i => i.Weight))%</span>
                                    </th>
                                }
                                <th class="gw-sr-fin gw-sr-groupblank" aria-hidden="true"></th>
                                <th class="gw-sr-fin gw-sr-eq gw-sr-groupblank" aria-hidden="true"></th>
                            </tr>
                            <tr>
                                <th scope="col" class="gw-sr-student">Student</th>
                                @for (var p = 0; p < term.Categories.Count; p++)
                                {
                                    var x = term.Categories[p];
                                    var tone = tones[p % tones.Length];
                                    <th scope="col" class="gw-sr-cat gw-sr-tone-@tone @(p == 0 && !print ? "is-open" : "")" data-cat="@p">
                                        <div class="gw-sr-headtop">

                                            </button>
                                        </div>
                                        <div class="gw-sr-open-only">

@model GradeWise.Models.StudentDashboardViewModel
@using System
@using System.Collections.Generic
@using System.Globalization
@using System.Linq
@using GradeWise.Services
@{
    // Oldest first, as the service returns them. The chart plots Earned Grade (points out of 100).
    var points = Model.History;

    // The table starts with this many rows; "Show more" reveals more, ten at a time; "Show less" goes back.
    const int FirstShown = 5;
    const int MoreStep = 10;

    // Chart size and margins. Earned Grade runs from 0 to 100 up the side.
    const double W = 600, H = 190, L = 40, R = 16, T = 12, B = 30;
    var pass = GradeCalculator.PassingAverage;
    Func<int, double> px = i => points.Count == 1 ? L + (W - L - R) / 2 : L + (W - L - R) * i / (points.Count - 1);
    Func<double, double> py = v => T + (H - T - B) * (1 - v / 100.0);

    // Razor treats the SVG text tag as its own tag, so the chart labels are built as plain strings (fixed words and numbers only).
    Func<double, double, string, string, string> label = (x, y, anchor, content) =>
        "<text class=\"gw-chart-label\" x=\"" + GradeCalculator.Raw(x) + "\" y=\"" + GradeCalculator.Raw(y)
        + "\" text-anchor=\"" + anchor + "\">" + content + "</text>";

    // Points for the ink line, and the same points closed along the bottom for the lime area fill.
    var linePoints = string.Join(" ", points.Select((p, i) => GradeCalculator.Raw(px(i)) + "," + GradeCalculator.Raw(py(p.Earned))));
    var areaPoints = linePoints + " " + GradeCalculator.Raw(W - R) + "," + GradeCalculator.Raw(H - B)
        + " " + GradeCalculator.Raw(L) + "," + GradeCalculator.Raw(H - B);

    var hiddenCount = Math.Max(0, points.Count - FirstShown);

    // Names the scope in the heading and the grade column ("Midterm grade", "Final Term grade", "Final Grade").
    var gradeHead = Model.Scope == GradeWise.Models.GradeScopes.FinalGrade ? "Final Grade" : Model.ScopeLabel + " grade";
}

<section class="gw-panel gw-history-panel">
    <div class="gw-panel-head">
        <h2 class="gw-panel-title">Progress history (@Model.ScopeLabel)</h2>
    </div>

    @if (Model.HistoryHidden > 0)
    {
        <div class="gw-panel-body gw-history-note">
            <p class="gw-muted gw-small">
                @Model.HistoryHidden older @(Model.HistoryHidden == 1 ? "entry predates" : "entries predate") separate Midterm and Final Term tracking and @(Model.HistoryHidden == 1 ? "appears" : "appear") under Final Grade.
            </p>
        </div>
    }

    @if (points.Count == 0)
    {
        <div class="gw-panel-body gw-empty-state">
            <img src="@Url.Content("~/Content/img/stickers/mascot-cat.svg")" alt="" class="gw-empty-mascot" width="72" height="72" />
            <p class="gw-empty-title">No history yet</p>
            <p class="gw-muted">A snapshot is saved each time your instructor updates your scores.</p>
        </div>
    }
    else
    {
        if (points.Count >= 2)
        {
            <div class="gw-panel-body">
                <svg class="gw-chart" viewBox="0 0 @W @H" role="img"
                     aria-label="Line chart of your @gradeHead over time, from @GradeCalculator.Format(points[0].Earned) to @GradeCalculator.Format(points[points.Count - 1].Earned) out of 100. Passing is @(pass.ToString("0")).">
                    @foreach (var tick in new[] { 0, 100 })
                    {
                        <line class="gw-chart-grid" x1="@GradeCalculator.Raw(L)" x2="@GradeCalculator.Raw(W - R)" y1="@GradeCalculator.Raw(py(tick))" y2="@GradeCalculator.Raw(py(tick))" />
                        @Html.Raw(label(L - 6, py(tick) + 4, "end", tick.ToString()))
                    }
                    <line class="gw-chart-pass" x1="@GradeCalculator.Raw(L)" x2="@GradeCalculator.Raw(W - R)" y1="@GradeCalculator.Raw(py(pass))" y2="@GradeCalculator.Raw(py(pass))" />
                    @Html.Raw(label(L - 6, py(pass) + 4, "end", pass.ToString("0")))

                    <polygon class="gw-chart-area" points="@areaPoints" />
                    <polyline class="gw-chart-line" points="@linePoints" />

                    @* Each point gets a tall hover band (like the faculty Analytics charts): hover or focus it to see the grade. *@
                    @for (var i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
                    {
                        var step = (W - L - R) / (points.Count - 1);
                        // Plain words only, no symbols: "11/23/2026 3:39 AM, Midterm grade 66.75, Equivalent 3.00, up 2.00".
                        var tip = points[i].Label + ", " + gradeHead + " " + GradeCalculator.Format(points[i].Earned)
                                  + ", Equivalent " + (points[i].HasGrades ? GradeCalculator.Format(points[i].Equivalent) : "none yet")
                                  + (points[i].Change.HasValue ? ", " + (points[i].Change.Value >= 0 ? "up " : "down ") + GradeCalculator.Format(Math.Abs(points[i].Change.Value)) : "");
                        <g class="gw-hit gw-history-hit" data-tooltip="@tip" data-iso="@points[i].Iso" tabindex="0" role="img" aria-label="@tip">
                            <rect class="gw-hit-area" x="@GradeCalculator.Raw(px(i) - step / 2)" y="@GradeCalculator.Raw(T)" width="@GradeCalculator.Raw(step)" height="@GradeCalculator.Raw(H - T - B)" />
                            <circle class="gw-chart-dot" cx="@GradeCalculator.Raw(px(i))" cy="@GradeCalculator.Raw(py(points[i].Earned))" r="4" />
                        </g>
                    }
                </svg>
                <p class="gw-chart-legend"><span class="gw-chart-key" aria-hidden="true"></span>Dashed line: passing grade (@(pass.ToString("0")))</p>
            </div>
        }

        <div class="gw-table-wrap">
            <table class="gw-table gw-history-table" id="gw-history-table">
                <thead>
                    <tr>
                        <th>When</th>
                        <th>What changed</th>
                        <th class="gw-num">@gradeHead</th>
                        <th class="gw-num">Equivalent</th>
                        <th class="gw-num">Change</th>
                    </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                    @for (var i = points.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
                    {
                        var h = points[i];
                        var rowNumber = points.Count - 1 - i;   // 0 is the newest row

                        // "A, B, C and 2 more" becomes "A, B, C" + a button; the button swaps in the full list (h.Details).
                        var more = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Match(h.Summary ?? "", @"^(.*) and (\d+) more$");
                        var canExpand = more.Success && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(h.Details) && h.Details != h.Summary;
                        <tr class="gw-history-row" hidden="@(rowNumber >= FirstShown)">
                            <td><time class="gw-history-time" datetime="@h.Iso">@h.Label</time></td>
                            <td class="gw-history-what" title="@h.Details">
                                @if (canExpand)
                                {
                                    <span class="gw-what-short">@more.Groups[1].Value</span>
                                    <button type="button" class="gw-what-toggle gw-what-more" aria-expanded="false">and @more.Groups[2].Value more</button>
                                    <span class="gw-what-full" hidden>@h.Details <button type="button" class="gw-what-toggle gw-what-less" aria-expanded="true">show less</button></span>
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    @h.Summary
                                }
                            </td>
                            <td class="gw-num">@GradeCalculator.Format(h.Earned)</td>
                            <td class="gw-num">@GradeCalculator.Format(h.Equivalent)</td>
                            <td class="gw-num">
                                @if (h.Change.HasValue)
                                {
                                    @((h.Change.Value >= 0 ? "+" : "") + GradeCalculator.Format(h.Change))
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    <span class="gw-muted">&mdash;</span>
                                }
                            </td>
                        </tr>
                    }
                </tbody>
            </table>
        </div>

        if (hiddenCount > 0)
        {
            <div class="gw-panel-body gw-history-more">
                <button type="button" class="gw-btn gw-btn-small gw-btn-outline" id="gw-history-more" data-step="@MoreStep">Show more (@hiddenCount)</button>
                <button type="button" class="gw-btn gw-btn-small gw-btn-outline" id="gw-history-less" data-first="@FirstShown" hidden>Show less</button>
            </div>
        }
    }
</section>

<script>
    (function () {
        // Hover tooltip for the chart (anything with class gw-hit and a data-tooltip), same as faculty Analytics.
        (function () {
            var tip = document.createElement("div");
            tip.className = "gw-tip";
            tip.setAttribute("role", "tooltip");
            tip.hidden = true;
            document.body.appendChild(tip);

            function place(x, y) {
                var w = tip.offsetWidth, h = tip.offsetHeight;
                var left = Math.max(8, Math.min(x - w / 2, window.innerWidth - w - 8));
                var top = y - h - 14;
                if (top < 8) top = y + 20;
                tip.style.left = left + "px";
                tip.style.top = top + "px";
            }
            function hit(node) {
                return node && node.closest ? node.closest(".gw-hit[data-tooltip]") : null;
            }
            document.addEventListener("mousemove", function (e) {
                var el = hit(e.target);
                if (!el) { tip.hidden = true; return; }
                tip.textContent = el.getAttribute("data-tooltip");
                tip.hidden = false;
                place(e.clientX, e.clientY);
            });
            document.addEventListener("focusin", function (e) {
                var el = hit(e.target);
                if (!el) return;
                var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                tip.textContent = el.getAttribute("data-tooltip");
                tip.hidden = false;
                place(r.left + r.width / 2, r.top);
            });
            document.addEventListener("focusout", function () { tip.hidden = true; });
            window.addEventListener("scroll", function () { tip.hidden = true; }, true);
        })();

        function pad(n) { return n < 10 ? "0" + n : String(n); }

        // Show each time in the viewer's own time zone as MM/DD/YYYY h:mm AM/PM.
        var localTimes = {};
        var times = document.querySelectorAll("time.gw-history-time[datetime]");
        for (var t = 0; t < times.length; t++) {
            var d = new Date(times[t].getAttribute("datetime"));
            if (isNaN(d.getTime())) continue;
            var hours = d.getHours();
            var suffix = hours >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM";
            hours = hours % 12;
            if (hours === 0) hours = 12;
            var shown = pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + "/" + pad(d.getDate()) + "/" + d.getFullYear() +
                " " + hours + ":" + pad(d.getMinutes()) + " " + suffix;
            times[t].textContent = shown;
            localTimes[times[t].getAttribute("datetime")] = shown;
        }

        // The chart tooltips start with the same time, so they show the viewer's own time too.
        var hits = document.querySelectorAll(".gw-history-hit[data-iso]");
        for (var k = 0; k < hits.length; k++) {
            var local = localTimes[hits[k].getAttribute("data-iso")];
            var text = hits[k].getAttribute("data-tooltip") || "";
            var cut = text.indexOf(", ");
            if (!local || cut < 0) continue;
            var fixed = local + text.substring(cut);
            hits[k].setAttribute("data-tooltip", fixed);
            hits[k].setAttribute("aria-label", fixed);
        }

        // "and N more" in the What changed column: show the full list, "show less" folds it back.
        document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
            var btn = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest(".gw-what-toggle") : null;
            if (!btn) return;
            var cell = btn.closest(".gw-history-what");
            if (!cell) return;
            var expand = btn.classList.contains("gw-what-more");
            var shortText = cell.querySelector(".gw-what-short");
            var moreBtn = cell.querySelector(".gw-what-more");
            var full = cell.querySelector(".gw-what-full");
            var lessBtn = cell.querySelector(".gw-what-less");
            if (!shortText || !moreBtn || !full || !lessBtn) return;
            shortText.hidden = expand;
            moreBtn.hidden = expand;
            full.hidden = !expand;
            moreBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", expand ? "true" : "false");
            (expand ? lessBtn : moreBtn).focus();
        });

        // "Show more" reveals up to ten more rows. "Show less" goes back to the first five.
        var more = document.getElementById("gw-history-more");
        var less = document.getElementById("gw-history-less");
        var table = document.getElementById("gw-history-table");
        if (!more || !less || !table) return;
        var step = parseInt(more.getAttribute("data-step"), 10) || 10;
        var first = parseInt(less.getAttribute("data-first"), 10) || 5;

        function rows() { return table.querySelectorAll("tr.gw-history-row"); }

        function refresh() {
            var all = rows();
            var hiddenCount = 0;
            for (var i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
                if (all[i].hasAttribute("hidden")) hiddenCount++;
            }
            more.textContent = "Show more (" + hiddenCount + ")";
            more.hidden = hiddenCount === 0;
            less.hidden = all.length - hiddenCount <= first;
        }

        more.addEventListener("click", function () {
            var all = rows();
            var left = step;
            for (var i = 0; i < all.length && left > 0; i++) {
                if (all[i].hasAttribute("hidden")) {
                    all[i].removeAttribute("hidden");
                    left--;
                }
            }
            refresh();
            if (more.hidden) less.focus();
        });

        less.addEventListener("click", function () {
            var all = rows();
            for (var i = first; i < all.length; i++) all[i].setAttribute("hidden", "");
            refresh();
            (table.tHead || table).scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
            more.focus();
        });
    })();
</script>

    var goalKey = "gw.goal." + Model.StudentNo + "." + Model.SelectedId;

@if (!Model.HasCategories)
{
    <div class="gw-alert gw-alert-warn" role="status">
        No @Model.ScopeLabel grading categories are set for this course yet, so there is nothing to calculate.
